rows.title: Entry Level Cloud Infrastructure Network Monitoring and Automation Software Engineer - San Jose, CA - 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

At IBM, work is more than a job. It is a calling: To build. To design. To code. To consult. To think along with clients and sell. To make markets. To invent. To collaborate. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you have never thought possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the world's most challenging problems? If so, let's talk.

About Business Unit

IBM Cloud is the global public cloud platform from IBM, one of the most secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready cloud platforms in the world. IBM Cloud powers thousands of enterprises with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS) offerings delivered across public, private, and hybrid cloud models.

Within IBM Cloud, the Network Underlay organization is responsible for designing, building, and operating the physical and software-defined network infrastructure that underpins IBM Cloud's global fleet of data centers. NetTools is the automation and tooling engineering team within Network Underlay. We build the software systems that allow network engineers to provision, configure, monitor, and manage network infrastructure at scale, across dozens of data centers globally.

The Network Automation mission within NetTools develops and operates three interconnected platforms: NCS/Axon (Network Configuration Service), the system that automates the full lifecycle of network switch configuration from initial rack bring-up to day-to-day operations; SSOT (Source of Truth) and Hivemind, the authoritative data stores for network configuration state in classic and next-generation data center environments respectively; and the associated monitoring, validation, and reporting pipelines that keep our network infrastructure compliant, observable, and reliable.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Software Developers at IBM are the backbone of our strategic initiatives to design, code, test, and provide industry-leading solutions that make the world run today. Planes and trains take off on time, bank transactions complete in the blink of an eye, and the world remains safe because of the work our software developers do. At IBM, you will use the latest software development tools, techniques, and approaches and work with leading minds in the industry to build solutions you can be proud of.

As a Back-End Developer on the NetTools Network Automation team, you will own and deliver production-grade back-end services and automation pipelines that are critical to the daily operation of IBM Cloud's network infrastructure. You will work alongside senior engineers building and evolving the Axon/NCS platform and the SSOT/Hivemind systems, taking on direct ownership of components from design through delivery.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Implement and automate infrastructure solutions: design, develop, and maintain back-end Python microservices that implement Day-0 (initial network provisioning, Zero Touch Provisioning) and Day-2 (operational changes, firmware updates, configuration drift remediation) automation workflows. This includes owning REST API endpoints, YAML-driven input processing, and Jinja2-based configuration generation pipelines that produce switch configurations deployed across IBM Cloud data centers.Build and maintain automated test frameworks: design, implement, and own unit, integration, and end-to-end regression tests for the Axon/NCS platform. Establishing reliable test coverage and a dedicated test environment is a key team priority, and this role will drive that work forward, including authoring test cases, identifying edge conditions, and validating end-to-end workflow correctness.Build and set up CI/CD pipelines in OpenShift and Kubernetes environments: administer automated CI/CD systems and tools that support the development and test lifecycle of NCS/Axon services, ensuring reliable and repeatable delivery of changes to production.Own SSOT and Hivemind integration work: design and deliver the interfaces between NCS/Axon and the SSOT/Hivemind data platforms (backed by NetBox and CockroachDB), ensuring that network context data (rack topology, port mappings, cable connections, device inventory) is reliably consumed and validated by the automation workflows.Support the compliance and security integrity of the environment: contribute to the NCS Overhaul initiative by hardening service components, improving Docker container configuration practices, writing operational runbooks, and ensuring the platform meets IBM's security and compliance requirements.Partner with cross-functional teams on alerting and monitoring: collaborate with Network Engineering, Data Center Operations, and program managers to develop and maintain observability for mission-critical NCS services, and provide technical escalation support for infrastructure operations teams.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Back-end development in Python: demonstrated experience writing and maintaining production Python services, including REST API design and consumption (e.g., Flask, FastAPI, or equivalent), JSON/YAML data processing, and service-layer business logic.Version control and collaborative development with Git: proficiency working in a Git-based team workflow, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD integration.Containerization and deployment: working knowledge of Docker (building, configuring, and running containers) and familiarity with container orchestration via Kubernetes or OpenShift. NCS runs as containerized workloads on IBM's Fabric Container Platform.REST API design and HTTP fundamentals: ability to design, implement, document, and consume RESTful APIs. The Axon architecture exposes Day-0 and Day-2 network build APIs consumed by multiple service teams across IBM Cloud.Automated testing and software quality: experience writing unit and integration tests, building regression test suites, and applying software quality practices in a production-critical environment.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Working knowledge with one or more operating systems: Ubuntu (preferred), RHEL, or CentOS Linux.Working knowledge with one or more programming tools: Bash, PowerShell, Python, Ruby, or Go.Working knowledge with key infrastructure tools: Ansible, Chef, or equivalent configuration management tooling.Familiarity with template engines such as Jinja2 or Helm. Configuration generation in NCS is built on Jinja2 templates rendered from YAML-based rack context inputs.Basic understanding of networking concepts: IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6), VLANs, switching, routing fundamentals, or exposure to Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP). Intellectual curiosity about network infrastructure at scale is a strong plus.Working knowledge with monitoring and observability technologies: Zabbix (preferred), Splunk, or Grafana.Working knowledge with ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub

Company Description

Application Opening: 9/25/2026Application Deadline: May close anytime but no sooner than Friday, 10/16/2026 at 5:00PM (PDT). Salary Range: $143,572 - $180,596 annually (click here to learn more)

Controller’s Office

The Controller is the City’s chief financial officer. Our team includes financial, technology, analytical, and other professionals who work hard to secure the City’s financial integrity and promote efficient, effective, and accountable government. We hold ourselves to high standards and strive to be a model for good government. We value the diverse backgrounds, perspectives and lived experiences of our teams and clients in everything we do. We work in a collaborative and inclusive environment, promote equal opportunity, and invest in the professional development and well-being of our team members. You can expect to work alongside colleagues who are committed to serving the public with integrity and want to see positive impacts from their work. We are looking for smart, motivated individuals who want to make a difference and use government to play a role in solving our City’s issues, including addressing long-standing and harmful disparities in our communities. For a career with purpose and professional growth, join us in the Controller’s Office!

Systems Division of the Controller’s Office:

The Systems Division of the Controller’s Office manages the City and County of San Francisco’s Enterprise Oracle and PeopleSoft Applications, which include Oracle Interaction Hub, PeopleSoft Human Capital Management (HCM), PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM), PeopleSoft Enterprise Learning Management (ELM), and Oracle Business Intelligence. These applications are branded locally as our SF Employee Portal, SF People & Pay, SF Financials, SF Procurement, SF Learning, and SF Reports and Analytics systems. Collectively, these applications provide a robust, integrated platform that delivers mission-critical services to 55 City Departments, eliminating the need for hundreds of independent legacy systems and customized applications. The division serves over 35,000 active City employees, 75,000 retirees and 25,000 City vendors (bidders and suppliers). Peripheral and legacy applications also leveraged by the division include Oracle Identify & Access Management, Sherpa Budget Formulation & Management, Phire Architect, Control-M, and FreshWorks. The technology implemented and maintained by the Systems Division provides standardization, transparency, and efficiency for the City’s crucial business processes. Users are fully supported to ensure adoption of these interconnected systems.

Job Description

Business Intelligence Platform Change Project

The Controller’s Office is working in a multi-year project to migrate the Reports and Analytics solution into a unified Snowflake-based platform. The BI Platform Change will provide departments with secure, streamlined access to PeopleSoft data, improving efficiency, governance, and standardizing data sharing citywide. By replacing outdated processes, this modern framework supports transparency, accountability, collaboration, better service delivery, strategic growth, and public trust.

Job Description:

This IS Engineer position will be part of the BI Platform Change project and will work with members of the SF Reports & Analytics Team, Functional Teams and other City and County staff to support the project. The analyst will perform both functional (business process and systems analysis) and technical (report, query and dashboard development, data extract, load and transformation, metadata modeling, tuning, and troubleshooting) tasks.

This position will be supporting the current Oracle BI platform, but it will also collaborate in the building of the new business intelligence platform using tools such as dbt, SQL, and other tools with a Snowflake data warehouse source and target.

Essential duties include but are not limited to:

Analyze the interrelationships of business processes, complex financial data, human resources data, and systems to develop reporting requirements and data structures. Perform fit/gap analysis to evaluate reporting and data needs. Develop and maintain OBIEE/OAS dashboards, analyses, and BI Publisher reports. Design and enhance RPDs (Physical, BMM & Presentation Layers). Support Subject Areas, Logical Table Sources (LTS), and metadata models. Develop ETL solutions using ODI, perform query optimization, cache management, and performance tuning, support production issues, enhancements, and troubleshooting activitiesWrite business and system process and technical documentation. Identify, manage and escalate issues and risks throughout software development life cycle. Performing other duties as assigned. 

Qualifications

Education: An associate degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or a closely related field from an accredited college or university OR its equivalent in terms of total course credits/units [i.e., at least sixty (60) semester or ninety (90) quarter credits/units with a minimum of twenty (20) semester or thirty (30) quarter credits/units in one of the fields above or a closely-related field].

Experience: One (1) year of experience analyzing, installing, configuring, enhancing, and/or maintaining the components of a system or platform.

Substitution: One year of additional experience as described above may be substituted for the required degree; or Completion of the 1010 Information Systems Trainee Program may be substituted for the required degree.

One-year full-time employment is considered equivalent to 2000 hours (2000 hours of qualifying work experience is based on a 40-hour work week). Any overtime hours that you work above forty (40) hours per week are not included in the calculation to determine full-time employment. Applicants must meet minimum qualification requirements by the final filing date unless otherwise noted. Every application is reviewed to ensure that you meet the minimum qualifications as listed in the job ad. Please review our articles on Employment Application and Minimum Qualifications and Verification of Experience and/or Education for considerations taken when reviewing applications. 

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS:

Technical Knowledge

Working expertise in OBIEE, OAS, ODI, BI Publisher, SQL, and Data Warehousing. Hands-on experience in RPD development, dashboard creation, performance tuning, security implementationOne (1) years of experience in the information systems field, including system analysis, business process design, development and implementation of business application solutions or IT project management. One (1) year of hands-on experience administering and developing on Oracle databases and experience with Snowflake managed cloud data platformOne (1) years of Demonstrated expertise in writing advanced, performant SQL, using SQL-based data transformation and modelingExperience with layered data architecture (staging, intermediate, marts) using dbt best practices to support analytics and reporting use cases including parameterized and dynamic dbt models using Jinja templating to support reusable transformations across multiple datasets and environmentsHands-on experience in GitHub for code change management and collaboration with other team membersExperience in building and deploying data pipelines using orchestration toolsUnderstanding the process to build and deploy data pipelines using orchestration toolsDeep understanding of data warehouse concepts, data modeling, and modern ETL principlesUnderstanding of data governance, data security, and data privacy principlesUnderstanding of PeopleSoft applications such as PeopleSoft Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM), PeopleSoft Capital Human Resources (HCM) experience performing data analysis, design and testing. Working with DBAs, BI Development team, PeopleSoft, and Security teams to improve performance and data quality using Agile sessionsWorking knowledge of business process flows used to support a complex accounting system, and experience in developing and executing application test plans. 

Collaboration And Communication Skills

Strong problem-solving skills with ability to design practical and effective data solutionsExcellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholdersA collaborative mindset with enthusiasm to work across diverse, cross-functional teams

Mission alignment

Commitment to equity, transparency, and ethical data usePassion for public service using data to improve government services

Additional Information

Selection Procedures 

The selection process will include evaluation of applications in relation to minimum requirements. Candidates whose qualifications most closely meet the needs of the Department will move forward in the recruitment process.

About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is looking for engineers to help build the world’s best search and assistant product for work. Our engineers work on a range of systems across the stack, including query understanding, document understanding, domain-adapted language models, natural language question-answering, evaluation, and experimentation. We interact regularly with customers, deeply understand their pain points, and use whatever tool is necessary, simple or complex, to solve their problems.

You Will

Invent new signals to improve the personalization of our search engineTrain a model to capture interactions between signals in our ranking systemDesign smarter ways to domain-adapt language models to each customer’s corpusDiscover new ways of combining LLMs with search engines to answer complex questionsWrite robust code that’s easy to read, maintain, and testMentor more junior engineers, or learn from battle-tested ones

About You

Compensation & Benefits

The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $265,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

rows.title: Software Engineering Manager (semiconductor/capital equipment)
rows.descriptionText:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead the Diagnostics & Calibration software team for EUV actinic reticle inspection system. This role will be responsible for technical leadership, people management, and delivery execution for software that diagnoses and calibrates KLA’s reticle inspection platforms. We are looking for a leader who is energized by problems that are one of a kind and is not afraid to push the limits of creativity. If you are someone who will leverage the current wave of AI and motivate the team to spin up a proof-of-concept over a weekend because you are curious this role is for you.

You will partner closely with physicists, hardware engineers, system teams, and global software organizations to translate complex system-level requirements into robust, scalable diagnostic and calibration solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role ideal for a manager who enjoys growing teams while remaining technically engaged.

Travel occasionally to global sites and customer locations to support integration, bring-up, and deployment activities (10–20%).

Multidisciplinary background in either Physical science, Computer science, Microscopy, Optics, or relevant fields with either a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in relevant field.8+ years of software development experience, with 2+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role.Strong background in system-level software development involving hardware-software interaction.Familiarity with using AI tools for SW development (e.g. Devin, Codex)Familiarity with building applications using LLMs / generative AI and agentic frameworks, and integrate them into engineering workflows.Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps)Proficiency programming languages such as Python, C++, or C#.Experience developing medium to large-scale software applications in multi-developer environments.Demonstrated ability to translate user needs and system requirements into technical specifications and executable plans.Strong problem-solving skills with experience diagnosing and resolving complex system-level issues.Excellent communication and collaboration skills in globally distributed teams.Self-motivated leader with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. rows.title: Entry Level Cloud Infrastructure Network Monitoring and Automation Software Engineer - San Jose, CA - 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

At IBM, work is more than a job. It is a calling: To build. To design. To code. To consult. To think along with clients and sell. To make markets. To invent. To collaborate. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you have never thought possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the world's most challenging problems? If so, let's talk.

About Business Unit

IBM Cloud is the global public cloud platform from IBM, one of the most secure, scalable, and enterprise-ready cloud platforms in the world. IBM Cloud powers thousands of enterprises with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS) offerings delivered across public, private, and hybrid cloud models.

Within IBM Cloud, the Network Underlay organization is responsible for designing, building, and operating the physical and software-defined network infrastructure that underpins IBM Cloud's global fleet of data centers. NetTools is the automation and tooling engineering team within Network Underlay. We build the software systems that allow network engineers to provision, configure, monitor, and manage network infrastructure at scale, across dozens of data centers globally.

The Network Automation mission within NetTools develops and operates three interconnected platforms: NCS/Axon (Network Configuration Service), the system that automates the full lifecycle of network switch configuration from initial rack bring-up to day-to-day operations; SSOT (Source of Truth) and Hivemind, the authoritative data stores for network configuration state in classic and next-generation data center environments respectively; and the associated monitoring, validation, and reporting pipelines that keep our network infrastructure compliant, observable, and reliable.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Software Developers at IBM are the backbone of our strategic initiatives to design, code, test, and provide industry-leading solutions that make the world run today. Planes and trains take off on time, bank transactions complete in the blink of an eye, and the world remains safe because of the work our software developers do. At IBM, you will use the latest software development tools, techniques, and approaches and work with leading minds in the industry to build solutions you can be proud of.

As a Back-End Developer on the NetTools Network Automation team, you will own and deliver production-grade back-end services and automation pipelines that are critical to the daily operation of IBM Cloud's network infrastructure. You will work alongside senior engineers building and evolving the Axon/NCS platform and the SSOT/Hivemind systems, taking on direct ownership of components from design through delivery.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Implement and automate infrastructure solutions: design, develop, and maintain back-end Python microservices that implement Day-0 (initial network provisioning, Zero Touch Provisioning) and Day-2 (operational changes, firmware updates, configuration drift remediation) automation workflows. This includes owning REST API endpoints, YAML-driven input processing, and Jinja2-based configuration generation pipelines that produce switch configurations deployed across IBM Cloud data centers.Build and maintain automated test frameworks: design, implement, and own unit, integration, and end-to-end regression tests for the Axon/NCS platform. Establishing reliable test coverage and a dedicated test environment is a key team priority, and this role will drive that work forward, including authoring test cases, identifying edge conditions, and validating end-to-end workflow correctness.Build and set up CI/CD pipelines in OpenShift and Kubernetes environments: administer automated CI/CD systems and tools that support the development and test lifecycle of NCS/Axon services, ensuring reliable and repeatable delivery of changes to production.Own SSOT and Hivemind integration work: design and deliver the interfaces between NCS/Axon and the SSOT/Hivemind data platforms (backed by NetBox and CockroachDB), ensuring that network context data (rack topology, port mappings, cable connections, device inventory) is reliably consumed and validated by the automation workflows.Support the compliance and security integrity of the environment: contribute to the NCS Overhaul initiative by hardening service components, improving Docker container configuration practices, writing operational runbooks, and ensuring the platform meets IBM's security and compliance requirements.Partner with cross-functional teams on alerting and monitoring: collaborate with Network Engineering, Data Center Operations, and program managers to develop and maintain observability for mission-critical NCS services, and provide technical escalation support for infrastructure operations teams.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Back-end development in Python: demonstrated experience writing and maintaining production Python services, including REST API design and consumption (e.g., Flask, FastAPI, or equivalent), JSON/YAML data processing, and service-layer business logic.Version control and collaborative development with Git: proficiency working in a Git-based team workflow, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD integration.Containerization and deployment: working knowledge of Docker (building, configuring, and running containers) and familiarity with container orchestration via Kubernetes or OpenShift. NCS runs as containerized workloads on IBM's Fabric Container Platform.REST API design and HTTP fundamentals: ability to design, implement, document, and consume RESTful APIs. The Axon architecture exposes Day-0 and Day-2 network build APIs consumed by multiple service teams across IBM Cloud.Automated testing and software quality: experience writing unit and integration tests, building regression test suites, and applying software quality practices in a production-critical environment.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Working knowledge with one or more operating systems: Ubuntu (preferred), RHEL, or CentOS Linux.Working knowledge with one or more programming tools: Bash, PowerShell, Python, Ruby, or Go.Working knowledge with key infrastructure tools: Ansible, Chef, or equivalent configuration management tooling.Familiarity with template engines such as Jinja2 or Helm. Configuration generation in NCS is built on Jinja2 templates rendered from YAML-based rack context inputs.Basic understanding of networking concepts: IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6), VLANs, switching, routing fundamentals, or exposure to Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP). Intellectual curiosity about network infrastructure at scale is a strong plus.Working knowledge with monitoring and observability technologies: Zabbix (preferred), Splunk, or Grafana.Working knowledge with ServiceNow, JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub

rows.title: Applied AI Engineer — Early Career
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

We’re building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab.

Goaly is a stealth AI startup founded by ex-Meta Superintelligence Labs engineers and researchers. Our mission is to dramatically lower the cost, time, and talent barriers to building proprietary AI — and make each generation of models faster and cheaper to build than the last.

Backed by leading AI investors and endorsed by frontier AI researchers and builders, we’re looking for exceptional new grads who want to work on hard, foundational AI systems problems with outsized ownership from day one.

About The Role

Join as a full member of the technical team from day one. You’ll own meaningful AI problems end-to-end — not just a narrow component — and work directly with the founding team across model post-training, RL environments, distributed systems, training or inference performance, backend services, APIs, SDKs, or developer tools.

We move fast, give strong engineers real responsibility early, and encourage great work to become papers, open-source contributions, and production systems used by real customers.

This role is designed for exceptional early-career engineers finishing or recently finished with a bachelor’s or master’s degree, or showing equivalent ability through what they’ve built. We look for raw technical strength, initiative, and unusual learning speed more than pedigree. That can show up through research, OSS, ambitious projects, internships, competitions, startup work, or products used by real people.

Candidates with deeper research experience, including AI PhDs, may be a stronger fit for our AI Research Scientist — Early Career role.

What you'll do

Build applied AI projects end-to-end — from problem framing and prototyping to evaluation, production rollout, and iteration. Create agentic systems and applications, including agent harnesses, tool use, workflows, memory, and multi-step execution. Apply strong prompt, context, and loop engineering to make models more reliable, capable, and efficient on real-world tasks. Track frontier models, research, and AI-native developer tools; quickly test what is useful and turn new capabilities into product improvements. Design evaluations, datasets, and feedback loops to measure model and agent performance, diagnose failures, and guide iteration. Move fluidly across the stack depending on where the hardest problem is — from model APIs and inference to backend services, developer tooling, and product features. Use AI coding and development tools aggressively but thoughtfully, while maintaining strong technical judgment and code quality. 

Why Goaly

Work on frontier AI problems across model training, inference, agentic RL infra, and domain-specialized continual learning.

Build systems that push research into production — from new mode recipes and post-training methods to infrastructure that runs at serious scale.

Publish and contribute to open source and top AI conferences, with opportunities to pursue work worthy of top AI conferences and rele

ase impactful OSS used by the broader AI community.

Serious resources to build with: well-capitalized, substantial GPU capacity, and competitive compensation.

Learn directly from a founding team that has trained trillion-parameter models and built frontier-scale AI infrastructure, while developing your own research and technical leadership.

Own meaningful problems from day one. On a small, highly technical team, you’ll have unusually large scope, research freedom, and direct impact on both the product & technical roadmap.

Move fast and own the full problem, not one tiny component. Work directly with the founding team, make technical decisions quickly, and take ideas from research to production without layers of process.

H-1B sponsorship available; OPT/CPT candidates welcome.

You may be a good fit if you have

A bachelor’s or master’s in CS, engineering, math, or a related field — or equivalent ability demonstrated through your work. Typically 0–2 years of full-time experience. Strong coding skills and CS fundamentals, with evidence from projects, research, internships, competitions, or shipped products. A track record of learning quickly, taking initiative, and delivering ambitious work with limited structure. Genuine curiosity about the AI frontier & Continuous learning — you actively track new models, research, tools, and applications and like experimenting with what’s newly possible. Grit, humility, and a willingness to work hard on the highest-impact problem, even outside your initial area of expertise. Clear communication and comfort working in a fast-moving, low-ego team. 

Strong pluses

Meaningful OSS contributions or independent systems used by others. Experience with ML/LLMs, distributed systems, GPUs, compilers, databases, networking, or performance. Strong results in research, competitions, technical internships, or startup work. A track record of turning ideas into working systems quickly, measuring results, and iterating. 

Location, visa sponsorship & benefits

Hybrid in Palo Alto: 4+ days/week in office. Visa sponsorship: H-1B and OPT/CPT support available, with immigration counsel. Meals & perks: Complimentary lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks. 

A note on qualifications. We value exceptional ability over perfect keyword matches. If the work excites you and you can show strong technical ability, learning speed, or ownership, we encourage you to apply.

Equal opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

We are using AI to build and ship AI hardware. Etched’s production ramp requires thousands of interdependent, chained decisions that involve product configurations, material availability, production capacity, capital commitments, complex logistics, field deployments, customer commitments, and more. You will embed with Platform, Production, Supply Chain, Finance, and manufacturing partners to build the agentic systems that make those decisions faster and better.

You will own the development of agentic systems that loop signal to execution: understanding what Etched needs to manufacture and deliver; modelling production plans and scenarios; triaging changes and the unexpected; capturing decisions in the systems we execute through - and designing agents that augment and scale our teams. Success is measured by what we deliver, the schedules we attain, our ramp speed, and time from signal to action. Production is the product.

Etched offers a unique environment to tackle real supply-chain challenges and production decisions with frontier model capabilities: we have our own in-office cluster to run agentic systems on, all teams are in-person, and every cluster we deploy offers an opportunity to raise the bar across production. You will build the frontier systems that help us coordinate execution and learn from every build.

Key Responsibilities

Build, deploy, and operate AI systems that run S&OP, material planning, build readiness, manufacturing partner execution, quality, logistics, and customer deployments.Embed with Platform, Production, Supply Chain, Finance, and other teams to identify high-leverage decisions, turn them into executable workflows augmented by agentic systems, and own outcomes.Build operational models connecting demand, product configurations, revisions, BOMs, supply, inventory, cost, capacity, builds, tests, quality, and shipments.Build agents that craft executable plans considering demand, supply, capacity, inventory, capital, schedules, and risk - and keep those plans current as constraints change.Propagate design changes through material exposure, sourcing, cost, factory and test readiness, production schedules, and delivery commitments.Build production and quality agents that coordinate clear-to-build, work in progress, bottlenecks, testing, excursions, genealogy, containment, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.Design historical replays and live evals tied to operating outcomes including forecast quality, schedule attainment, inventory, cost, yield, throughput, and resolution time.Continuously evaluate frontier models and system optimization methods.

You may be a good fit if you have

A track record of solving hard problems across stacks and domains. You enjoy being dropped into unfamiliar territory and figuring it outComfort with Python and code: you can read it, modify it, debug it, and direct AI to write it well. We do not care whether you write code from scratch. We care whether you ship things that workFluency using AI to learn and ramp on new problems; agentic coding tools, deep research, and frontier models are how you work, not an add-onHands-on experience building and shipping LLM-based agents or AI tooling that real users depend on (beyond just calling an AP - context engineering, tool integration, orchestration, failure analysis)An eval-driven mindset: you measure whether AI systems actually work before scaling themHigh agency and comfort with ambiguity. You can find the problem, not just solve the stated oneWorked in complex hardware, manufacturing, supply chain, S&OP, operations research, or enterprise planning, ideally through periods of hyperscale

Strong Candidates May Also Have Experience With

ERP/MRP, PLM, MES, and/or QMSBOMs and ECOs, NPI and ramp, factory test, or quality systemsForecasting, constraint optimization, simulation, or digital twins

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage$500 per month credit for waiving medical benefitsHousing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the officeRelocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and moreDaily lunch and dinner in our officeUnlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification
How We’re Different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is looking for engineers to help build the world’s best search and assistant product for work. Our engineers work on a range of systems across the stack, including query understanding, document understanding, domain-adapted language models, natural language question-answering, evaluation, and experimentation. We interact regularly with customers, deeply understand their pain points, and use whatever tool is necessary, simple or complex, to solve their problems.

This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our San Francisco office)

Compensation & Benefits

The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $265,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. rows.descriptionText:
Description

Design Strategy at Gensler is focused on enabling transformation. Our creative and collaborative approach, supported by data and intelligence, enables impactful change and evolution of our clients’ organization, culture, and environment.

Our practice in New York is growing and we are looking for a talented design strategist to focus on data-driven projects across our broad range of services including workplace strategy, real estate portfolio strategy, generating user insights, and performing behavior analytics. We’re focused on developing holistic real estate and design strategies for a wide range of influential organizations, such as major corporations, healthcare providers, cultural institutions, real estate developers, and universities. We are looking for early career applicants with an entrepreneurial spirit who are eager to learn how data and insights can empower our client relationships and evolve our practice.

Your Role 

As a Design Strategist, you will collaborate with teams working to develop and deliver meaningful insights through a blend of quantitative and qualitative strategies. You will learn how to leverage client data from a range of sources to evaluate current conditions and develop solutions that support our clients’ objectives. Your work will span a wide range of scales, from pilot projects that test new ideas to strategies rolled out across the globe. You’ll participate in research efforts, synthesize data and feedback, and develop innovative future state concepts and solutions.

What You Will Do

On projects, as a Design Strategist you’ll:

Collaborate closely with Strategy Leads and Directors on work sessions with internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders Assist in the planning and performing of user research and data collection activities Help develop analytical methodologies for solving business problems to make portfolio or enterprise-level decisionsAnalyze large scale qualitative and quantitative data sets to determine impact on business goals, organizational culture, or performance criteria for spatial design Support projects that explore data modeling and statistical analysis (e.g., clustering, regression) to uncover workplace patterns Assist in building automation tools to increase efficiency and scalability for clientsInterface with Gensler ‘s Design Technology team to orchestrate complex, multi-sourced data analysis and managementCollaborate on developing scenarios (with plans, data, feedback, relevant precedents, etc) to illustrate a range of relevant solutions, based on the research, that meet client objectives Support project findings through compelling presentations, reports, posters, videos, websites, etc.Interface with Gensler design studios to ensure the seamless transition of design strategy into design implementation

Your Qualifications

You’re passionate about the built environment and its impact on individuals and organizations. You are curious, analytical, and creative, eager to explore how data can uncover stories about how people work, connect, and use space. You

have experience with research methodologies and activities, and can with work with both qualitative and quantitative data are curious about how data connects to human behavior, culture, design, and spaceenjoy open-ended exploration, digging into data to uncover insights that were not obvious at firstare a clear communicator and presenter of ideas, findings and/or point of vieware an enthusiastic collaborator and are able to work successfully with a range of other disciplines who complement your experience are a critical and creative thinker, with a solution-oriented mindsetrespond proactively and thoughtfully to feedback from clients and colleagues can graphically visualize information and ideas, able to effectively use charts, and graphics to represent and communicate findings and complex ideas can draft strong narratives in support of graphical findings/insights

Your background and experience

0-2 years of relevant professional experience in data-driven research, strategy, or designBachelor’s or Master’s degree in architecture, interior design, environmental design, urban design, real estate, design strategy, organizational development, organizational psychology, or similar fields Coursework in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other quantitative fields is a plusProficiency in data analysis, visualization, and managementProficiency in Excel/Google SheetsProficiency with data modeling, clustering, or regression analysisProficiency in data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is a plusExperience working with Power Query or Google App ScriptExperience working with workplace performance data and survey data is a plusFamiliarity with Python (numpy/pandas/sklearn), R, or SQL is a plusFamiliarity in Adobe Creative Suite 

To be considered, please include 2-3 project examples that demonstrate your qualifications as described above and a cover letter as part of your submission. 

The base salary range will be estimated between $75,000 - $83,000 plus bonuses and benefits and contingent on relevant experience.

About Strategy At Gensler

Gensler’s Strategy Practice is focused on exploring and defining how space, technology, services, and policy can create great experiences and support an organizations’ best work. We use in-depth user research and data to explore and develop strategies that enable our clients to meet their business and organizational objectives. With our design teams here in New York and around the world, we conceptualize and implement creative solutions that support our client’s needs. In parallel, we help our clients manage change to ensure new ideas take root, and to build capability that sustains.

Life at Gensler

At Gensler, we are as committed to enjoying life as we are to delivering best-in-class design. From curated art exhibits to internal design competitions to “Well-being Awareness Week,” our offices reflect our people’s diverse interests.

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. Our comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability, wellness programs, flex spending, paid holidays, and paid time off. We also offer a 401k, profit sharing, employee stock ownership, and twice annual bonus opportunities. Our annual base salary range has been established based on local markets.

As part of the firm’s commitment to licensure and professional development, Gensler offers reimbursement for certain professional licenses and associated renewals and exam fees. In addition, we reimburse tuition for certain eligible programs or classes. We view our professional development programs as strategic investments in our future.

NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of choice. All aspects of employment decisions will be based on merit, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected under federal, state and local law.

Job Description:

The Analytics, Modeling & Insights (AMI) organization is on a mission to deliver significant value, create lasting impact, and influence the future of the Enterprise through trusted, objective insights, thoughtful experimentation, and next-level innovation. Our vision is to power responsible growth with insight, foresight, and clarity by demonstrating the principles that shape how we work:

Objective: Maintain an unbiased lens to inform sound decisions grounded in data.Innovative: Embrace emerging technologies and methods to continuously amplify our capabilities.Strategic: Apply enterprise-wide data and deep expertise to anticipate needs and guide sustainable decisions.Collaborative: Partner across disciplines to deliver insights aligned with stakeholder needs.Effective Storytelling: Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives that drive action.Efficient: Optimize tools and processes for timely, consistent, and scalable impact.

AMI is looking for an intellectually curious, business-minded analyst who wants to turn complex data into insights that shape what comes next. As part of the Channel and Consumer Client Insights team, you will apply quantitative analysis to deepen understanding of consumer clients, their behaviors, journeys, and interactions across channels. Your work may span client segmentation and profiling, audience development, advanced behavioral analytics, and insights from financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences. You will uncover meaningful patterns and translate them into strategies that improve client experiences and business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and human behavior. You will tackle high-visibility questions, explore complex and varied data, and create clear recommendations for leaders across the organization. The strongest candidates will pair hands-on analytical skill with curiosity, creativity, and a talent for making complex findings meaningful.

Responsibilities

In this role, the analyst will translate complex client and channel data into meaningful insights, owning quantitative work from business question through actionable recommendation. Responsibilities may include:

Developing Client and Channel Insights: Analyze client, household, transaction, and interaction data to identify patterns, needs, and opportunities that inform business strategy and improve client experiences.Understanding Behaviors and Journeys: Examine how clients engage over time and across touchpoints to deepen understanding of behaviors, journeys, relationships, and channel usage.Creating Segments and Audiences: Develop client profiles, segments, and actionable audiences that illuminate meaningful differences and support targeted business decisions.Applying Advanced Analytics: Use appropriate statistical, behavioral, and quantitative techniques to evaluate trends, relationships, cohorts, and performance.Assessing Channel Experiences: Generate insights across financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences to identify opportunities to simplify service and improve how clients engage.Advancing Analytic Methods: Improve approaches for organizing, classifying, and interpreting client and interaction data to increase the quality and usefulness of insights.Creating Reusable Analytics: Build reproducible data sets, code, methodologies, and documentation that can scale into reusable analytic assets and data products.Delivering Compelling Stories: Translate complex analysis into concise, executive-ready narratives, visualizations, and recommendations that drive action.Partnering Across the Enterprise: Work with business, strategy, data, technology, risk, and analytics partners to clarify objectives and deliver timely, decision-relevant work.Managing Work Responsibly: Lead assignments from intake through delivery while maintaining quality, documentation, and applicable data, privacy, risk, and analytic standards.

Required Skills

Demonstrated experience as an innovative thinker, self-starter, and creative problem solver who is intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.Experience performing quantitative analysis using large, complex, or multi-source data sets.Technical and analytical aptitude to perform data analysis, trending, segmentation, behavioral analysis, and other statistical techniques.Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical programming language or statistical tool, such as Python, R, SAS, or an equivalent platform.Ability to structure ambiguous business questions, select an appropriate analytical approach, validate results, and develop practical recommendations.Crisp written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts and develop compelling presentations for varied audiences.Strong attention to detail, ability to manage competing priorities, and effectiveness working independently and across teams.Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, data science, computer science, engineering, business analytics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Desired Skills

Experience in financial services, consumer banking, client insights, channel insights, marketing analytics, or strategy.Experience analyzing client behaviors, journeys, segmentation, audiences, channel usage, servicing interactions, acquisition, retention, or relationship deepening.Working knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, experimental design, time-series analysis, cohort analysis, and measurement approaches.Advanced degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, or another related field.

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics - Open Finance

Overview

The Strategic Customer Analytics - Open Finance team serves as a trusted analytics partner to Mastercard's Open Finance clients, helping customers understand performance, identify growth opportunities, and maximize value from Mastercard's data and connectivity solutions. The Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics will play a critical role in transforming complex datasets into actionable insights that drive business decisions for both internal and external stakeholders.

This role combines advanced analytics, data storytelling, client consulting, and cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and executive leadership teams to develop performance reporting, investigate trends, uncover opportunities, and communicate findings through compelling analyses and presentations.

The ideal candidate is highly comfortable working with large datasets, and capable of translating technical concepts into clear business recommendations. They will have opportunities to influence strategic initiatives, support key client relationships, and help shape the future of analytics within Mastercard's Open Finance organization. Job Description:

The Analytics, Modeling & Insights (AMI) organization is on a mission to deliver significant value, create lasting impact, and influence the future of the Enterprise through trusted, objective insights, thoughtful experimentation, and next-level innovation. Our vision is to power responsible growth with insight, foresight, and clarity by demonstrating the principles that shape how we work:

Objective: Maintain an unbiased lens to inform sound decisions grounded in data.Innovative: Embrace emerging technologies and methods to continuously amplify our capabilities.Strategic: Apply enterprise-wide data and deep expertise to anticipate needs and guide sustainable decisions.Collaborative: Partner across disciplines to deliver insights aligned with stakeholder needs.Effective Storytelling: Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives that drive action.Efficient: Optimize tools and processes for timely, consistent, and scalable impact.

AMI is looking for an intellectually curious, business-minded analyst who wants to turn complex data into insights that shape what comes next. As part of the Channel and Consumer Client Insights team, you will apply quantitative analysis to deepen understanding of consumer clients, their behaviors, journeys, and interactions across channels. Your work may span client segmentation and profiling, audience development, advanced behavioral analytics, and insights from financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences. You will uncover meaningful patterns and translate them into strategies that improve client experiences and business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and human behavior. You will tackle high-visibility questions, explore complex and varied data, and create clear recommendations for leaders across the organization. The strongest candidates will pair hands-on analytical skill with curiosity, creativity, and a talent for making complex findings meaningful.

Responsibilities

In this role, the analyst will translate complex client and channel data into meaningful insights, owning quantitative work from business question through actionable recommendation. Responsibilities may include:

Required Skills

Demonstrated experience as an innovative thinker, self-starter, and creative problem solver who is intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.Experience performing quantitative analysis using large, complex, or multi-source data sets.Technical and analytical aptitude to perform data analysis, trending, segmentation, behavioral analysis, and other statistical techniques.Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical programming language or statistical tool, such as Python, R, SAS, or an equivalent platform.Ability to structure ambiguous business questions, select an appropriate analytical approach, validate results, and develop practical recommendations.Crisp written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts and develop compelling presentations for varied audiences.Strong attention to detail, ability to manage competing priorities, and effectiveness working independently and across teams.Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, data science, computer science, engineering, business analytics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Desired Skills

Company Description

On The Stage (OTS) started in the arts—and we’ve never left. What began as a platform built for theatre makers has grown into the ticketing, marketing, and fundraising engine powering the full spectrum of live entertainment: from K-12 drama programs and community theatres to professional performing arts organizations, comedy clubs, music venues, multi-venue entertainment complexes, immersive experiences, and location-based entertainment.

Founded by Tony and Olivier Award-winning Broadway producer Hunter Arnold alongside Silicon Valley tech veterans, we were built from the inside out by people who came from the arts and understood what was missing. That origin shapes everything: the language we use, the problems we prioritize, and the conviction that every live entertainment producer—non-profit or commercial, a school drama teacher or a West End producer—deserves access to the same infrastructure that powers Broadway.

Today, OTS serves thousands of organizations across the US, non-profits and commercial producers alike. Our all-in-one platform delivers Broadway-caliber infrastructure: ticketing with mobile-first checkout, a native CRM, automated marketing, a full fundraising suite, in-checkout revenue accelerators, and real-time reporting—all sharing a single patron record. Whether the goal is filling seats, cultivating donors, or maximizing revenue per transaction, every feature serves one mission: helping live entertainment organizations endure, expand, and prosper.

We believe in power without complexity—intuitive enough for a solo educator to launch in minutes, sophisticated enough to power the most complex commercial productions. OTS is at a pivotal growth stage, and the marketing infrastructure we build today will directly shape how we reach and serve the next wave of performing arts and live entertainment organizations.

For more information, visit www.OnTheStage.com.

Job Description

About the Role

On The Stage is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Marketing Campaign Coordinator to execute integrated campaigns that generate demand, engage prospects, and contribute to pipeline growth.

This is a hands-on role for an early-career marketer who enjoys turning plans into polished, measurable campaigns. You will coordinate email and webinar programs, manage day-to-day campaign operations in HubSpot, collaborate with our paid digital advertising agency partner, support social distribution, and monitor performance across HubSpot and Salesforce.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management and communication skills with curiosity about marketing technology and data. You do not need to arrive as an expert in every system, but you should be comfortable learning new platforms, troubleshooting execution issues, and using performance data to improve your work.

What You'll Do

Email Campaign Execution

Build, test, schedule, and deploy prospect and customer email campaigns in HubSpot. Maintain campaign calendars and coordinate copy, creative, audience lists, segmentation, approvals, and launch dates. Create and maintain lists, workflows, forms, landing pages, and campaign records. Perform quality assurance across links, personalization, formatting, suppression logic, tracking, and mobile rendering before launch. Monitor deliverability, opens, clicks, conversions, and downstream lead and pipeline performance. Support segmented, lifecycle, sponsored, and re-engagement email programs. 

Webinar Campaigns

Coordinate webinar campaigns from initial setup through post-event follow-up. Build registration pages, forms, confirmation and reminder emails, attendee lists, and on-demand follow-up campaigns. Manage webinar logistics, including speaker coordination, rehearsals, recordings, and attendee reporting. Ensure registrant and attendee data flows accurately into HubSpot and Salesforce. Publish recordings and coordinate post-webinar email, social, and sales follow-up. 

Conferences and Trade Shows

Coordinate with associations and vendor partners to secure OTS presence at industry events. Manage logistics for attending, such as booth shipping, giveaways swag orders, and printed materials to ensure orderly arrival and sufficient quantities. Receive or generate attendee lists and facilitate pre- and post- show outreach to help secure meetings on site. Coordinate with Sales and Customer Success team members for list outreach, attendee engagement, pre-show prep and talking points, and travel logistics. Manage campaign monitoring and tracking in Hubspot and Salesforce to report on success. 

Paid Digital & Vendor Coordination

Serve as the day-to-day marketing contact for OTS's paid digital advertising partner. Coordinate campaign briefs, creative assets, audience inputs, landing pages, tracking requirements, approvals, and launch timelines. Review campaign pacing and performance with the vendor, surface questions or issues, and keep internal stakeholders informed. Assist with organic and paid social campaign execution across major social platforms. 

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards in HubSpot and Salesforce. Monitor HubSpot Salesforce data flow and escalate sync, segmentation, routing, or campaign member issues.Track campaign metrics such as engaged leads, demo requests, conversion rates, cost per lead, webinar registrations and attendance, sales opportunities, and marketing influenced pipeline. Monitor progress against campaign goals and flag risks, anomalies, or underperformance early. Prepare clear campaign recaps that explain what happened, what was learned, and what should change next time. Partner with Marketing, Sales, and GTM Operations to improve visibility from initial engagement through pipeline. 

Cross-Functional Campaign Coordination

Work closely with Marketing, Sales, GTM Operations, Customer Success, and external partners to keep campaigns moving. Manage multiple timelines, dependencies, and approvals without sacrificing quality. Organize campaign assets and maintain accurate records in OTS's project management and documentation systems. Proactively communicate status, blockers, decisions, and next steps. 

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field. 1–3 years of experience in marketing, campaign coordination, demand generation, marketing operations, or a related role. Experience executing email or integrated marketing campaigns. Familiarity with HubSpot or another marketing automation platform. Working knowledge of CRM concepts and the relationship between marketing activity, contacts, accounts, opportunities, and pipeline. Ability to build reports, interpret campaign performance, and communicate findings clearly. Strong project-management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and external vendors. A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems. 

Systems & Platform Familiarity

Marketing automation platforms (we use HubSpot Marketing Hub)CRM platforms (we use Salesforce)Webinar hosting platforms (we use Zoom Webinars)Social media platforms and publishing toolsGoogle suite of Docs, Slides, Sheets, and moreProject-management and documentation tools (we use Notion, Slack)

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience building emails, lists, forms, landing pages, workflows, campaigns, and reports, preferably in HubSpotExperience planning and coordinating webinars or virtual events. Experience running paid ad campaigns across various networks, or coordinating with an external marketing vendor. Familiarity with UTM parameters, conversion tracking, lead attribution, and campaign taxonomy. Experience in B2B SaaS or related technology companyExperience in or passion for live entertainment, theatre, performing arts, and education a huge plusBasic familiarity with Canva or similar creative tools. 

How You'll Succeed

Campaigns launch on time, accurately, and with thorough quality assurance. HubSpot is organized, dependable, and easy for the team to navigate and use. Webinar registrants and campaign responders receive timely, coordinated follow-up. Paid digital projects move smoothly between OTS and our agency partner. Marketing reporting is current and clearly connects activity to leads, opportunities, and pipeline. Stakeholders have confidence in campaign status, performance, and next steps. You continuously improve processes by documenting what works and addressing recurring execution issues. 

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
