rows.descriptionText:
The Role…

The Membership Strategy Manager is responsible for delivering Soho House’s global membership strategy across a set of key Houses, translating centrally designed frameworks into locally relevant plans that protect and grow membership revenue. Houses and areas of focus are assigned by the Global Membership Strategy Manager and Chief Membership Officer according to what the role’s base geography allows, and may change over time in line with business need.

Reporting to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global), the role takes agreed global strategy — across retention and engagement, intakes and applications, and new House openings — and leads its execution across its assigned Houses in partnership with the Regional Membership Director, House Membership teams and the Soho Support Member Success function.

The role is the strategic link between global strategy and local delivery. It applies global frameworks to the specific conditions of its assigned Houses, manages the data and performance cycle behind each initiative, and feeds on-the-ground insight, barriers and opportunities back into global planning.

The role is responsible for the delivery and success of membership strategy across its assigned Houses. Accountability for regional membership performance sits with the Regional Membership Director and their teams.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery of Global Strategy Across Assigned Houses

Take agreed global membership initiatives and objectives and lead their delivery across its assigned Houses, translating global frameworks into practical local plans with membership and operations teams.Prioritise and sequence global initiatives according to House-level risk, opportunity and operational capacity.Feed on-the-ground insight, local nuance and delivery barriers back into global strategy development.Act as the primary point of contact across its assigned Houses for global membership strategy, ensuring House teams understand what is being asked of them and why.

Retention & Engagement

Deliver its assigned Houses’ contribution to the global membership retention target.Localised: design and run toolboxes that reduce turnover among high-risk member groups across its assigned Houses, tracking and evolving these approaches as performance data emerges.Centralised: drive engagement against the globally defined attrition indicators, closing the gap between local execution and target.Data: manage pre- and post-initiative data for its assigned Houses, adjusting continually with local teams to protect the retention goal.Strengthen onboarding and first-three-year engagement across its assigned Houses, using behavioural insight to intervene at the highest-risk stages of membership.Partner with the Data Team and the Soho Support Member Success function so that proactive intervention is targeted where it delivers the greatest impact across its assigned Houses.

Intakes & Applications

Partner with local teams to track and deliver budgeted intakes for its assigned Houses, de-risking revenue shortfall from missed intake targets.Leverage seasonality and local cultural calendars to maximise application volumes.Execute acquisition strategies that deliver the required Every House mix across its assigned Houses.Run scenario-based local offers, adapting approaches proven elsewhere in the group.Identify emerging risk to intake or revenue early and escalate to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) with a recommended recovery plan.

New Openings & Hypercare

Apply the global opening framework to pre-opening acquisition and membership success planning for openings within its assigned Houses.Lead membership-side opening implementation and hypercare across its assigned Houses.Partner with pre-opening, marketing and House teams so that application, intake and early engagement targets are met at opening.Capture what worked and what did not at each opening and feed it back into the global opening playbook.

Data, Insight & Performance

Track and report performance across its assigned Houses, spanning onboarding, engagement, retention, renewals, applications and intakes.Translate House-level data into clear, commercially focused recommendations for both local teams and global strategy.Partner with the Data Team on member segmentation and predictive churn models, ensuring local nuance is reflected.Present regional performance and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Partnership & Cross-Functional Working

Partner with the Regional Membership Director, who holds accountability for regional membership performance, to ensure strategy is delivered effectively across its assigned Houses.Work with House Membership teams, Member Relations, Operations, Marketing, Communications and Digital to remove barriers to retention and acquisition across its assigned Houses.Provide clear prioritisation and targeting guidance so House teams can execute global initiatives consistently.Act as escalation point across its assigned Houses for retention performance, cohort risk and engagement challenges.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify and test improvements to member engagement, retention and acquisition across its assigned Houses.Measure effectiveness and hand successful approaches to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) for scaling across other regions.Champion a culture of continuous improvement within its assigned Houses’ membership teams.

Requirements/ Qualifications

Significant experience in membership strategy, retention, customer success, loyalty or lifecycle marketing within a membership, hospitality or premium customer environment.Proven experience delivering engagement and retention strategies that improve customer or member lifetime value.Experience delivering acquisition as well as retention — intake or sales targets, offer design and funnel management.Experience supporting new site, venue or market openings in a hospitality, retail or membership environment.Experience operating in a matrixed international business, delivering centrally designed strategy through local teams without direct authority over them.Strong analytical capability, with experience using CRM platforms (ideally Salesforce) and customer data to inform decisions.Experience working with behavioural insight, segmentation and predictive models to influence customer engagement.Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into commercially focused recommendations.Proven experience working across multiple business functions and influencing stakeholders at all levels.Strong presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.Highly organised, commercially minded and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.Knowledge of the assigned Houses’ membership landscape and cultural calendar.Confident using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work – e.g. building and interrogating performance reporting, structuring data analysis, and preparing decks and presentations for senior stakeholders.

Why work with us...

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.

Health Care + 401K: Full time employees are eligible for full benefits; Medical, Dental & Vision as well as Retirement fund with a 2% matchPaid Time Off: Full- Time Employees have sick day's + vacation daysCareer Development: Soho House can progress your career domestically or internationally as well as managerially or technicallySoho Impact: Empowering the Soho House Community to make positive change, through mentoring, apprenticeship, local outreach and sustainabilityLearning & Development: An extensive range of internally and externally run courses are available for all employees.Cookhouse & House Tonic: Celebrating our passion for food and drink. Check out our monthly calendars and get involved in trips, training's and events. Available to all.Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.Team Meal: Whilst on duty in our Houses & Restaurants you will be provided with a substantial meal free of charge.

In accordance with New York law, the salary range for this role if filled within New York is listed below. The range for the position in other geographies may vary based on market differences. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

Role Summary 

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients.  

All over the world, Pfizer colleagues work together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Our colleagues can grow and develop a career that offers both individual and company success; be part of an ownership culture that values diversity and where all colleagues are energized and engaged; and can impact the health and lives of millions of people. Pfizer, a global leader in the biopharmaceutical industry, is continuously seeking top talent who are inspired by our purpose to innovate to bring therapies to patients that significantly improve their lives.  

Pfizer has a deep heritage and leadership in cardiovascular disease, and we are committed to providing breakthroughs that change patients’ lives.  An integral part of Internal Medicine, the Cardiology (CARD) Team’s mission is to promote a breakthrough therapy for patients suffering from NVAF or VTE. 

The CARD Health & Science Professional (HSP) is responsible for increasing territory sales and relationship development with assigned customers and accounts by engaging in product promotion and determining the best strategies to manage their business.

A CARD HSP should possess customer, market, and business acumen, analytical skills, and strong product and disease state knowledge; demonstrate ability to drive sales, promotional and strategic business development and management skills, and in-depth customer engagement expertise both in-person and virtually; demonstrate outstanding communication and teamwork skills; be adept in the operation of digital and virtual tools; and be effective at working remotely in collaboration with cross-functional internal teams to address customer needs and compliantly deliver on Pfizer business objectives.

Overview

Position Summary

The Associate, Owned Media is a hands-on owned media role responsible for building, QA'ing, deploying, measuring, and optimizing customer-facing batch campaigns across email, SMS, and app push. This is a builder's role at its core — the majority of the work is in the platform, constructing campaigns, assembling content modules, configuring audience and personalization logic, and pressure-testing every element before it reaches a customer.

What differentiates this role is where that build effort is pointed: toward media optimization. Operating in a CDP-enabled environment that is actively introducing new technologies to support AI-driven content decisioning, the associate is responsible for making owned media placements work harder — ensuring the right content appears in the right position, for the right customer, at the right moment. Personalization here is practical and placement-driven: it is about content relevance and module-level sequencing within each send, not simply inserting a first name.

The role is focused exclusively on delivering personalized batch communications — including promotional, campaign-driven, and calendar-based email, SMS, and app push messages. It requires hands-on build experience, strong operational discipline, attention to detail, analytical thinking, campaign QA rigor, and the ability to connect customer data, audience logic, content placement, and channel execution to drive engagement, retention, spend per customer, and long-term value. High-quality execution is the foundation; optimization is the outcome.

Great brands reflect culture. The best ones help shape it. At Foot Locker, we’re rooted in sport, powered by style, and driven by the communities that move both. From Foot Locker and Kids Foot Locker to Champs Sports, WSS, and atmos, our brands sit at the intersection of sport, style, and self-expression.

As part of the DICK’S Sporting Goods family, you’re backed by the resources, reach, and career opportunities of a world-class sports company. That unleashes Foot Locker to keep pushing forward with the agility and edge that define the brand. We’re looking for great people who want to influence culture and the generation that is shaping what’s next.

Whether you’re building strategy, shaping innovations, or creating unforgettable customer moments, you’ll contribute to decisions and experiences that define our brands’ impact in the communities we serve.

Come change the game with us. Apply today!

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Batch Campaign Build & Execution

CDP, Audience & Segmentation Support

This position from time to time will play a support role in segmentation, supporting audience creation, segmentation, targeting, and validation with CRM strategy, analytics, CDP, and marketing technology stakeholders.Define, document, and QA audience logic across segments including acquisition, active, lapsing, lapsed, reactivated, loyalty/member, high-value, and behavior-based groups.Validate suppressions, exclusions, consent requirements, personalization rules, and targeting logic to ensure the right message — and the right content within that message — reaches the right customer through the right channel.


Campaign QA & Customer Experience

Own cross-channel QA including links, images, copy, subject lines, preheaders, SMS character limits, push copy, personalization, dynamic and AI-selected content, audience logic, tracking, rendering, send timing, quiet hours, and compliance language.Identify and resolve campaign risks — content inconsistencies, broken links, rendering issues, tracking gaps, targeting concerns, or approval needs — before deployment.Maintain high standards for accuracy, customer experience, and brand presentation across all owned media channels.


Personalization, Content Placement & AI Decisioning

Drive personalization through relevant content placement — determining which offers, products, categories, and creative modules appear for which audiences, and in what order, to maximize the value of every placement in a send.Build and maintain the dynamic content, rules, and variable logic that power personalized placements at scale, so that a single batch send delivers meaningfully different experiences across segments.Maintain operational understanding of how decisioning rules, content libraries, eligibility criteria, and fallback/default content behave, and QA AI-generated or AI-selected content for accuracy, brand alignment, and compliance before deployment.Document configurations, test cases, and execution standards for new tools, and help translate vendor and platform capabilities into repeatable operational processes.Partner with marketing technology, data, analytics, and vendor teams to troubleshoot issues, validate outputs, and improve decisioning performance over time.


Testing, Measurement & Optimization

Execute A/B and multivariate tests across batch campaigns and channels — including content placement, module ordering, offer relevance, and decisioning tests — covering setup, QA, monitoring, and documentation.Treat each send as media inventory to be optimized — analyzing placement-level and module-level performance to understand what content earns engagement, and applying those learnings to future builds.Partner with analytics and strategy teams to translate insights into future optimizations and close the feedback loop between planning, execution, and outcomes.


Compliance, Governance & Best Practices

Ensure campaigns follow legal, compliance, privacy, brand, and data protection guidelines across email, SMS, and push.Maintain working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, TCPA, SMS consent, opt-out handling, quiet hours, state-by-state requirements, and applicable privacy standards.Promote repeatable execution standards, process documentation, and scalable cross-channel operations.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate across Owned Media, Brand, eCommerce, CRM Strategy, Loyalty, Analytics, Creative, Marketing Technology, Mobile/App, Legal/Compliance, and vendor partners.Communicate clearly on campaign status, risks, QA findings, approval needs, and performance insights.Act as a bridge between strategy, data, technology, creative, and execution.


Qualifications

Qualifications

2-3 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, email, SMS/push marketing, campaign operations, or a related digital marketing role.Demonstrated hands-on build experience — personally constructing, QA'ing, and deploying campaigns at volume across one or more owned media channels.Familiarity with email/SMS/push platforms, CRM tools, CDPs, campaign management systems, and emerging AI/content decisioning technologies.Experience with segmentation, audience targeting, dynamic content, content placement and personalization logic, or AI-assisted content decisioning tools preferred.Understanding of owned media KPIs: delivered volume, open/click rate, conversion, revenue, engagement, opt-outs, and customer value metrics.Familiarity with A/B testing, campaign reporting, and translating results into recommendations.A media optimization mindset — the instinct to treat owned channels as inventory, to question why a placement underperformed, and to pair that curiosity with disciplined, error-free execution.Knowledge of compliance and privacy concepts: CAN-SPAM, TCPA, consent, suppressions, GDPR, and data handling best practices.Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, analytical mindset, and communication skills.Collaborative, curious, customer-focused, and comfortable in cross-functional environments.Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; retail, eCommerce, DTC, or omnichannel experience preferred.Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, or related field preferred.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

ABOUT THIS JOB This opening is for a 2027 start date.

We are seeking a versatile Associate, Digital Experience Designer to join the Martech & Digital Infrastructure team in the Wealth Management Marketing team, supporting both the Private Wealth Management (PWM) and Goldman Sachs Ayco (Ayco) businesses. This is a hybrid design and execution role, sitting at the intersection of UX design, webpage authoring, email design support, and conversion testing implementation where you’d be supporting the full digital experience lifecycle across PWM and Ayco.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable designing in Figma or a CMS as they are supporting the implementation of A/B test variants — a combination that makes them a high-impact contributor across the team.

OUR IMPACT

WEALTH MANAGEMENT

Across Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our direct-to-consumer business provides digital solutions that help customers save and invest. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data and design.

PWM

Goldman Sachs Private Wealth Management (PWM) specializes in creating comprehensive wealth management plans for ultra-high-net-worth individuals and families, as well as select institutions, including foundations and endowments. PWM Teams work one-on-one with clients to advise and deliver customized strategies drawn from our deep investment experience, diverse wealth management capabilities, and global reach. Our Private Wealth Advisors (PWAs) deliver an unparalleled investment platform inclusive of the full product and service offerings of Goldman Sachs and beyond, which may include tax and estate planning, philanthropic planning, and private banking and lending services. As client needs evolve, this close relationship allows the team to offer complementary services and new opportunities by leveraging the resources of Goldman Sachs and beyond.

Ayco

Goldman Sachs Ayco specializes in financial planning with a focus on optimizing the value of benefits and compensation offered by clients’ employers and wealth management for high-net-worth clients. We seek to help clients achieve more clarity around their financial picture; feel more confident they can use their money to live the life they want today, while they plan for tomorrow; and feel more in control. Our dedicated team of advisors and coaches, across approximately 110 offices throughout the U.S., build and implement financial plans with each client’s values, priorities, and beliefs at the center. We work with clients to help navigate across seven key financial planning disciplines and access Goldman Sachs’ 150+ years of financial experience. As our clients’ lives unfold, we help adjust their strategy, explain tradeoffs, and serve as a sounding board. Goldman Sachs Ayco seeks to help our clients minimize financial stress and maximize their return on life, today and tomorrow.

PWM Marketing & Martech

The PWM Martech & Digital Infrastructure team is the operational and analytical engine powering Wealth Management's digital ecosystem. We own and operate our enterprise digital platforms, spanning web experience, marketing automation, CRM, analytics and Email marketing and are responsible for every digital touchpoint from first prospect impression through the full user journey. We focus on building and optimizing digital experiences that engage ultra-high-net-worth prospects and clients across PWM and Ayco.

About The Role

The Associate, Digital Experience Designer is a core design and production execution role where supporting the design, authoring, and optimization of our website and email touchpoints spanning across UX design, component configuration, email design, and A/B test page implementation to ensure our digital touch points are polished, on-brand, and continuously improving.

You will work closely with stakeholders from across the team, designing and building experiences across web and email, and supporting the implementation of test variants.

Responsibilities

UX Design & Visual Experience

 Design wireframes, mockups, and page layouts for new web pages, landing pages, and site sections, translating brand direction and content briefs into intuitive, UHNW-appropriate digital experiences  Maintain and contribute to the design system and component library, ensuring visual consistency and brand compliance across all assets  Collaborate with copywriters, the content team, and marketing stakeholders to translate complex wealth management concepts into clear, accessible, and compelling digital experiences  Ensure all designs meet WCAG accessibility standards and Goldman Sachs brand guidelines  Design responsive layouts optimized across desktop, tablet, and mobile with a strong command of typography, visual hierarchy, and layout principles  Design and recommend component enhancements/limitations to stakeholders (Marketing, Product and Engineering) across CMS and Email marketing platforms  Translate design system and toolkits across platforms into implementation 

Web Authoring & Page Support

 Support daily web authoring operations in the CMS, configuring components, assembling page layouts, and publishing content across PWM and Ayco web properties  Assist the Web team with page updates, content changes, and quality assurance, ensuring accuracy, brand compliance, and accessibility standards before and after publish  Manage component configuration across the CMS, selecting, customizing, and troubleshooting existing components to meet page design and content requirements  Support multilingual web builds by configuring and publishing localized page variants in coordination with translation partners 

Email Design Support

 Support the design and production of email templates and one-off campaign emails by working within established brand guidelines to produce visually consistent, mobile-responsive email layouts  Collaborate with broader marketing and design team by providing design assets, layout guidance, and visual QA support for email builds  Assist with email rendering QA across major clients (Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, mobile) — flagging design or layout issues before deployment  Contribute to the email template library by designing new modular components that can be reused across campaigns and nurture journeys 

A/B Test Page Implementation & Design Support

 Support the implementation of A/B test variants in Adobe Target, designing and configuring the page layouts and components required to run experiments defined by the key stakeholders  Design test variant page layouts and components by translating test hypotheses into visually distinct, properly structured page experiences ready for QA and launch  Conduct pre-launch QA on test variants ensuring pages render correctly, components are configured accurately, and the experience matches the intended design before a test goes live  Partner with the cross-functional team on test readiness, flagging implementation issues and ensuring variant pages are built to spec 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operations

 Serve as a flexible design and production resource, supporting web design, authoring, email, and test implementation needs as priorities shift  Coordinate with marketing stakeholders to route page changes and design work through appropriate approval workflows before publishing  Partner with the Web team to hand off designs and escalate technical implementation needs that go beyond component configuration  Contribute to project tracking and backlog management, flagging capacity constraints and surfacing prioritization trade-offs 

Required

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 UX & Visual Design: Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent design and prototyping tools; demonstrated ability to produce wireframes, mockups, and responsive page layouts with a strong portfolio  Web CMS Experience: Hands-on experience authoring and publishing pages in an enterprise CMS — Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred; equivalent platforms considered  Email Design: Experience designing mobile-responsive email layouts and familiarity with email design best practices, rendering constraints, modular template systems (experience with Storyports and Litmus preferred)  A/B Test Implementation: Comfort configuring and building page variants in testing tools (Adobe Target, Optimizely, or equivalent) — executing the design build accurately and on time  Design Fundamentals: Strong command of typography, visual hierarchy, layout, color, accessibility standards (WCAG) and email deliverability best practices  Attention to Detail: Strong QA instincts, being able to catch rendering issues, broken components, copy errors, and accessibility gaps before they reach a live audience  Collaboration & Communication: Comfortable working across matrixed teams — content, engineering, compliance, analytics — with clear written and verbal communication  Design system governance: Maintaining and contributing to a shared component library at scale 

Preferred

 Experience working in a regulated or compliance-driven environment and comfort routing design work through approval workflows  Familiarity with HTML/CSS - not a development role, but front-end fundamentals help when configuring components and troubleshooting rendering issues  Exposure to web analytics or behavioral tools such as Adobe Analytics, Contentsquare, or equivalent with proven ability to connect design decisions to performance data  Experience supporting multilingual or international web builds 

Education

 Undergraduate degree preferred — Design, Interactive Media, Visual Communications, Marketing, or a related field 

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2023. All rights reserved.

Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Salary Range

The expected base salary for this New York, NY, United States-based position is $85000-$160000. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year-end.

Benefits

Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong overall employee experience. Security Officer (Part Time)

This is a part-time, first-shift position. Candidates must be available to work overnight hours, including weekends and holidays, based on business needs.*

Would you like to be part of a team that keeps the cast, crew, celebrity guests and co-workers at The Walt Disney Company safe and secure? Our Security Officers do it all, from working special events like Disney shows to regular perimeter checks of our buildings and offices. If you thrive in an environment where no two days are exactly alike, and where professionalism and precision are valued, apply today to join us!

As a Security Officer, you’d be part of a well-trained, cohesive team that provides 24/7 protection for co-workers and guests at our buildings and at special events. Your mission? To protect Disney property and safeguard our people!

Every day as a Security Officer is different! Depending on your shift, on any given day you might:

Greet visitors, check company IDs, and provide temporary IDs at building entrancesEvaluate and screen the audience line at live TV showsBe a security presence at movie premiers, live performances, events, or private partiesPatrol hallways and building perimeters to spot safety issues or irregularitiesFill out the logbook precisely and completelyAnswer questions asked by visitors and employees in a friendly, professional wayUse your know-how and training to diffuse a tense situationRespond to medical or fire incidents, and work directly with local first respondersAssist private security details brought by celebrities, sports stars, politicians and visiting dignitaries – even the President has been known to stop byControl messenger flow and package deliveryUtilize technology to report and document incidents and manage information flowPerform walk-through evaluation at off-site events

Here’s what you will need to be successful in the job:

1 year of corporate security, law enforcement or military experienceExcellent communication skills, including fluent written and spoken English, and strong command of basic English grammarAbility to make quick decisions using your training and common senseThe knack for talking to people in a friendly way that gets resultsA “team” orientation and willingness to collaboratePhysical ability to perform all aspects of the job and be outside in all weather; andFlexible workdays/hours (this is a “shift work” role) and ability to work some overtime

It would be a plus if you also have these skills:

Valid Security Guard license issued by your stateKnowledge of Microsoft Office SuiteExperience working under pressureAbility to take command and diplomatically control difficult situations

Education is important to us, here is what we are looking for:

High School Diploma or equivalent requiredAssociate degree or higher preferred

Some Of The Perks We Offer Include

Taking part in ongoing learning on subjects such as CPR, Imminent Threat Assessment and First Aid training.Attending a movie screening or television taping, enjoying the full array of benefits offered by The Walt Disney Company including paid time off, 401K participation, a retirement savings plan, discounts on a wide variety of offerings, medical/dental/vision insurance and educational reimbursement-just to name a few!

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Description

Job Description

Mount Sinai is one of the largest non-profit health systems in the U.S., with a strong reputation and Top 20 national ranking for both care quality and research/education. Our health system has ~40,000 employees working together to provide care for millions of patients each year. Mount Sinai Solutions (MSS) is a unique business unit within Mount Sinai dedicated to serving Commercially insured patients, whether through direct contracting with employers and unions, or via partnerships with companies that serve them. We currently serve over 450,000 patients in the New York area, via 35+ customers and 10+ partners, offering a wide range of products ranging from virtual navigation services to worksite health centers.

About

We are looking for talented professionals that are passionate about developing a true system of care that can create market-leading value for our customers, members, and patients and:

 Are comfortable “playing up” and “playing down” as needed to accomplish business objectives Work productively amidst ambiguity Thrive in fast-paced work environments Seek to improve the status quo

Responsibilities

We are looking for an Operations Associate to join our Team, focused on delivering great value and a best-in-class experience for our patients. In this role, support key stakeholders across Enterprise Business Development and Innovations by providing critical support functions to our customers, partnerships and growth initiatives, including closely collaborating with leaders across the Mount Sinai Health System.

Solution, Customer and Partnership Implementation

 Coordinate the implementation and onboarding of new products, customers, and partners, from planning through operational launch and stabilization. Support end-to-end integration and interoperability activities within the Mount Sinai ecosystem, helping ensure workflows, handoffs, and service expectations are clearly defined. Maintain project plans, workplans, timelines, risks, issues, decisions, and status updates; escalate barriers and support timely resolution. Partner with cross-functional teams to confirm operational readiness across areas such as access and scheduling, clinical operations, billing, finance, IT, analytics, marketing, and managed care. Develop and maintain implementation documentation, including process maps, standard operating procedures, training materials, readiness checklists, and transition plans.

Ongoing Operations & Improvement Support

 Support the day-to-day operations adjusting focus as team priorities and workload shift. Execute and monitor operational requirements associated with customer, service, and outcomes commitments. Coordinate revenue cycle activities, including claims processing, payment receipt, payment reconciliation, and payment distribution in partnership with Revenue Cycle and Finance. Triage and help resolve operational issues raised by customers, patients, partners, and internal teams; document root causes, owners, actions, and outcomes. Assess current-state workflows, identify gaps or inefficiencies, and help design future-state processes that improve reliability, scalability, and patient experience. Partner with Analytics, Finance, IT, and other teams to support accurate data collection, consistent definitions, and reliable performance reporting. Monitor key performance indicators and contractual requirements; identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for follow-up.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s Degree2 years of professional experience in a fast-paced work environment; experience in healthcare industry is a plusExpertise in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, etc.) Experience with electronic medical records, Epic (preferred)

Additional Skills And Qualities

Strong written and verbal communication skillsStrong analytical and trouble-shooting skillsSelf-motivated team playerHighly organized, structured, and detail-orientedBackground in program development and process improvement strongly preferred 

Employer Description

Strength through Unity and Inclusion

The Mount Sinai Health System is committed to fostering an environment where everyone can contribute to excellence. We share a common dedication to delivering outstanding patient care. When you join us, you become part of Mount Sinai’s unparalleled legacy of achievement, education, and innovation as we work together to transform healthcare. We encourage all team members to actively participate in creating a culture that ensures fair access to opportunities, promotes inclusive practices, and supports the success of every individual.

At Mount Sinai, our leaders are committed to fostering a workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We strive to create an environment where collaboration, fairness, and continuous learning drive positive change, improving the well-being of our staff, patients, and organization. Our leaders are expected to challenge outdated practices, promote a culture of respect, and work toward meaningful improvements that enhance patient care and workplace experiences. We are dedicated to building a supportive and welcoming environment where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and advance professionally. Explore this opportunity and be part of the next chapter in our history.

About The Mount Sinai Health System

Mount Sinai Health System is one of the largest academic medical systems in the New York metro area, with more than 48,000 employees working across eight hospitals, more than 400 outpatient practices, more than 300 labs, a school of nursing, and a leading school of medicine and graduate education. Mount Sinai advances health for all people, everywhere, by taking on the most complex health care challenges of our time — discovering and applying new scientific learning and knowledge; developing safer, more effective treatments; educating the next generation of medical leaders and innovators; and supporting local communities by delivering high-quality care to all who need it. Through the integration of its hospitals, labs, and schools, Mount Sinai offers comprehensive health care solutions from birth through geriatrics, leveraging innovative approaches such as artificial intelligence and informatics while keeping patients’ medical and emotional needs at the center of all treatment. The Health System includes more than 9,000 primary and specialty care physicians; 13 joint-venture outpatient surgery centers throughout the five boroughs of New York City, Westchester, Long Island, and Florida; and more than 30 affiliated community health centers. We are consistently ranked by U.S. News & World Report's Best Hospitals, receiving high "Honor Roll" status, and are highly ranked: No. 1 in Geriatrics, top 5 in Cardiology/Heart Surgery, and top 20 in Diabetes/Endocrinology, Gastroenterology/GI Surgery, Neurology/Neurosurgery, Orthopedics, Pulmonology/Lung Surgery, Rehabilitation, and Urology. New York Eye and Ear Infirmary of Mount Sinai is ranked No. 12 in Ophthalmology. U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Children’s Hospitals” ranks Mount Sinai Kravis Children's Hospital among the country’s best in several pediatric specialties. The Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai is ranked No. 11 nationwide in National Institutes of Health funding and in the 99th percentile in research dollars per investigator according to the Association of American Medical Colleges. Newsweek’s “The World’s Best Smart Hospitals” ranks The Mount Sinai Hospital as No. 1 in New York and in the top five globally, and Mount Sinai Morningside in the top 20 globally.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Mount Sinai Health System is an equal opportunity employer, complying with all applicable federal civil rights laws. We do not discriminate, exclude, or treat individuals differently based on race, color, national origin, age, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are deeply committed to fostering an environment where all faculty, staff, students, trainees, patients, visitors, and the communities we serve feel respected and supported. Our goal is to create a healthcare and learning institution that actively works to remove barriers, address challenges, and promote fairness in all aspects of our organization.

Compensation

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $72473 - $108709 Annually. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

The Analytics, Modeling & Insights (AMI) organization is on a mission to deliver significant value, create lasting impact, and influence the future of the Enterprise through trusted, objective insights, thoughtful experimentation, and next-level innovation. Our vision is to power responsible growth with insight, foresight, and clarity by demonstrating the principles that shape how we work:

Objective: Maintain an unbiased lens to inform sound decisions grounded in data.Innovative: Embrace emerging technologies and methods to continuously amplify our capabilities.Strategic: Apply enterprise-wide data and deep expertise to anticipate needs and guide sustainable decisions.Collaborative: Partner across disciplines to deliver insights aligned with stakeholder needs.Effective Storytelling: Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives that drive action.Efficient: Optimize tools and processes for timely, consistent, and scalable impact.

AMI is looking for an intellectually curious, business-minded analyst who wants to turn complex data into insights that shape what comes next. As part of the Channel and Consumer Client Insights team, you will apply quantitative analysis to deepen understanding of consumer clients, their behaviors, journeys, and interactions across channels. Your work may span client segmentation and profiling, audience development, advanced behavioral analytics, and insights from financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences. You will uncover meaningful patterns and translate them into strategies that improve client experiences and business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and human behavior. You will tackle high-visibility questions, explore complex and varied data, and create clear recommendations for leaders across the organization. The strongest candidates will pair hands-on analytical skill with curiosity, creativity, and a talent for making complex findings meaningful.

Responsibilities

In this role, the analyst will translate complex client and channel data into meaningful insights, owning quantitative work from business question through actionable recommendation. Responsibilities may include:

Developing Client and Channel Insights: Analyze client, household, transaction, and interaction data to identify patterns, needs, and opportunities that inform business strategy and improve client experiences.Understanding Behaviors and Journeys: Examine how clients engage over time and across touchpoints to deepen understanding of behaviors, journeys, relationships, and channel usage.Creating Segments and Audiences: Develop client profiles, segments, and actionable audiences that illuminate meaningful differences and support targeted business decisions.Applying Advanced Analytics: Use appropriate statistical, behavioral, and quantitative techniques to evaluate trends, relationships, cohorts, and performance.Assessing Channel Experiences: Generate insights across financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences to identify opportunities to simplify service and improve how clients engage.Advancing Analytic Methods: Improve approaches for organizing, classifying, and interpreting client and interaction data to increase the quality and usefulness of insights.Creating Reusable Analytics: Build reproducible data sets, code, methodologies, and documentation that can scale into reusable analytic assets and data products.Delivering Compelling Stories: Translate complex analysis into concise, executive-ready narratives, visualizations, and recommendations that drive action.Partnering Across the Enterprise: Work with business, strategy, data, technology, risk, and analytics partners to clarify objectives and deliver timely, decision-relevant work.Managing Work Responsibly: Lead assignments from intake through delivery while maintaining quality, documentation, and applicable data, privacy, risk, and analytic standards.

Required Skills

Demonstrated experience as an innovative thinker, self-starter, and creative problem solver who is intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.Experience performing quantitative analysis using large, complex, or multi-source data sets.Technical and analytical aptitude to perform data analysis, trending, segmentation, behavioral analysis, and other statistical techniques.Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical programming language or statistical tool, such as Python, R, SAS, or an equivalent platform.Ability to structure ambiguous business questions, select an appropriate analytical approach, validate results, and develop practical recommendations.Crisp written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts and develop compelling presentations for varied audiences.Strong attention to detail, ability to manage competing priorities, and effectiveness working independently and across teams.Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, data science, computer science, engineering, business analytics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Desired Skills

Experience in financial services, consumer banking, client insights, channel insights, marketing analytics, or strategy.Experience analyzing client behaviors, journeys, segmentation, audiences, channel usage, servicing interactions, acquisition, retention, or relationship deepening.Working knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, experimental design, time-series analysis, cohort analysis, and measurement approaches.Advanced degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, or another related field.

Shift:

1st shift (United States of America)

Hours Per Week: 

40

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics - Open Finance
rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics - Open Finance

Overview

The Strategic Customer Analytics - Open Finance team serves as a trusted analytics partner to Mastercard's Open Finance clients, helping customers understand performance, identify growth opportunities, and maximize value from Mastercard's data and connectivity solutions. The Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics will play a critical role in transforming complex datasets into actionable insights that drive business decisions for both internal and external stakeholders.

This role combines advanced analytics, data storytelling, client consulting, and cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and executive leadership teams to develop performance reporting, investigate trends, uncover opportunities, and communicate findings through compelling analyses and presentations.

The ideal candidate is highly comfortable working with large datasets, and capable of translating technical concepts into clear business recommendations. They will have opportunities to influence strategic initiatives, support key client relationships, and help shape the future of analytics within Mastercard's Open Finance organization. You will also collaborate closely with a globally distributed team across North America, India, Europe, South Africa, and South America, requiring strong communication skills and an ability to work effectively across time zones.

Role

 Analyze customer and platform performance data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business recommendations. Develop and deliver executive-level dashboards, scorecards, presentations, and business reviews for both internal stakeholders and external clients. Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Management teams to provide data-driven insights that support client growth and retention. Investigate performance changes, conversion trends, operational issues, and client inquiries through detailed root-cause analysis. Collaborate with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Product, and Engineering teams to improve reporting capabilities and analytical methodologies. Design and maintain scalable reporting solutions using enterprise analytics platforms and data visualization tools. Leverage automation, AI-enabled analytics, and modern reporting techniques to improve efficiency and enhance the quality of client insights. Identify opportunities to standardize reporting processes and establish analytics best practices across the organization. Support strategic initiatives by providing analytical expertise, forecasting, performance measurement, and business case development. Leverage modern data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, Tableau, and enterprise reporting tools. Partner with geographically distributed teammates and stakeholders across multiple regions to deliver consistent, high-quality analytics and reporting outcomes. Support client-facing engagements, including periodic travel for business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and performance discussions (15-20% in North America and occasionally internationally)


All About You

 Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related experience. Experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, strategy, or a related analytical role. Strong SQL and data analysis skills with experience working with large-scale datasets. Experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Exceptional analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present insights to executive audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience translating technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.


Nice-to-Have

 Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, open banking, open finance, or digital platforms. Knowledge of A/B testing, performance measurement, forecasting, or statistical analysis techniques. Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks. Experience working in client-facing analytics or consulting environments. Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve reporting and analytical workflows.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.THIS POSTING IS NOT FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, BUT MASTERCARD IS SEEKING RESUMES TO REVIEW IN THE FUTURE WHEN JOBS BECOME AVAILABLE.

Purchase, New York: $101,000 - $162,000 USD

O'Fallon, Missouri: $88,000 - $141,000 USD

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Applied AI

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The Commercial Bank Applied AI team is at the forefront of embedding Generative AI directly into core business processes. We specialize in building enterprise-grade architectures using advanced techniques such as Multi-Agent Systems, Advanced RAG, Context Engineering, Tool-Calling Frameworks etc. The ideal candidate is deeply passionate about the practical applications of Generative AI and brings hands-on experience in machine learning and AI, gained through either professional industry work or rigorous academic research.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, machine learning engineers, and product managers to deliver Generative AI solutions customers love. Leverage a broad stack of technologies—Python, PyTorch, LangChain, AWS, Spark, and Vector Databases—to build Multi-Agent systems and advanced RAG pipelines over vast volumes of numeric and textual data. Build Generative AI models and pipelines through all phases of development, from context engineering through fine-tuning, evaluation, validation, and deployment. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About The Role

As a member of the Growth Strategy team, you’ll drive Charlie Health’s national expansion by owning territory design, hiring strategy, and account assignment for our Outreach team, while also supporting planning needs across Community Engagement as part of the broader sales organization. This role is highly cross-functional, partnering closely with Outreach leadership and Talent Acquisition to determine where to hire, how many roles to open each month, and what types of Outreach reps are best suited for each market based on data and growth objectives.

You’ll also lead territory builds, support regional reshuffling, and work with the broader team to ensure accounts are assigned efficiently. As new roles become available, you’ll coordinate their release in a timely, strategic way to keep pace with company growth OKRs.

In addition to these responsibilities, you’ll support broader Growth Strategy initiatives related to market expansion, workforce planning, and operational efficiency across the Outreach organization. You’ll be given a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and we expect you to “think like an owner” in everything you do.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

Own territory mapping and book building for the Outreach team, ensuring rep coverage is structured thoughtfully and deployed effectivelyPartner with Outreach leadership and Talent Acquisition to support workforce planning decisions, including where to hire, when to open roles, and how to align coverage with growth prioritiesSupport account assignment, regional reshuffling, and rep coverage changes as the organization evolvesBuild and maintain analyses and planning tools related to TAM, hiring strategy, Community Engagement (inside sales) planning, capacity planning, and market expansionHelp improve territory mapping, workforce planning, and book-building processes through scalable operational enhancementsSupport execution of key Outreach workflow changes by partnering on rollout coordination, planning support, and process documentationConduct analyses of key business metrics and performance indicators to support data-driven decision-makingPrepare and present findings, recommendations, and updates to Growth Strategy leadership and stakeholders

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

The total target base compensation for this role will be between $75,000 and $100,000 per year at the commencement of employment. In addition to base compensation, this role offers a target performance-based bonus. The target total cash compensation range, including potential bonus, will be between $82,000 and $110,000 per year. Description

Design Strategy at Gensler is focused on enabling transformation. Our creative and collaborative approach, supported by data and intelligence, enables impactful change and evolution of our clients’ organization, culture, and environment.

Our practice in New York is growing and we are looking for a talented design strategist to focus on data-driven projects across our broad range of services including workplace strategy, real estate portfolio strategy, generating user insights, and performing behavior analytics. We’re focused on developing holistic real estate and design strategies for a wide range of influential organizations, such as major corporations, healthcare providers, cultural institutions, real estate developers, and universities. We are looking for early career applicants with an entrepreneurial spirit who are eager to learn how data and insights can empower our client relationships and evolve our practice.

Your Role 

As a Design Strategist, you will collaborate with teams working to develop and deliver meaningful insights through a blend of quantitative and qualitative strategies. You will learn how to leverage client data from a range of sources to evaluate current conditions and develop solutions that support our clients’ objectives. Your work will span a wide range of scales, from pilot projects that test new ideas to strategies rolled out across the globe. You’ll participate in research efforts, synthesize data and feedback, and develop innovative future state concepts and solutions.

What You Will Do

On projects, as a Design Strategist you’ll:

Collaborate closely with Strategy Leads and Directors on work sessions with internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders Assist in the planning and performing of user research and data collection activities Help develop analytical methodologies for solving business problems to make portfolio or enterprise-level decisionsAnalyze large scale qualitative and quantitative data sets to determine impact on business goals, organizational culture, or performance criteria for spatial design Support projects that explore data modeling and statistical analysis (e.g., clustering, regression) to uncover workplace patterns Assist in building automation tools to increase efficiency and scalability for clientsInterface with Gensler ‘s Design Technology team to orchestrate complex, multi-sourced data analysis and managementCollaborate on developing scenarios (with plans, data, feedback, relevant precedents, etc) to illustrate a range of relevant solutions, based on the research, that meet client objectives Support project findings through compelling presentations, reports, posters, videos, websites, etc.Interface with Gensler design studios to ensure the seamless transition of design strategy into design implementation

Your Qualifications

You’re passionate about the built environment and its impact on individuals and organizations. You are curious, analytical, and creative, eager to explore how data can uncover stories about how people work, connect, and use space. You

have experience with research methodologies and activities, and can with work with both qualitative and quantitative data are curious about how data connects to human behavior, culture, design, and spaceenjoy open-ended exploration, digging into data to uncover insights that were not obvious at firstare a clear communicator and presenter of ideas, findings and/or point of vieware an enthusiastic collaborator and are able to work successfully with a range of other disciplines who complement your experience are a critical and creative thinker, with a solution-oriented mindsetrespond proactively and thoughtfully to feedback from clients and colleagues can graphically visualize information and ideas, able to effectively use charts, and graphics to represent and communicate findings and complex ideas can draft strong narratives in support of graphical findings/insights

Your background and experience

0-2 years of relevant professional experience in data-driven research, strategy, or designBachelor’s or Master’s degree in architecture, interior design, environmental design, urban design, real estate, design strategy, organizational development, organizational psychology, or similar fields Coursework in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other quantitative fields is a plusProficiency in data analysis, visualization, and managementProficiency in Excel/Google SheetsProficiency with data modeling, clustering, or regression analysisProficiency in data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is a plusExperience working with Power Query or Google App ScriptExperience working with workplace performance data and survey data is a plusFamiliarity with Python (numpy/pandas/sklearn), R, or SQL is a plusFamiliarity in Adobe Creative Suite 

To be considered, please include 2-3 project examples that demonstrate your qualifications as described above and a cover letter as part of your submission. 

The base salary range will be estimated between $75,000 - $83,000 plus bonuses and benefits and contingent on relevant experience.

About Strategy At Gensler

Gensler’s Strategy Practice is focused on exploring and defining how space, technology, services, and policy can create great experiences and support an organizations’ best work. We use in-depth user research and data to explore and develop strategies that enable our clients to meet their business and organizational objectives. With our design teams here in New York and around the world, we conceptualize and implement creative solutions that support our client’s needs. In parallel, we help our clients manage change to ensure new ideas take root, and to build capability that sustains.

Life at Gensler

At Gensler, we are as committed to enjoying life as we are to delivering best-in-class design. From curated art exhibits to internal design competitions to “Well-being Awareness Week,” our offices reflect our people’s diverse interests.

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. Our comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability, wellness programs, flex spending, paid holidays, and paid time off. We also offer a 401k, profit sharing, employee stock ownership, and twice annual bonus opportunities. Our annual base salary range has been established based on local markets.

As part of the firm’s commitment to licensure and professional development, Gensler offers reimbursement for certain professional licenses and associated renewals and exam fees. In addition, we reimburse tuition for certain eligible programs or classes. We view our professional development programs as strategic investments in our future.

NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

About The Team

As the oldest and largest Line of Business at Capital One, US Card is the engine that powers our enterprise. Join the engine room of Capital One’s customer experience. We are seeking strategic, technically-minded Product Managers to lead mission-critical platforms that power billions of interactions. By applying to this role, you will be considered for critical initiatives across our core ecosystems. As a Senior Associate PdM, you will own the translation of grand business vision into flawless technical execution. Depending on the role, your day-to-day will include:

Platform & Data Modernization: Partner with Tech and Data Engineering to decommission legacy systems, refine next-gen data products, and build robust, foundational data capabilities. Strategic Roadmapping: Define the MVP, ruthlessly prioritize the post-migration backlog, and build airtight business cases for what your team should tackle next and why. Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the ultimate bridge between Business Analysts, Tech, Ops, Risk, and Design to deliver transformative customer outcomes. Risk & Controls Management: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement a modernized suite of preventative controls directly into our platform architecture. 

About The Roles

Here are just a couple of examples of our open Product Management roles:

Card Recoveries Platform: Help us deliver the next generation of the Recoveries platform that is the foundation of our $3 billion Recoveries business. Your work on this platform will help accelerate new product launches, increase recovery rates, and meaningfully change the trajectory of our customers’ path back to credit. Payments and Offers Capabilities: Our Customer Resiliency offer programs serve as the vital framework through which we empower customers to resolve outstanding balances, frequently by extending significant concessions to those facing the most acute financial pressures. With millions of individuals engaging with these programs annually, your work will directly impact a massive population, guiding them through periods of instability toward a future of sustainable credit health. Agent & Customer Assist Platform (AI & Servicing): Accelerate the evolution of our comprehensive, AI-leveraged source of truth for all Card servicing policies. You’ll build and scale the intelligent tooling that empowers agents and digital channels to assist millions of customers daily. Credit Bureau Disputes: Drive delivery for our Card Credit Bureau Disputes team, ensuring data integrity, compliance, and frictionless user experiences during critical financial moments. In this role you will lead the strategy and delivery, define overarching product priorities, align on definitions of success, and partner with others across the team to ruthlessly prioritize backlog and build airtight business cases for what your team should tackle next and why, and more.

Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challengesCommunicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

As an Analyst on the Paid Social and Programmatic team, you'll play an integral role in growing a channel that spends eight figures annually across Meta, TikTok, Reddit and Snapchat. You'll bring the inherent excitement and uniqueness of live events to fans in a way that has a direct impact on SeatGeek's overall user and revenue growth.

You'll use both sides of your brain. You'll develop growth marketing strategies alongside designers, data scientists and engineers, then prove the value of those strategies through rigorous, hypothesis-led measurement. This is a channel where we run real incrementality studies rather than taking platform-reported numbers at face value, so you'll be involved in building for, and measuring, success.

Marketing Administrator 

Mandarin Oriental New York is looking for a Marketing Administrator to join our Sales Department.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

A stunning fusion of modern design with stylish oriental flair, Mandarin Oriental, New York features 244 elegant guestrooms and suites — all with breath-taking views of Manhattan and Five-Star hospitality. Luxurious amenities include MO Lounge, all-day dining overlooking Central Park and the Manhattan skyline; a 14,500 square-foot Five-Star Mandarin Oriental Spa; and a state-of-the-art fitness center with a 75-foot lap pool. In addition, there is premium meeting and event space, including a 6,000 square-foot pillar-less ballroom with three walls of windows overlooking Central Park.
