rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

ABOUT THIS JOB This opening is for a 2027 start date.

We are seeking a versatile Associate, Digital Experience Designer to join the Martech & Digital Infrastructure team in the Wealth Management Marketing team, supporting both the Private Wealth Management (PWM) and Goldman Sachs Ayco (Ayco) businesses. This is a hybrid design and execution role, sitting at the intersection of UX design, webpage authoring, email design support, and conversion testing implementation where you’d be supporting the full digital experience lifecycle across PWM and Ayco.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable designing in Figma or a CMS as they are supporting the implementation of A/B test variants — a combination that makes them a high-impact contributor across the team.

OUR IMPACT

WEALTH MANAGEMENT

Across Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our direct-to-consumer business provides digital solutions that help customers save and invest. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data and design.

PWM

Goldman Sachs Private Wealth Management (PWM) specializes in creating comprehensive wealth management plans for ultra-high-net-worth individuals and families, as well as select institutions, including foundations and endowments. PWM Teams work one-on-one with clients to advise and deliver customized strategies drawn from our deep investment experience, diverse wealth management capabilities, and global reach. Our Private Wealth Advisors (PWAs) deliver an unparalleled investment platform inclusive of the full product and service offerings of Goldman Sachs and beyond, which may include tax and estate planning, philanthropic planning, and private banking and lending services. As client needs evolve, this close relationship allows the team to offer complementary services and new opportunities by leveraging the resources of Goldman Sachs and beyond.

Ayco

Goldman Sachs Ayco specializes in financial planning with a focus on optimizing the value of benefits and compensation offered by clients’ employers and wealth management for high-net-worth clients. We seek to help clients achieve more clarity around their financial picture; feel more confident they can use their money to live the life they want today, while they plan for tomorrow; and feel more in control. Our dedicated team of advisors and coaches, across approximately 110 offices throughout the U.S., build and implement financial plans with each client’s values, priorities, and beliefs at the center. We work with clients to help navigate across seven key financial planning disciplines and access Goldman Sachs’ 150+ years of financial experience. As our clients’ lives unfold, we help adjust their strategy, explain tradeoffs, and serve as a sounding board. Goldman Sachs Ayco seeks to help our clients minimize financial stress and maximize their return on life, today and tomorrow.

PWM Marketing & Martech

The PWM Martech & Digital Infrastructure team is the operational and analytical engine powering Wealth Management's digital ecosystem. We own and operate our enterprise digital platforms, spanning web experience, marketing automation, CRM, analytics and Email marketing and are responsible for every digital touchpoint from first prospect impression through the full user journey. We focus on building and optimizing digital experiences that engage ultra-high-net-worth prospects and clients across PWM and Ayco.

About The Role

The Associate, Digital Experience Designer is a core design and production execution role where supporting the design, authoring, and optimization of our website and email touchpoints spanning across UX design, component configuration, email design, and A/B test page implementation to ensure our digital touch points are polished, on-brand, and continuously improving.

You will work closely with stakeholders from across the team, designing and building experiences across web and email, and supporting the implementation of test variants.

Responsibilities

UX Design & Visual Experience

 Design wireframes, mockups, and page layouts for new web pages, landing pages, and site sections, translating brand direction and content briefs into intuitive, UHNW-appropriate digital experiences  Maintain and contribute to the design system and component library, ensuring visual consistency and brand compliance across all assets  Collaborate with copywriters, the content team, and marketing stakeholders to translate complex wealth management concepts into clear, accessible, and compelling digital experiences  Ensure all designs meet WCAG accessibility standards and Goldman Sachs brand guidelines  Design responsive layouts optimized across desktop, tablet, and mobile with a strong command of typography, visual hierarchy, and layout principles  Design and recommend component enhancements/limitations to stakeholders (Marketing, Product and Engineering) across CMS and Email marketing platforms  Translate design system and toolkits across platforms into implementation 

Web Authoring & Page Support

 Support daily web authoring operations in the CMS, configuring components, assembling page layouts, and publishing content across PWM and Ayco web properties  Assist the Web team with page updates, content changes, and quality assurance, ensuring accuracy, brand compliance, and accessibility standards before and after publish  Manage component configuration across the CMS, selecting, customizing, and troubleshooting existing components to meet page design and content requirements  Support multilingual web builds by configuring and publishing localized page variants in coordination with translation partners 

Email Design Support

 Support the design and production of email templates and one-off campaign emails by working within established brand guidelines to produce visually consistent, mobile-responsive email layouts  Collaborate with broader marketing and design team by providing design assets, layout guidance, and visual QA support for email builds  Assist with email rendering QA across major clients (Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, mobile) — flagging design or layout issues before deployment  Contribute to the email template library by designing new modular components that can be reused across campaigns and nurture journeys 

A/B Test Page Implementation & Design Support

 Support the implementation of A/B test variants in Adobe Target, designing and configuring the page layouts and components required to run experiments defined by the key stakeholders  Design test variant page layouts and components by translating test hypotheses into visually distinct, properly structured page experiences ready for QA and launch  Conduct pre-launch QA on test variants ensuring pages render correctly, components are configured accurately, and the experience matches the intended design before a test goes live  Partner with the cross-functional team on test readiness, flagging implementation issues and ensuring variant pages are built to spec 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operations

 Serve as a flexible design and production resource, supporting web design, authoring, email, and test implementation needs as priorities shift  Coordinate with marketing stakeholders to route page changes and design work through appropriate approval workflows before publishing  Partner with the Web team to hand off designs and escalate technical implementation needs that go beyond component configuration  Contribute to project tracking and backlog management, flagging capacity constraints and surfacing prioritization trade-offs 

Required

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 UX & Visual Design: Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent design and prototyping tools; demonstrated ability to produce wireframes, mockups, and responsive page layouts with a strong portfolio  Web CMS Experience: Hands-on experience authoring and publishing pages in an enterprise CMS — Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred; equivalent platforms considered  Email Design: Experience designing mobile-responsive email layouts and familiarity with email design best practices, rendering constraints, modular template systems (experience with Storyports and Litmus preferred)  A/B Test Implementation: Comfort configuring and building page variants in testing tools (Adobe Target, Optimizely, or equivalent) — executing the design build accurately and on time  Design Fundamentals: Strong command of typography, visual hierarchy, layout, color, accessibility standards (WCAG) and email deliverability best practices  Attention to Detail: Strong QA instincts, being able to catch rendering issues, broken components, copy errors, and accessibility gaps before they reach a live audience  Collaboration & Communication: Comfortable working across matrixed teams — content, engineering, compliance, analytics — with clear written and verbal communication  Design system governance: Maintaining and contributing to a shared component library at scale 

Preferred

 Experience working in a regulated or compliance-driven environment and comfort routing design work through approval workflows  Familiarity with HTML/CSS - not a development role, but front-end fundamentals help when configuring components and troubleshooting rendering issues  Exposure to web analytics or behavioral tools such as Adobe Analytics, Contentsquare, or equivalent with proven ability to connect design decisions to performance data  Experience supporting multilingual or international web builds 

Education

 Undergraduate degree preferred — Design, Interactive Media, Visual Communications, Marketing, or a related field 

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About The Role

As a member of the Growth Strategy team, you’ll drive Charlie Health’s national expansion by owning territory design, hiring strategy, and account assignment for our Outreach team, while also supporting planning needs across Community Engagement as part of the broader sales organization. This role is highly cross-functional, partnering closely with Outreach leadership and Talent Acquisition to determine where to hire, how many roles to open each month, and what types of Outreach reps are best suited for each market based on data and growth objectives.

You’ll also lead territory builds, support regional reshuffling, and work with the broader team to ensure accounts are assigned efficiently. As new roles become available, you’ll coordinate their release in a timely, strategic way to keep pace with company growth OKRs.

In addition to these responsibilities, you’ll support broader Growth Strategy initiatives related to market expansion, workforce planning, and operational efficiency across the Outreach organization. You’ll be given a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and we expect you to “think like an owner” in everything you do.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

Own territory mapping and book building for the Outreach team, ensuring rep coverage is structured thoughtfully and deployed effectivelyPartner with Outreach leadership and Talent Acquisition to support workforce planning decisions, including where to hire, when to open roles, and how to align coverage with growth prioritiesSupport account assignment, regional reshuffling, and rep coverage changes as the organization evolvesBuild and maintain analyses and planning tools related to TAM, hiring strategy, Community Engagement (inside sales) planning, capacity planning, and market expansionHelp improve territory mapping, workforce planning, and book-building processes through scalable operational enhancementsSupport execution of key Outreach workflow changes by partnering on rollout coordination, planning support, and process documentationConduct analyses of key business metrics and performance indicators to support data-driven decision-makingPrepare and present findings, recommendations, and updates to Growth Strategy leadership and stakeholders

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Product Specialist, Product Management, Global Consumer Credit Commercialization

Mastercard’s Global Consumer Credit team is responsible for developing and commercializing consumer credit products, value propositions, and related capabilities that help our partners drive portfolio growth, deepen cardholder engagement, and deliver differentiated consumer experiences. The team supports a broad set of global priorities for affluent and non-affluent consumer credit products, including key value propositions such as The Mastercard Collection, and focuses on sales enablement, customer engagement, market insights, and performance tracking.

Role

The Product Specialist will support the execution of global commercialization priorities for consumer credit products. This role will help to create sales enablement materials, support customer engagement efforts, identify actionable insights, assist with marketing strategies, and maintain reporting.

In This Role, You Will

Description

Design Strategy at Gensler is focused on enabling transformation. Our creative and collaborative approach, supported by data and intelligence, enables impactful change and evolution of our clients’ organization, culture, and environment.

Our practice in New York is growing and we are looking for a talented design strategist to focus on data-driven projects across our broad range of services including workplace strategy, real estate portfolio strategy, generating user insights, and performing behavior analytics. We’re focused on developing holistic real estate and design strategies for a wide range of influential organizations, such as major corporations, healthcare providers, cultural institutions, real estate developers, and universities. We are looking for early career applicants with an entrepreneurial spirit who are eager to learn how data and insights can empower our client relationships and evolve our practice.

Your Role 

As a Design Strategist, you will collaborate with teams working to develop and deliver meaningful insights through a blend of quantitative and qualitative strategies. You will learn how to leverage client data from a range of sources to evaluate current conditions and develop solutions that support our clients’ objectives. Your work will span a wide range of scales, from pilot projects that test new ideas to strategies rolled out across the globe. You’ll participate in research efforts, synthesize data and feedback, and develop innovative future state concepts and solutions.

What You Will Do

On projects, as a Design Strategist you’ll:

Collaborate closely with Strategy Leads and Directors on work sessions with internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders Assist in the planning and performing of user research and data collection activities Help develop analytical methodologies for solving business problems to make portfolio or enterprise-level decisionsAnalyze large scale qualitative and quantitative data sets to determine impact on business goals, organizational culture, or performance criteria for spatial design Support projects that explore data modeling and statistical analysis (e.g., clustering, regression) to uncover workplace patterns Assist in building automation tools to increase efficiency and scalability for clientsInterface with Gensler ‘s Design Technology team to orchestrate complex, multi-sourced data analysis and managementCollaborate on developing scenarios (with plans, data, feedback, relevant precedents, etc) to illustrate a range of relevant solutions, based on the research, that meet client objectives Support project findings through compelling presentations, reports, posters, videos, websites, etc.Interface with Gensler design studios to ensure the seamless transition of design strategy into design implementation

Your Qualifications

You’re passionate about the built environment and its impact on individuals and organizations. You are curious, analytical, and creative, eager to explore how data can uncover stories about how people work, connect, and use space. You

have experience with research methodologies and activities, and can with work with both qualitative and quantitative data are curious about how data connects to human behavior, culture, design, and spaceenjoy open-ended exploration, digging into data to uncover insights that were not obvious at firstare a clear communicator and presenter of ideas, findings and/or point of vieware an enthusiastic collaborator and are able to work successfully with a range of other disciplines who complement your experience are a critical and creative thinker, with a solution-oriented mindsetrespond proactively and thoughtfully to feedback from clients and colleagues can graphically visualize information and ideas, able to effectively use charts, and graphics to represent and communicate findings and complex ideas can draft strong narratives in support of graphical findings/insights

Your background and experience

0-2 years of relevant professional experience in data-driven research, strategy, or designBachelor’s or Master’s degree in architecture, interior design, environmental design, urban design, real estate, design strategy, organizational development, organizational psychology, or similar fields Coursework in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other quantitative fields is a plusProficiency in data analysis, visualization, and managementProficiency in Excel/Google SheetsProficiency with data modeling, clustering, or regression analysisProficiency in data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is a plusExperience working with Power Query or Google App ScriptExperience working with workplace performance data and survey data is a plusFamiliarity with Python (numpy/pandas/sklearn), R, or SQL is a plusFamiliarity in Adobe Creative Suite 

To be considered, please include 2-3 project examples that demonstrate your qualifications as described above and a cover letter as part of your submission. 

The base salary range will be estimated between $75,000 - $83,000 plus bonuses and benefits and contingent on relevant experience.

About Strategy At Gensler

Gensler’s Strategy Practice is focused on exploring and defining how space, technology, services, and policy can create great experiences and support an organizations’ best work. We use in-depth user research and data to explore and develop strategies that enable our clients to meet their business and organizational objectives. With our design teams here in New York and around the world, we conceptualize and implement creative solutions that support our client’s needs. In parallel, we help our clients manage change to ensure new ideas take root, and to build capability that sustains.

Life at Gensler

At Gensler, we are as committed to enjoying life as we are to delivering best-in-class design. From curated art exhibits to internal design competitions to “Well-being Awareness Week,” our offices reflect our people’s diverse interests.

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. Our comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability, wellness programs, flex spending, paid holidays, and paid time off. We also offer a 401k, profit sharing, employee stock ownership, and twice annual bonus opportunities. Our annual base salary range has been established based on local markets.

As part of the firm’s commitment to licensure and professional development, Gensler offers reimbursement for certain professional licenses and associated renewals and exam fees. In addition, we reimburse tuition for certain eligible programs or classes. We view our professional development programs as strategic investments in our future.

NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of choice. All aspects of employment decisions will be based on merit, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected under federal, state and local law.

Individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with federal, state and local law.

See also Know your rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal, right to work and E-verify program, as required by law.

Gensler endeavors to make gensler.com/careers accessible to all applicants. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us.

Regarding Gensler’s approach to recruiting new talent, we will never ask an applicant for sensitive or personal financial information during the recruitment process. We advise all applicants seeking employment with Gensler to review available information on recruitment fraud. Anyone who suspects that they have been contacted by someone falsely representing Gensler should email talentacquisition@gensler.com.

Our vision is to power responsible growth with insight, foresight, and clarity by demonstrating the principles that shape how we work:

Your work may span client segmentation and profiling, audience development, advanced behavioral analytics, and insights from financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences. You will uncover meaningful patterns and translate them into strategies that improve client experiences and business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and human behavior. You will tackle high-visibility questions, explore complex and varied data, and create clear recommendations for leaders across the organization. The strongest candidates will pair hands-on analytical skill with curiosity, creativity, and a talent for making complex findings meaningful.

Description

Design Strategy at Gensler is focused on enabling transformation. Our creative and collaborative approach, supported by data and intelligence, enables impactful change and evolution of our clients’ organization, culture, and environment.

Our practice in New York is growing and we are looking for a talented design strategist to focus on data-driven projects across our broad range of services including workplace strategy, real estate portfolio strategy, generating user insights, and performing behavior analytics. We’re focused on developing holistic real estate and design strategies for a wide range of influential organizations, such as major corporations, healthcare providers, cultural institutions, real estate developers, and universities. We are looking for early career applicants with an entrepreneurial spirit who are eager to learn how data and insights can empower our client relationships and evolve our practice.

Your Role 

As a Design Strategist, you will collaborate with teams working to develop and deliver meaningful insights through a blend of quantitative and qualitative strategies. You will learn how to leverage client data from a range of sources to evaluate current conditions and develop solutions that support our clients’ objectives. Your work will span a wide range of scales, from pilot projects that test new ideas to strategies rolled out across the globe. You’ll participate in research efforts, synthesize data and feedback, and develop innovative future state concepts and solutions.

What You Will Do

On projects, as a Design Strategist you’ll:

Collaborate closely with Strategy Leads and Directors on work sessions with internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders Assist in the planning and performing of user research and data collection activities Help develop analytical methodologies for solving business problems to make portfolio or enterprise-level decisionsAnalyze large scale qualitative and quantitative data sets to determine impact on business goals, organizational culture, or performance criteria for spatial design Support projects that explore data modeling and statistical analysis (e.g., clustering, regression) to uncover workplace patterns Assist in building automation tools to increase efficiency and scalability for clientsInterface with Gensler ‘s Design Technology team to orchestrate complex, multi-sourced data analysis and managementCollaborate on developing scenarios (with plans, data, feedback, relevant precedents, etc) to illustrate a range of relevant solutions, based on the research, that meet client objectives Support project findings through compelling presentations, reports, posters, videos, websites, etc.Interface with Gensler design studios to ensure the seamless transition of design strategy into design implementation

Your Qualifications

You’re passionate about the built environment and its impact on individuals and organizations. You are curious, analytical, and creative, eager to explore how data can uncover stories about how people work, connect, and use space. You

have experience with research methodologies and activities, and can with work with both qualitative and quantitative data are curious about how data connects to human behavior, culture, design, and spaceenjoy open-ended exploration, digging into data to uncover insights that were not obvious at firstare a clear communicator and presenter of ideas, findings and/or point of vieware an enthusiastic collaborator and are able to work successfully with a range of other disciplines who complement your experience are a critical and creative thinker, with a solution-oriented mindsetrespond proactively and thoughtfully to feedback from clients and colleagues can graphically visualize information and ideas, able to effectively use charts, and graphics to represent and communicate findings and complex ideas can draft strong narratives in support of graphical findings/insights

Your background and experience

0-2 years of relevant professional experience in data-driven research, strategy, or designBachelor’s or Master’s degree in architecture, interior design, environmental design, urban design, real estate, design strategy, organizational development, organizational psychology, or similar fields Coursework in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other quantitative fields is a plusProficiency in data analysis, visualization, and managementProficiency in Excel/Google SheetsProficiency with data modeling, clustering, or regression analysisProficiency in data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is a plusExperience working with Power Query or Google App ScriptExperience working with workplace performance data and survey data is a plusFamiliarity with Python (numpy/pandas/sklearn), R, or SQL is a plusFamiliarity in Adobe Creative Suite 

To be considered, please include 2-3 project examples that demonstrate your qualifications as described above and a cover letter as part of your submission. 

The base salary range will be estimated between $75,000 - $83,000 plus bonuses and benefits and contingent on relevant experience.

About Strategy At Gensler

Gensler’s Strategy Practice is focused on exploring and defining how space, technology, services, and policy can create great experiences and support an organizations’ best work. We use in-depth user research and data to explore and develop strategies that enable our clients to meet their business and organizational objectives. With our design teams here in New York and around the world, we conceptualize and implement creative solutions that support our client’s needs. In parallel, we help our clients manage change to ensure new ideas take root, and to build capability that sustains.

Life at Gensler

At Gensler, we are as committed to enjoying life as we are to delivering best-in-class design. From curated art exhibits to internal design competitions to “Well-being Awareness Week,” our offices reflect our people’s diverse interests.

We encourage every person at Gensler to lead a healthy and balanced life. Our comprehensive benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability, wellness programs, flex spending, paid holidays, and paid time off. We also offer a 401k, profit sharing, employee stock ownership, and twice annual bonus opportunities. Our annual base salary range has been established based on local markets.

As part of the firm’s commitment to licensure and professional development, Gensler offers reimbursement for certain professional licenses and associated renewals and exam fees. In addition, we reimburse tuition for certain eligible programs or classes. We view our professional development programs as strategic investments in our future.

NOTICE TO APPLICANTS

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of choice. All aspects of employment decisions will be based on merit, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected under federal, state and local law.

Individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with federal, state and local law.

Regarding Gensler’s approach to recruiting new talent, we will never ask an applicant for sensitive or personal financial information during the recruitment process. We advise all applicants seeking employment with Gensler to review available information on recruitment fraud. Anyone who suspects that they have been contacted by someone falsely representing Gensler should email talentacquisition@gensler.com.

Job Description:

The Analytics, Modeling & Insights (AMI) organization is on a mission to deliver significant value, create lasting impact, and influence the future of the Enterprise through trusted, objective insights, thoughtful experimentation, and next-level innovation. Our vision is to power responsible growth with insight, foresight, and clarity by demonstrating the principles that shape how we work:

AMI is looking for an intellectually curious, business-minded analyst who wants to turn complex data into insights that shape what comes next. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and human behavior. Job Role and Responsibility: Develop, implement, and maintain quantitative models and analytical frameworks to support valuation, risk measurement, and capital calculations for derivatives portfolios, including valuation adjustments (XVA) and counterparty credit risk. Perform quantitative analysis of financial instruments by applying mathematical, statistical, and financial theory to assess pricing, sensitivities, and risk exposures under various market conditions. Design and enhance analytical methodologies used in stress testing, scenario analysis, and regulatory capital exercises by incorporating market data, model assumptions, and portfolio characteristics. Collaborate with trading, risk management, and technology teams to translate business requirements into quantitative solutions and to ensure consistent implementation of models in production systems. Conduct peer reviews and model impact assessments by evaluating quantitative changes, documenting rationale, and supporting internal governance and control processes. Maintain comprehensive model and process documentation to support transparency, auditability, and regulatory review, ensuring alignment with internal model risk management standards. Telecommuting is permitted up to 2 days a week. Position must appear in person to the location listed as the work address.  Strong foundation in quantitative finance, statistics, probability theory, and linear algebra, with demonstrated application to securities pricing, risk modeling, and portfolio analytics. Extensive hands-on programming experience in C++ and Python for the development of performance sensitive quantitative models. In depth knowledge of financial markets and instruments, including equities, fixed income securities, derivatives (options, futures, swaps), and structured products. Demonstrated experience in quantitative modeling for financial markets, including the development, implementation, and validation of pricing models (e.g., Black Scholes, binomial tree methods, Monte Carlo simulation) and risk measurement frameworks. Experience applying time series analysis, regression techniques, and statistical inference to complex market data. Proficiency in SQL and relational database systems for extracting, manipulating, and analyzing large scale financial datasets. Ability to translate quantitative analyses into clear, actionable insights for trading, risk management, and senior stakeholders. rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics - Open Finance

Overview

The Strategic Customer Analytics - Open Finance team serves as a trusted analytics partner to Mastercard's Open Finance clients, helping customers understand performance, identify growth opportunities, and maximize value from Mastercard's data and connectivity solutions. The Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics will play a critical role in transforming complex datasets into actionable insights that drive business decisions for both internal and external stakeholders.

This role combines advanced analytics, data storytelling, client consulting, and cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and executive leadership teams to develop performance reporting, investigate trends, uncover opportunities, and communicate findings through compelling analyses and presentations.

The ideal candidate is highly comfortable working with large datasets, and capable of translating technical concepts into clear business recommendations. They will have opportunities to influence strategic initiatives, support key client relationships, and help shape the future of analytics within Mastercard's Open Finance organization. You will also collaborate closely with a globally distributed team across North America, India, Europe, South Africa, and South America, requiring strong communication skills and an ability to work effectively across time zones.

Role

 Analyze customer and platform performance data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business recommendations. Develop and deliver executive-level dashboards, scorecards, presentations, and business reviews for both internal stakeholders and external clients. Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Management teams to provide data-driven insights that support client growth and retention. Investigate performance changes, conversion trends, operational issues, and client inquiries through detailed root-cause analysis. Collaborate with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Product, and Engineering teams to improve reporting capabilities and analytical methodologies. Design and maintain scalable reporting solutions using enterprise analytics platforms and data visualization tools. Leverage automation, AI-enabled analytics, and modern reporting techniques to improve efficiency and enhance the quality of client insights. Identify opportunities to standardize reporting processes and establish analytics best practices across the organization. Support strategic initiatives by providing analytical expertise, forecasting, performance measurement, and business case development. Leverage modern data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, Tableau, and enterprise reporting tools. Partner with geographically distributed teammates and stakeholders across multiple regions to deliver consistent, high-quality analytics and reporting outcomes. Support client-facing engagements, including periodic travel for business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and performance discussions (15-20% in North America and occasionally internationally)


All About You

 Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related experience. Experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, strategy, or a related analytical role. Strong SQL and data analysis skills with experience working with large-scale datasets. Experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Exceptional analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present insights to executive audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience translating technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.


Nice-to-Have

 Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, open banking, open finance, or digital platforms. Knowledge of A/B testing, performance measurement, forecasting, or statistical analysis techniques. Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks. Experience working in client-facing analytics or consulting environments. Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve reporting and analytical workflows.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.THIS POSTING IS NOT FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, BUT MASTERCARD IS SEEKING RESUMES TO REVIEW IN THE FUTURE WHEN JOBS BECOME AVAILABLE.

Duties

Summary

This position is being filled under a stream-lined hiring authority, Title 21 of the United States Code (21 US Code 379d-3a) as amended by the 21st Century Cures Act of 2016, section 3072 and the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2023, Section 3624. Requirements

Qualifications

In order to qualify for the Investigator I position which falls under the 0696 occupational Series, you must meet the following requirements by 11:59 pm EST on 10/01/2026: Basic Qualification Requirements: This Investigator job family covers professional positions that conduct inspections in FDA regulated industries and prepare and submit reports accompanied by supporting evidence documenting violations of the FD&C Act and other laws, regulations, and requirements administered by FDA. The position investigates and/or inspects FDA-regulated industry globally and evaluates compliance with U.S. laws and regulations in order to promote a culture of safety and quality with the objective of preventing unsafe, ineffective and/or defective products from becoming available to patients and consumers or used in clinical trials while facilitating appropriate development of novel products. FDA's enforcement of the laws and regulations protects patients and consumers from products that are impure, unsafe, ineffective, improperly or deceptively labeled or packaged, or in some other way dangerous or defective. Investigators routinely examine products; collect samples; conduct inspections of establishments that design, make, process, hold, or distribute FDA-regulated products; and otherwise gather information and evidence to document objectionable conditions and assess compliance with U.S. law and regulations. Investigators apply critical thinking to evaluate manufacturing processes, design practices, facility and material controls, supply chains, quality management systems, laboratory analyses, and clinical investigation programs to assess compliance with U.S. laws and regulations and to support advancements and innovations. Investigators continuously maintain required certification and credentials; provide internal and external stakeholder outreach, assistance, and education; and may mentor less experienced personnel. These positions require knowledge of various scientific fields such as biochemistry, biology, biotechnology, chemistry, data science, digital health, engineering, epidemiology, food engineering, food processing technologies, food safety, healthcare, medical technology, microbiology, nutrition, pharmaceutical science, pharmacology, public health, quality assurance, and quality management. Job Description:

The Analytics, Modeling & Insights (AMI) organization is on a mission to deliver significant value, create lasting impact, and influence the future of the Enterprise through trusted, objective insights, thoughtful experimentation, and next-level innovation. Our vision is to power responsible growth with insight, foresight, and clarity by demonstrating the principles that shape how we work:

Objective: Maintain an unbiased lens to inform sound decisions grounded in data.Innovative: Embrace emerging technologies and methods to continuously amplify our capabilities.Strategic: Apply enterprise-wide data and deep expertise to anticipate needs and guide sustainable decisions.Collaborative: Partner across disciplines to deliver insights aligned with stakeholder needs.Effective Storytelling: Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives that drive action.Efficient: Optimize tools and processes for timely, consistent, and scalable impact.

AMI is looking for an intellectually curious, business-minded analyst who wants to turn complex data into insights that shape what comes next. As part of the Channel and Consumer Client Insights team, you will apply quantitative analysis to deepen understanding of consumer clients, their behaviors, journeys, and interactions across channels. Your work may span client segmentation and profiling, audience development, advanced behavioral analytics, and insights from financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences. You will uncover meaningful patterns and translate them into strategies that improve client experiences and business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and human behavior. You will tackle high-visibility questions, explore complex and varied data, and create clear recommendations for leaders across the organization. The strongest candidates will pair hands-on analytical skill with curiosity, creativity, and a talent for making complex findings meaningful.

Responsibilities

In this role, the analyst will translate complex client and channel data into meaningful insights, owning quantitative work from business question through actionable recommendation. Responsibilities may include:

Developing Client and Channel Insights: Analyze client, household, transaction, and interaction data to identify patterns, needs, and opportunities that inform business strategy and improve client experiences.Understanding Behaviors and Journeys: Examine how clients engage over time and across touchpoints to deepen understanding of behaviors, journeys, relationships, and channel usage.Creating Segments and Audiences: Develop client profiles, segments, and actionable audiences that illuminate meaningful differences and support targeted business decisions.Applying Advanced Analytics: Use appropriate statistical, behavioral, and quantitative techniques to evaluate trends, relationships, cohorts, and performance.Assessing Channel Experiences: Generate insights across financial centers, ATMs, contact centers, IVR, chat, and digital experiences to identify opportunities to simplify service and improve how clients engage.Advancing Analytic Methods: Improve approaches for organizing, classifying, and interpreting client and interaction data to increase the quality and usefulness of insights.Creating Reusable Analytics: Build reproducible data sets, code, methodologies, and documentation that can scale into reusable analytic assets and data products.Delivering Compelling Stories: Translate complex analysis into concise, executive-ready narratives, visualizations, and recommendations that drive action.Partnering Across the Enterprise: Work with business, strategy, data, technology, risk, and analytics partners to clarify objectives and deliver timely, decision-relevant work.Managing Work Responsibly: Lead assignments from intake through delivery while maintaining quality, documentation, and applicable data, privacy, risk, and analytic standards.

Required Skills

Demonstrated experience as an innovative thinker, self-starter, and creative problem solver who is intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.Experience performing quantitative analysis using large, complex, or multi-source data sets.Technical and analytical aptitude to perform data analysis, trending, segmentation, behavioral analysis, and other statistical techniques.Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical programming language or statistical tool, such as Python, R, SAS, or an equivalent platform.Ability to structure ambiguous business questions, select an appropriate analytical approach, validate results, and develop practical recommendations.Crisp written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex concepts and develop compelling presentations for varied audiences.Strong attention to detail, ability to manage competing priorities, and effectiveness working independently and across teams.Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, data science, computer science, engineering, business analytics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Desired Skills

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics - Open Finance

Overview

The Strategic Customer Analytics - Open Finance team serves as a trusted analytics partner to Mastercard's Open Finance clients, helping customers understand performance, identify growth opportunities, and maximize value from Mastercard's data and connectivity solutions. The Senior Analyst, Analytics & Metrics will play a critical role in transforming complex datasets into actionable insights that drive business decisions for both internal and external stakeholders.

This role combines advanced analytics, data storytelling, client consulting, and cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and executive leadership teams to develop performance reporting, investigate trends, uncover opportunities, and communicate findings through compelling analyses and presentations.

The ideal candidate is highly comfortable working with large datasets, and capable of translating technical concepts into clear business recommendations. They will have opportunities to influence strategic initiatives, support key client relationships, and help shape the future of analytics within Mastercard's Open Finance organization. You will also collaborate closely with a globally distributed team across North America, India, Europe, South Africa, and South America, requiring strong communication skills and an ability to work effectively across time zones.

Role

 Analyze customer and platform performance data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business recommendations. Develop and deliver executive-level dashboards, scorecards, presentations, and business reviews for both internal stakeholders and external clients. Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Management teams to provide data-driven insights that support client growth and retention. Investigate performance changes, conversion trends, operational issues, and client inquiries through detailed root-cause analysis. Collaborate with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Product, and Engineering teams to improve reporting capabilities and analytical methodologies. Design and maintain scalable reporting solutions using enterprise analytics platforms and data visualization tools. Leverage automation, AI-enabled analytics, and modern reporting techniques to improve efficiency and enhance the quality of client insights. Identify opportunities to standardize reporting processes and establish analytics best practices across the organization. Support strategic initiatives by providing analytical expertise, forecasting, performance measurement, and business case development. Leverage modern data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, Tableau, and enterprise reporting tools. Partner with geographically distributed teammates and stakeholders across multiple regions to deliver consistent, high-quality analytics and reporting outcomes. Support client-facing engagements, including periodic travel for business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and performance discussions (15-20% in North America and occasionally internationally)


All About You

 Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related experience. Experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, strategy, or a related analytical role. Strong SQL and data analysis skills with experience working with large-scale datasets. Experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Exceptional analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present insights to executive audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience translating technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.


Nice-to-Have

 Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, open banking, open finance, or digital platforms. Knowledge of A/B testing, performance measurement, forecasting, or statistical analysis techniques. Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks. Experience working in client-facing analytics or consulting environments. Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve reporting and analytical workflows.

You will learn how to leverage client data from a range of sources to evaluate current conditions and develop solutions that support our clients’ objectives. Your work will span a wide range of scales, from pilot projects that test new ideas to strategies rolled out across the globe. Gensler’s Strategy Practice is focused on exploring and defining how space, technology, services, and policy can create great experiences and support an organizations’ best work. About The Mount Sinai Health System

Mount Sinai Health System is one of the largest academic medical systems in the New York metro area, with more than 48,000 employees working across eight hospitals, more than 400 outpatient practices, more than 300 labs, a school of nursing, and a leading school of medicine and graduate education. Job Description

Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

The Communications and Advocacy Section provides support to the successful implementation of UN Women’s strategic objectives to strengthen the capacity of UN Women to lead on women’s rights, empowerment and gender equality and to be the partner of choice to close the gender gap. In a time where we are facing increased pushback and a shifting funding landscape, strengthening UN Women’s brand visibility and coherence, and demonstrating our impact and value add, are two critical priorities that shall direct the work of the Digital Design and Branding Consultant.

Reporting to the Multimedia Specialist, the Communications Analyst (Video Editor) is responsible for assisting in the planning and implementation of the office communications and advocacy strategies to increase the standing and awareness of UN Women with partners, the media and the public.

Scope of Work:

 Develop and coordinate content creation Develop, script, film, and edit engaging content for digital platforms (social media, campaigns, websites, internal communications). Ensure consistency in tone, style, and brand guidelines. Collaborate with global colleagues, and in HQ with editorial and social media teams to align content with strategic goals. Produce a variety of video visually compelling formats including short-form social videos, explainer video, video message of the executive director, Work and guide external producers for motion and animation videos, and review the results Guide and work with social content creators, and review the results Coordinate Global Video Footage Oversight Collect, review, and categorize footage from global teams, agencies, and productions. Maintain quality standards across all submitted video materials. Coordinate with regional teams to identify content needs and ensure footage availability. Ensure proper permissions, usage rights, and brand compliance for all footage. Guide regional and country teams for in video field missions Maintain Video DAMS (Digital Asset Management System) Support the DAMS manager with the video library/DAM side, ensuring files are correctly tagged, organized, and searchable. Oversee metadata accuracy, naming conventions, and taxonomy to guarantee easy retrieval across regions. Train global teams on DAM workflows and best practices for uploading, tagging, and retrieving assets. Monitor asset lifecycle, archive legacy content, and ensure storage and version control are maintained. Work with IT/DAM manager and vendor to troubleshoot issues and optimize system performance.


The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.

Competencies:

Core Values:

Integrity;Professionalism;Respect for Diversity.


Core Competencies:

Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;Accountability;Creative Problem Solving;Effective Communication;Inclusive Collaboration;Stakeholder Engagement;Leading by Example.


Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

Organized, responsible, flexible, and able to prioritize and balance assignments.Committed to continuous improvement.Able to learn new tools and digital trends.Detail oriented.


Minimum Qualifications

 Master’s degree (or equivalent) in communications, public relations, journalism or relevant field is required. A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.

 At least 2 years of progressively responsible work experience in visual communications and storytelling is required. Experience working with creative teams and developing visual concepts is required. Fluency with Adobe Creative Suite, including Adobe Photoshop, Premier Pro, After Effects and Illustrator, is required. Knowledge of typography, color and sound correction /production is required. Knowledge and experience in gender themes is desirable. International experience is desirable.

 Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of another official UN language is desirable (French, Arabic, Chinese, Russian or Spanish).

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

company.name: Research Foundation of The City University of New York

rows.descriptionText:
Thank you for considering a career with the Research Foundation of The City University of New York (RFCUNY).

The team at RFCUNY is made up of dedicated, talented professionals committed to providing the services that allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries.

We are pleased that you are interested in exploring opportunities to join RFCUNY.

Primary Location:

NYC COLLEGE OF TECHNOLOGY

Bargaining Unit

Yes

General Description

New York City College of Technology (City Tech), a senior college of the City University of New York (CUNY), is a comprehensive public institution located in downtown Brooklyn. City Tech serves a diverse student body through career-focused associate and bachelor’s degree programs in science, technology, health, and other applied fields. The Physics Department supports undergraduate education and active research in quantum and condensed-matter physics, high-energy physics, geophysics, astrophysics, laser physics, and machine learning.

City Tech invites applications for a full-time Research Associate (Postdoctoral Fellow) to conduct grant-supported experimental research on light–matter interactions for quantum-information and quantum-communication applications. The successful candidate will develop and optically characterize advanced materials and devices, with emphasis on transition-metal dichalcogenides monolayers and heterostructures, and their interactions with single photons. The postdoctoral fellow will work collaboratively with the research team to advance new quantum-photonic technologies and disseminate findings through peer-reviewed publications and scientific presentations.

The position will begin on September 1, 2026, and is an in-person full-time appointment for up to one year. Renewal or extension is contingent upon funding availability, satisfactory performance, and alignment of the candidate’s research interests with those of City Tech.

Minimum Qualifications

Doctoral Degree in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field, with demonstrated research ability.

Other Qualifications

A preferred candidate should have:

Demonstrated experience in experimental research on low-dimensional or quantum materials, including two-dimensional materialsExperience with nanofabrication, microfabrication, device processing, or cleanroom-based fabrication methodsExperience with optical characterization techniques, such as photoluminescence, reflectance, Raman spectroscopy, absorption spectroscopy, microscopy, or time-resolved optical measurementsExperience designing, conducting, and troubleshooting optical experiments for materials or photonic devicesBackground in light-matter interactions, quantum optics, quantum photonics, single-photon measurements, or quantum-information scienceExperience integrating materials with optical or photonic devices and evaluating device performanceStrong quantitative data-analysis skills and proficiency with scientific data-analysis toolsA record of peer-reviewed publications or other scholarly research outputsAbility to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary research environmentStrong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to prepare scientific reports, manuscripts, and presentations

Responsibilities

In addition to the responsibilities listed under General Description the Postdoctoral Fellow will:

Conduct experimental research on transition-metal dichalcogenide and related quantum materials, with emphasis on light–matter interactions relevant to quantum-information and quantum-communication technologies.Design, fabricate, and/or integrate material systems and optical or photonic devices, as appropriate to the research objectives.Develop and execute optical-characterization experiments, including spectroscopy, microscopy, and photon-based measurements, to evaluate material and device properties.Analyze, validate, and interpret experimental data; maintain accurate experimental records; and prepare technical reports on research progress and results.Contribute to research planning, experimental design, and development of new measurement capabilities.Collaborate with the principal investigator, students, and internal and external research partners on multidisciplinary research activities.Prepare and publish research findings in peer-reviewed journals and present results at conferences, seminars, and project meetings.Assist in mentoring undergraduate and graduate student researchers, as appropriate.Follow applicable laboratory safety, research-integrity, and ethical-conduct standards.Perform other related duties as assigned.

Pay Range

Minimum - Maximum: $65,000

RFCUNY Benefits

RFCUNY Employee Benefits and Accruals (link to https://www.rfcuny.org/RFWebsite)

About The Research Foundation

The Research Foundation of The City University of New York (RFCUNY) is a nonprofit educational corporation founded in 1963 to provide post-award fiscal and administrative support for CUNY’s research and sponsored programs. RFCUNY’s services allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries, on projects and programs that serve our local and global communities, proposing concrete solutions to society’s most pressing challenges.

RFCUNY serves as a fiscal agent and works closely with all the CUNY campus Grants Offices to perform the core functions of post-award financial management for CUNY research projects and sponsored programs. These functions include legal assessment and signing of agreements where RFCUNY is named as a fiscal agent; setting up award accounts; preparing sub-awards and assisting PIs in monitoring the work of the recipients of sub-awards; supporting project directors with hiring and managing research project and sponsored program staff; supporting the purchasing and paying for goods and services with grant and program funds; managing financial aspects of projects including accounts receivable, financial reporting, invoicing, budget monitoring, and cost compliance with uniform guidance; ensuring that sponsor financial requirements are met; monitoring compliance with applicable project and financial management rules and laws; supporting the management of independent and external audits and financial reviews; and providing data, information, management expertise, and other supports to CUNY’s research and sponsored programs.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The Research Foundation of the City University of New York is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/Americans with Disabilities Act/E-Verify Employer. It is the policy of the Research Foundation of CUNY to provide equal employment opportunities free of discrimination based on race, color, age, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth, national origin, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, domestic violence victim status, arrest record, criminal conviction history, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

and advancing equity. Four bureaus comprise the Division: Bureau of Maternal, Infant and Reproductive Health, Bureau of Early Intervention, Office of School Health, and Bureau of Administration. rows.title: Asset & Wealth Management, Marketing, Digital Experience Designer, Associate - New York - 2027

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

ABOUT THIS JOB This opening is for a 2027 start date.

We are seeking a versatile Associate, Digital Experience Designer to join the Martech & Digital Infrastructure team in the Wealth Management Marketing team, supporting both the Private Wealth Management (PWM) and Goldman Sachs Ayco (Ayco) businesses. This is a hybrid design and execution role, sitting at the intersection of UX design, webpage authoring, email design support, and conversion testing implementation where you’d be supporting the full digital experience lifecycle across PWM and Ayco.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable designing in Figma or a CMS as they are supporting the implementation of A/B test variants — a combination that makes them a high-impact contributor across the team.

OUR IMPACT

WEALTH MANAGEMENT

Across Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our direct-to-consumer business provides digital solutions that help customers save and invest. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data and design.

PWM

Goldman Sachs Private Wealth Management (PWM) specializes in creating comprehensive wealth management plans for ultra-high-net-worth individuals and families, as well as select institutions, including foundations and endowments. PWM Teams work one-on-one with clients to advise and deliver customized strategies drawn from our deep investment experience, diverse wealth management capabilities, and global reach. Our Private Wealth Advisors (PWAs) deliver an unparalleled investment platform inclusive of the full product and service offerings of Goldman Sachs and beyond, which may include tax and estate planning, philanthropic planning, and private banking and lending services. As client needs evolve, this close relationship allows the team to offer complementary services and new opportunities by leveraging the resources of Goldman Sachs and beyond.

Ayco

Goldman Sachs Ayco specializes in financial planning with a focus on optimizing the value of benefits and compensation offered by clients’ employers and wealth management for high-net-worth clients. We seek to help clients achieve more clarity around their financial picture; feel more confident they can use their money to live the life they want today, while they plan for tomorrow; and feel more in control. Our dedicated team of advisors and coaches, across approximately 110 offices throughout the U.S., build and implement financial plans with each client’s values, priorities, and beliefs at the center. We work with clients to help navigate across seven key financial planning disciplines and access Goldman Sachs’ 150+ years of financial experience. As our clients’ lives unfold, we help adjust their strategy, explain tradeoffs, and serve as a sounding board. Goldman Sachs Ayco seeks to help our clients minimize financial stress and maximize their return on life, today and tomorrow.

PWM Marketing & Martech

The PWM Martech & Digital Infrastructure team is the operational and analytical engine powering Wealth Management's digital ecosystem. We own and operate our enterprise digital platforms, spanning web experience, marketing automation, CRM, analytics and Email marketing and are responsible for every digital touchpoint from first prospect impression through the full user journey. We focus on building and optimizing digital experiences that engage ultra-high-net-worth prospects and clients across PWM and Ayco.

About The Role

The Associate, Digital Experience Designer is a core design and production execution role where supporting the design, authoring, and optimization of our website and email touchpoints spanning across UX design, component configuration, email design, and A/B test page implementation to ensure our digital touch points are polished, on-brand, and continuously improving.

You will work closely with stakeholders from across the team, designing and building experiences across web and email, and supporting the implementation of test variants.

Responsibilities

UX Design & Visual Experience

 Design wireframes, mockups, and page layouts for new web pages, landing pages, and site sections, translating brand direction and content briefs into intuitive, UHNW-appropriate digital experiences  Maintain and contribute to the design system and component library, ensuring visual consistency and brand compliance across all assets  Collaborate with copywriters, the content team, and marketing stakeholders to translate complex wealth management concepts into clear, accessible, and compelling digital experiences  Ensure all designs meet WCAG accessibility standards and Goldman Sachs brand guidelines  Design responsive layouts optimized across desktop, tablet, and mobile with a strong command of typography, visual hierarchy, and layout principles  Design and recommend component enhancements/limitations to stakeholders (Marketing, Product and Engineering) across CMS and Email marketing platforms  Translate design system and toolkits across platforms into implementation 

Web Authoring & Page Support

 Support daily web authoring operations in the CMS, configuring components, assembling page layouts, and publishing content across PWM and Ayco web properties  Assist the Web team with page updates, content changes, and quality assurance, ensuring accuracy, brand compliance, and accessibility standards before and after publish  Manage component configuration across the CMS, selecting, customizing, and troubleshooting existing components to meet page design and content requirements  Support multilingual web builds by configuring and publishing localized page variants in coordination with translation partners 

Email Design Support

 Support the design and production of email templates and one-off campaign emails by working within established brand guidelines to produce visually consistent, mobile-responsive email layouts  Collaborate with broader marketing and design team by providing design assets, layout guidance, and visual QA support for email builds  Assist with email rendering QA across major clients (Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, mobile) — flagging design or layout issues before deployment  Contribute to the email template library by designing new modular components that can be reused across campaigns and nurture journeys 

A/B Test Page Implementation & Design Support

 Support the implementation of A/B test variants in Adobe Target, designing and configuring the page layouts and components required to run experiments defined by the key stakeholders  Design test variant page layouts and components by translating test hypotheses into visually distinct, properly structured page experiences ready for QA and launch  Conduct pre-launch QA on test variants ensuring pages render correctly, components are configured accurately, and the experience matches the intended design before a test goes live  Partner with the cross-functional team on test readiness, flagging implementation issues and ensuring variant pages are built to spec 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operations

 Serve as a flexible design and production resource, supporting web design, authoring, email, and test implementation needs as priorities shift  Coordinate with marketing stakeholders to route page changes and design work through appropriate approval workflows before publishing  Partner with the Web team to hand off designs and escalate technical implementation needs that go beyond component configuration  Contribute to project tracking and backlog management, flagging capacity constraints and surfacing prioritization trade-offs 

Required

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 UX & Visual Design: Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent design and prototyping tools; demonstrated ability to produce wireframes, mockups, and responsive page layouts with a strong portfolio  Web CMS Experience: Hands-on experience authoring and publishing pages in an enterprise CMS — Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred; equivalent platforms considered  Email Design: Experience designing mobile-responsive email layouts and familiarity with email design best practices, rendering constraints, modular template systems (experience with Storyports and Litmus preferred)  A/B Test Implementation: Comfort configuring and building page variants in testing tools (Adobe Target, Optimizely, or equivalent) — executing the design build accurately and on time  Design Fundamentals: Strong command of typography, visual hierarchy, layout, color, accessibility standards (WCAG) and email deliverability best practices  Attention to Detail: Strong QA instincts, being able to catch rendering issues, broken components, copy errors, and accessibility gaps before they reach a live audience  Collaboration & Communication: Comfortable working across matrixed teams — content, engineering, compliance, analytics — with clear written and verbal communication  Design system governance: Maintaining and contributing to a shared component library at scale 

Preferred

 Experience working in a regulated or compliance-driven environment and comfort routing design work through approval workflows  Familiarity with HTML/CSS - not a development role, but front-end fundamentals help when configuring components and troubleshooting rendering issues  Exposure to web analytics or behavioral tools such as Adobe Analytics, Contentsquare, or equivalent with proven ability to connect design decisions to performance data  Experience supporting multilingual or international web builds 

Education

 Undergraduate degree preferred — Design, Interactive Media, Visual Communications, Marketing, or a related field 

About Goldman Sachs
