rows.title: Social Strategist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

Social Strategist - Band 2

The Role

COHO (Content House) is growing internal agency & production studio inside the Personal Care division within P&G. COHO is seeking a Social Strategist to turn cultural trends, audience insights, and brand opportunities into social-first ideas for our portfolio of brands with a focus on Old Spice.

You’ll be our tapped-in cultural radar… strategic thinker with a maker’s mindset who understands what’s happening on TikTok and Instagram Reels, why people care, and how Old Spice can meaningfully participate. This isn’t about chasing every trending sound. It’s about seeing the bigger brand opportunity inside a fast-moving cultural moment, then finding a simple, compelling way to activate it.

You need the cultural fluency to spot emerging behaviors, the strategic judgment to connect them to brand and communication goals, and the hands-on resourcefulness to help bring ideas to life. From quick-turn AI explorations and small in-house shoots to creator collaborations and product-focused content, you’ll help develop work that feels native to the feed.

Working closely with the Strategy Director and COHO’s creative and production teams, you’ll connect big-picture brand thinking with the speed, specificity, and experimentation social demands.

Three Core Pillars of Responsibility

 Social-First Strategy & Cultural OpportunityStay immersed in TikTok, Instagram Reels, creator communities, and cultural conversations to identify emerging opportunities for Old Spice.Understand the humor, behaviors, motivations, and audience tensions behind trends…not just the formats themselves.Connect cultural signals to brand priorities, product benefits, audience insights, and communication objectives.Develop concise creative briefs and creative springboards that explain the opportunity, why it matters, and how Old Spice can show up.Identify where the brand should participate, where it can lead, and when it should sit a trend out.Balance timely activations with longer-term opportunities to build the brand’s social voice, relevance, and recurring content formats. Social-Native Ideas & Content DevelopmentDevelop ideas built for TikTok and Instagram Reels from the start, rather than adapting traditional advertising for social.Translate opportunities into hooks, scripts, rough storyboards, reference edits, and actionable content concepts.Partner with creative and production teams on lightweight shoots, quick-turn activations, and social content produced in-house.Be comfortable capturing footage, making a rough edit, or building a prototype to demonstrate an idea.Bring entertaining, platform-native thinking to product storytelling and e-content.Use approved AI tools to accelerate ideation, explore creative directions, and develop quick-turn mockups and content tests.Help identify and brief creators whose style, audience, and credibility fit the brand opportunity.Support live and real-time content opportunities, helping turn timely moments into engaging social work. Social Insights, Learning & CollaborationUse platform analytics, basic social listening, comment analysis, and competitive observation to understand audience interests and content performance.Help establish clear content objectives and relevant measures of success, including watch time, engagement, sharing, and traffic.Translate results into practical recommendations on what to repeat, refine, test, or stop.Bring proactive, actionable recommendations to the Strategy Director and brand teams…not just trend reports or interesting links.Collaborate with brand, creative, production, and review partners to move quickly while respecting brand standards and platform guidelines.Build a shared bank of cultural observations, creator references, content formats, and learnings to strengthen future work.

The Candidate Profile

Social & Cultural Alchemist: You see how a niche internet moment can become a meaningful brand opportunity. You understand not just what is trending, but why it resonates.

Native to the Feed: You know TikTok and Instagram Reels—their humor, pacing, visual language, communities, and unwritten rules. You can tell when a brand belongs in the conversation and when it’s trying too hard.

Big-Picture Thinker, Hands-On Activator: You connect ideas to broader brand goals while finding achievable ways to bring them to life quickly. You’re as comfortable shaping a brief as sketching a concept or shooting a rough example.

Proactive Opportunity-Finder: You don’t wait for an assignment. You bring a point of view on what the brand could do next, why it matters, and how to make it happen.

Fast, With Judgment: You understand that relevance has a shelf life, but speed isn’t everything. You assess brand fit, cultural sensitivity, and production feasibility before recommending action.

Insight-Curious: You understand foundational social metrics and have basic familiarity with social listening tools. You use audience signals and performance data to sharpen your instincts.

AI-Resourceful: You use AI to explore, prototype, and iterate faster while applying human judgment and following approved usage, privacy, and rights guidelines.

Creator-Aware: You understand influencer marketing fundamentals and how to build ideas that benefit from a creator’s authentic voice—not overwrite it.

Collaborative by Nature: You work well with strategists, creatives, producers, editors, and brand teams. You bring fresh thinking, welcome feedback, and help move ideas into production.

Why COHO? Why P&G?

You’ll get the creative energy of an in-house content studio with the resources and reach of P&G. COHO gives you:

High-Impact Work: Help shape how Old Spice participates in culture through relevant, entertaining social content.Ideas That Get Made: Work alongside creative and production talent who can help turn a timely opportunity into tangible work.Room to Experiment: Explore emerging formats, creator partnerships, lightweight shoots, and AI-assisted content development.Strategic Mentorship: Partner with the Strategy Director to sharpen your brand thinking, creative briefing, and strategic storytelling.Hands-On Opportunity: Help make the content…not just recommend it.A Continuous Learning Loop: See how audiences respond and use those insights to make the next idea stronger.

Job Qualifications

Relevant experience in social strategy, social content development, creator marketing, or a related agency, brand, studio, or creator-led role.Portfolio or work examples demonstrating the ability to turn cultural observations and audience insights into social-first brand ideas.Strong working knowledge of TikTok and Instagram Reels, including platform-native formats and audience behaviors.Experience creating lightweight content, with basic mobile shooting and editing skills.Understanding of foundational brand strategy, communication objectives, and social performance metrics.Basic familiarity with social listening tools, native platform analytics, and influencer marketing.Experience using AI tools for ideation, prototyping, or content workflows.Strong writing, collaboration, presentation, and organizational skills.Experience with live content, reactive social, small in-house shoots, or e-content is a strong plus.Based in Cincinnati or willing to relocate.

Full time

R000159819

Job Segmentation

Experienced Professionals

Starting Pay / Salary Range

$110,000.00 - $165,300.00 / year

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

Sitting at the intersection of analytics, data engineering, and Ecom stakeholder support, this hands-on technical role owns Retail Media and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) analytics for the Enablement & Martech team. Operating within the Partner Success department, you will partner closely with international retail partners operating the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) to turn business metric definitions into precise, trusted technical logic. You will also play a key role in expanding into Ecom Analytics Engineering as we build out reporting marts and establish a new semantic layer.

Beyond technical delivery, you will act as a pivotal liaison between Analytics Engineering, Product, and commercial stakeholders to define, govern, and migrate core Ecom metrics. You will drive Looker governance, provide actionable digital performance analysis, automated reporting workflows, and champion best practices across the business while mentoring junior team members.

rows.title: Vice President, Corporate Communications
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

What will you be doing? 

The Vice President of Corporate Communications will lead the planning and execution of enterprise communications programs that help employees and stakeholders understand, engage with, and act on Circana’s most important business priorities. Reporting to and partnering closely with the Chief Communications Officer, this leader will translate M&A, HR, organizational change, and global initiatives into coordinated communication strategies, stakeholder playbooks, leader materials, and measurable engagement plans.

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Strategy & Change Communications

Lead communications planning and execution for M&A integration, HR initiatives, organizational changes, operating model updates, and global enterprise programs, ensuring leaders and employees receive clear, timely, and actionable information. Build the workplans, stakeholder maps, message architectures, editorial calendars, approval processes, and measurement approaches needed to execute consistently across regions and functions. Manage the strategic partnership between Corporate Communications and HR, serving as the primary point of alignment on talent, culture, org-design, and employee-experience initiatives to ensure integrated planning and consistent messaging. 

Leadership Engagement

Lead communications support for events, leadership visits, town halls, and engagement programs, ensuring clear sequencing and consistent enterprise messaging. Write speeches, video scripts, discussion guides, and talking points for senior leaders, translating business priorities into clear, audience-ready messages. 

Reputation, Issues & Governance

Partner with senior communications leaders to ensure internal, leadership, and stakeholder communications are aligned with Circana’s corporate narrative, reputation priorities, and business strategy. Support M&A and Legal workstreams by partnering with Legal to develop disciplined stakeholder communications for litigation-related, regulatory, and disclosure-sensitive matters, ensuring materials are aligned, appropriately reviewed, and managed with discretion. Serve as a trusted communications partner to HR, M&A, regional, and business stakeholders, providing counsel on message strategy, employee impact, timing, risks, and execution. Maintain communications governance, standards, and best practices that reinforce execution discipline and clear decision-making across complex initiatives. Use employee insights, channel analytics, feedback loops, and post-initiative retrospectives to evaluate communications effectiveness and continuously improve clarity, engagement, and adoption. 

Requirements

10+ years of experience in strategic corporate communications, ideally within fast-paced, highly regulated industries such as information services, financial services, or technology. Proven success leading multi-stakeholder communications for mergers, acquisitions, or organizational transformations. Experience coordinating with external communications, including PR, legal, HR, M&A, strategy, and leadership. Experience supporting Legal-driven and issues-management workstreams, including litigation, regulatory, disclosure-sensitive, response protocol, and employee-facing stakeholder communications. Strong writing and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex information into clear, concise messaging. Demonstrated ability to work under tight timeframes, manage through ambiguity, and influence across functions and levels. Executive presence and discretion. Demonstrated background supporting senior leadership communications, including executive messaging, leader visibility, and speechwriting programs. Sound judgment on communications matters, with the conviction to advise employees at all levels, from entry-level to C-suite, while building productive colleague relationships. Experience working across global teams and regions. Experience using data, feedback, and employee insights to measure and improve results. Strong project management skills. Highly conscientious, with strong attention to detail. Bachelor’s degree in communications, business, or related field (MBA or relevant graduate degree a plus). 

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote (US) with a preference for candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones. Candidates outside those regions may still be considered if they can consistently work Eastern/Central business hours to support collaboration with key stakeholders.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $180,000 - $200,000 USD. This role is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. 

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. 

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description. 

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Director Client Sales & Insights - Hybrid - Arlington, VA
rows.descriptionText:
Director, Client Insights / 17 

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

Circana seeks a passionate Director and client advocate with strong analytic skills to advance solutions and insights that best build the client's strategic vision. Collaborate with our clients and internal teams to maximize and apply insights gleaned from Circana data including store data analysis, household purchase behavior analysis, surveys, audits, data modeling, in-market testing, and other custom projects. Advocate for your client and create/close new opportunities with them. \

To be successful as a Client Insights Director you must possess and be able to execute four key skill sets:

Advanced Analytic Skills:

Demonstrate ability to analyze and interpret data and translate it into meaningful solutions for clients:

 Approach clients with coherent, actionable, and fact-based data that includes recommendations appropriate to their business needs.  Utilize storytelling with a What, So What, Now What mentality to deliver complexity into clarity for clients.  Continually provide analytical solutions and business insights to address any business gaps and/or opportunities and create value for the client Incorporate client’s full solution suite appropriately to deliver robust, end-to-end insights with an outside-in perspective Identify business issues or opportunities and suggests the appropriate level of analytic solution/approach

Consultative Selling:

Apply knowledge of the business, industry, and domain to identify, create, and close business opportunities:

 Target and sell solutions that address underlying client needs by asking questions that identify the root causes of issues versus symptoms Strengthen client solution matrix by cross pollinating opportunities across the organization.  Ask questions to test assumptions and challenges the status quo Synthesize information on a variety of issues; translate the information into a project framework that ultimately provides solutions for clients

Impactful Presence:

Demonstrate strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills; strong business acumen and present a professional image:

 Become trusted by clients, Circana client solutions teams, Circana cross-functional organizations, and Circana business partners and considered a domain expert and business partner Educate the client on analytic methods, shape their thinking, and influence the decisions they make Demonstrate a flexible approach to communication; adapt messages quickly to the appropriate level or function with poise and polish C-level presence

Client Focus:

Consistently act with client satisfaction in mind and follow through on commitments to ensure the needs of the client are met:

 Develop and maintain a deep understanding of customer needs and requirements Understand organizational shape and development Help customers identify solutions to problems they did not know they had Regularly and proactively communicate with the client-facing teams, including soliciting feedback to continually improve the relationshipTrack and organize multiple work streams against multiple clients, and manage time and resources against changing priorities. 

Job Responsibilities:

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Manage the Sales Cycle: Lead end-to-end sales processes including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, negotiation, and closing. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in [retail, CPG, or general merchandise] to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Achieve Revenue Targets: Meet or exceed individual and team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Support Innovation and Feedback: Provide market feedback to internal teams to help refine offerings and contribute to product development. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

5-8 progressive years of experience in marketing or sales with a premier Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) or marketing analytics companyExperience with IRI/Circana data solutions is preferred; experience with syndicated datasets is requiredDemonstrated expertise in translating Point of Sale data and analysis into relevant implications within the CPG industryDemonstrated expertise in translating consumer panel data into actionable insights and recommendationsAbility to build a rapport across functions and levels within an organizationProven ability to consult with clients to influence thinkingBachelor’s degree preferred

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

rows.descriptionText:

The Analytic Services team works on client engagements and related delivery for Epsilon product platforms. The team partners with clients, agencies and data providers, leveraging analytics, data science, digital measurement and emerging AI capabilities to drive strategic thought and effective decision making. The Senior Staff Data Scientist will lead a portfolio of analytics programs across client accounts, own end-to-end delivery and business impact, and serve as a senior thought partner to clients, account teams and internal leadership. This role combines strong technical depth, people leadership, client-facing executive presence and the ability to translate complex data into measurable marketing and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Operational

Own end-to-end delivery of analytics programs across multiple client accounts, from scoping and solution design through execution, measurement and business impact articulationPartner with analytic consulting teams, clients and account teams to translate agreed business objectives and analytical roadmaps into scalable analytical solutions, measurement frameworks and actionable insights.Develop and govern analytical frameworks for customer segmentation, propensity modeling, customer lifetime value, campaign measurement, attribution, churn prediction and marketing effectivenessLead complex, cross-functional initiatives across analytics, data engineering, product, technology and client teams to ensure high-quality, on-time and on-budget deliveryProvide oversight and quality assurance for statistical analyses, machine learning models, experimental designs, measurement frameworks and insight narrativesTranslate complex analytical findings into clear, compelling executive-level stories and recommendations that demonstrate measurable client business impactProvide technical leadership and analytics subject-matter expertise supporting pre-sales opportunities, solutioning, proof of concepts and proposal development in partnership with analytic consulting and account teams. Champion the adoption of scalable analytics, automation, reusable assets and emerging AI or GenAI capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and solution qualityGuide teams in hands-on analysis of large-scale first-party, third-party and platform data, ensuring statistically valid outputs and actionable insightsEnsure strong project governance through clear communication, risk management, collaborator alignment, documentation and proactive expectation management

Functional

Lead, manage, mentor and grow a high-performing team of data scientists across multiple client engagements.Define team goals, manage performance outcomes, provide regular coaching and create structured development plans for team members.Provide thought leadership to strengthen analytical methods, delivery processes, reusable frameworks and best practices across the teamDrive hiring, onboarding, capability building and succession planning in alignment with organizational growth prioritiesFoster a culture of analytical rigor, accountability, innovation, collaboration, experimentation and continuous learning.Ensure team engagement, utilization and delivery excellence across billable projects and critical initiativesGuide the team to follow all policies and procedures for project documentation, tracking specifications, QA/QC, data governance, platform access and client communication.Collaborate effectively with cross-functional internal teams, senior collaborators, global partners and client teams to drive measurable digital marketing and business outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree, or higher, in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Marketing Analytics or a related field; master’s degree preferred.Minimum 10+ years of experience in analytics, digital media analytics, marketing analytics or related consulting roles, with demonstrated experience leading client-facing analytics programs. Proven experience leading and developing teams, including goal setting, performance management, coaching, feedback communication and capability building.Strong hands-on and leadership experience with Python, SQL and Databricks mandatory; Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Power BI and Tableau platforms would be an added advantage. Deep understanding of funnel analysis, attribution, customer journey analytics, audience segmentation, cohort analysis, campaign measurement and experimentation.Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and concepts, including SEO, SEM, paid media, conversion rate optimization, content performance and campaign performance measurement.Ability to guide teams through complex analytical problem solving, hypothesis development, data exploration, tracking validation, insight generation and business recommendation.Strong executive communication skills with the ability to present complex analytical findings to senior partners through clear storytelling and visually compelling presentations.Excellent partner management, client relationship, consulting, prioritization and negotiation skills.Solid planning, resource management and project governance skills, with experience managing multiple programs, workstreams and teams concurrently.Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical quality, tagging accuracy, data validation, reproducibility, documentation and QA/QC standards.Demonstrated ability to drive innovation, process improvement and adoption of new tools, technologies, AI capabilities and analytical methodologies.Highly collaborative, accountable and motivated leader with strong interpersonal skills and a passion for solving complex client business problems through digital data and analytics.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.   About the teamAt Roku, the UI team builds the foundational frameworks, tooling, and high‑performance UI components that power experiences across millions of devices. We own the middleware and UI layers that enable smooth navigation, responsive interactions, rich animations, and consistent developer workflows across the platform. Our work spans graphics rendering, layout and animation systems, performance optimization, and developer APIs that make it easy to create reliable, visually compelling applications at scale. We operate in a collaborative, high‑trust environment and partner closely with firmware, platform, and product teams to ensure the end‑to‑end experience is fast, robust, and ready for what’s next. About the roleAs a Senior Software Engineer on the UI team, you’ll design, implement, and optimize systems that underpin Roku’s user experience and developer platform. You’ll work on performance‑critical code paths for graphics rendering, animation, layout, and UI frameworks, ensuring buttery‑smooth visuals and instant responsiveness across a wide range of devices. You’ll help shape core architecture, collaborate across the stack with hardware, firmware, and application teams, and see your work directly impact tens of millions of users. This role is ideal for engineers who love deep technical problem‑solving, care about performance down to the last millisecond, and want to build the invisible foundations that make great user experiences possible. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy. BenefitsRoku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Our employees can take time off work for vacation and other personal reasons to balance their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. The Roku CultureRoku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. Job Description

The IT Resilience and Assurance Analyst supports Hearst Technology Services’ Organizational Resilience team by helping strengthen enterprise technology resilience, operational maturity, governance practices, and continuous improvement across critical technology services.

This position is designed for individuals early in their technology careers who want practical exposure to the disciplines that keep enterprise technology services reliable, resilient, well-governed, and continuously improving, including business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational assurance, change management, quality assurance, operational risk management, technology governance, and AI-enabled operational improvement.

Working alongside experienced technology professionals, the analyst will help develop resilience capabilities, evaluate operational effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and build innovative AI-powered solutions that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, enhance decision-making, and increase the value delivered by Hearst Technology Services.

Role Summary

The role combines operational resilience activities, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery, crisis management, and operational readiness, with operational assurance activities that evaluate governance, documentation, operational controls, service maturity, and continuous improvement opportunities.

Equally important, the analyst will help identify practical opportunities where artificial intelligence, automation, and modern technologies can improve Organizational Resilience services.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Resilience

 Support Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery planning activities.  Assist with Business Impact Analyses and operational risk assessments.  Participate in disaster recovery exercises, tabletop exercises, and crisis management activities.  Help develop and maintain business continuity plans, disaster recovery plans, recovery procedures, and operational documentation.  Support incident response activities and post-incident improvement initiatives.  Research emerging technologies and best practices that strengthen organizational resilience. 

Operational Assurance

 Participate in Operational Assurance reviews across HTS technology services.  Collect, organize, and validate documentation, operational evidence, reports, dashboards, and supporting artifacts.  Compare documented processes with actual operational practices and identify opportunities for improvement.  Assist with operational maturity assessments using established methodologies.  Evaluate governance, operational controls, documentation quality, ownership, and reporting effectiveness.  Help identify operational risks, process gaps, and recommendations that improve service quality and consistency. 

AI Innovation & Solution Development

 Assist with and learn the design, prototyping, building, and continuous improvement of AI-powered solutions that streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.  Assist in developing AI assistants, copilots, knowledge bases, intelligent workflows, and automation solutions using approved enterprise AI platforms and low-code technologies.  Assist with dashboards, operational scorecards, and AI-enabled analytics that provide meaningful business insights.  Learn about and help evaluate emerging AI technologies and help recommend practical use cases that create measurable business value.  Assist with measuring the effectiveness of AI solutions and help improve them based on user feedback and operational outcomes.  Collaborate with technology teams to ensure AI solutions align with enterprise governance, security, and responsible AI practices. 

Governance & Continuous Improvement

 Assist in developing operational standards, procedures, playbooks, and documentation.  Support technology governance and operational consistency initiatives.  Participate in process improvement projects across Hearst Technology Services.  Track remediation activities and continuous improvement initiatives.  Collaborate across Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Enterprise Applications, and Service Management teams.  Support executive reporting and operational metrics. 

What You Will Learn

This position provides hands-on experience across multiple enterprise technology disciplines, including:

 Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery  Crisis Management  Operational Assurance  Technology Governance  Organizational Resilience  Enterprise Risk Management  AI Solution Development  AI Automation & Workflow Design  AI Assistants & Copilots  Prompt Engineering & AI Orchestration  AI Governance & Responsible AI  Executive Reporting & Operational Analytics  Process Improvement 

Education & Experience

Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in a technology- or business-related discipline, including but not limited to:

 Information Technology  Computer Science  Information Systems  Cybersecurity  Business Administration  Business Analytics  Data Analytics  Risk Management  Emergency Management  Operations Management  Industrial Engineering  Management Information Systems 

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a motivated individual who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, collaborating across teams, and continuously improving how technology services are delivered.

Prior professional experience is not required. We value analytical thinking, creativity, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a passion for using artificial intelligence and automation to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, and deliver greater value to the organization.

Skills, Coursework & Experience

 Internship, coursework, research, or project experience related to technology operations, cybersecurity, business continuity, operational resilience, enterprise risk, quality assurance, IT governance, or business process improvement  Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies.  Interest in designing AI-powered solutions, automations, or intelligent workflows.  Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Power Automate, Python, or low-code development platforms is a plus.  Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, or similar collaboration platforms is a plus.  Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.  Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.  Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies. 

Entry-Level Certifications Considered a Plus (Not Required)

 ITIL® 4 Foundation  COBIT® Foundation  Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)  Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)  CompTIA Security+  CompTIA Data+  AWS Cloud Practitioner 

This role is intended to develop early-career technology talent while strengthening Hearst Technology Services’ resilience, assurance, governance, and AI-enabled operational improvement capabilities. The analyst will contribute to practical work across business continuity, disaster recovery, operational assurance, reporting, documentation, and solution development, with an emphasis on learning through meaningful enterprise initiatives.

Position Type / Schedule

Part-Time Schedule: This benefits-eligible, part-time role is 21 hours per week across three flexible workdays, mutually agreed upon based on business needs and the employee’s academic or personal schedule.

Work Location: This is an in-person role based at Hearst’s New York City office.

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York City. The reasonable estimate, if hired in New York City, is $35.00/Hour - $41.00/Hour. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York City. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York City, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.

About Us

Hearst is a leading global, diversified information, services, and media company dedicated to innovating, informing audiences and leading with purpose, integrity and a culture of care.

Our portfolio includes more than 360 businesses worldwide. On the consumer side, we operate 35 television stations, 28 daily newspapers and publish more than 200 magazine editions featuring many of the most iconic brands in media. We also hold ownership stakes in leading cable networks such as A&E, HISTORY, Lifetime and ESPN. On the business-to-business side, our companies include Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information and analytics; Hearst Health, which provides intelligence and software that improve care outcomes; and Hearst Transportation, which delivers data and software for aviation, automotive and trucking.

Our strength lies in our people. We value the diverse perspectives that move us forward. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex or gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, military or veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. We also provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees consistent with applicable law.

About The Team

Our Corporate Teams deliver essential programs and services that support the entire Hearst enterprise. Spanning communications, employee benefits, finance, learning and development, legal, technology, and more, these teams lead initiatives that advance Hearst’s mission to inform and inspire. Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow, collaborate and make a lasting impact.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. rows.title: Applied AI Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions, collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.

We’re looking for a Applied AI Engineer who can manage their product roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and risk assessment.

From conception to launch and beyond, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for your product.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered solutions, leveraging LLMs and other machine learning technologiesCollaborating closely with Data Scientists and Software Engineers to deliver impactful solutionsLeading cross-functional teams to build and deploy NLP and AI solutions, such as AI assistants and AI automation platformsSetting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with company goalsDelivering measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

What You'll Need

Experience developing and launching AI products/features from scratch High analytical and technical acumen, along with solid business sense and problem-solving skillsExperience in a data science or machine learning roleExperience owning machine learning projects, from design to implementation and iterationGreat Python, SQL, or other programming language skillsHands-on experience with deep learning libs (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, etc.)Knowledge of version control, model deployment, and developer environmentsEvidence of impressive mathematical and statistical knowledgeAn entrepreneurial drive to never settle

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

rows.title: Account Representative, Uber Eats, UK - South Asian Restaurant Specialist (Bengali Speaker)
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

As a South Asian Restaurant Specialist Account Executive for Uber Eats, you will drive marketplace growth by acquiring independent South Asian restaurant partners onto the platform. You will use your language skills, understanding of the restaurant market and relationship-building skills to build trust with merchants over the phone, managing the full outbound sales cycle from prospecting through to closed partnership.

This is a specialist inside sales role within a fast-paced SMB sales team. You will succeed by mastering your pipeline, leveraging data to drive territory growth, and using your language capability to reach and engage merchants who are harder to acquire through traditional sales channels.

What You'll Do

Specialist Outbound Activity: Drive a high volume of daily cold calling, using your target language where relevant to build trust and engage merchants, while consistently progressing deals through every stage of the sales cycle. Territory Ownership: Execute a structured operational plan to hit acquisition quotas. Map market data and local business intelligence to identify high-value targets within South Asian cuisine categories. Rigorous Data and Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain accurate data in CRM with diligent follow-ups, detailed meeting notes, and clear next steps. Monitor dashboards to ensure consistent engagement, preventing deals from becoming inactive. Account Management and Partner Optimisation: Act as a strategic partner to merchants during and post-onboarding; evaluate business impact, manage initial partner health, and use upsell frameworks to introduce additional Uber products that maximise mutual value. Forecasting and Reporting: Partner with leadership to review pipeline health, deliver accurate performance forecasting, and maintain complete business visibility. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with internal teams to streamline the merchant launch experience. Share insights on objection patterns, merchant needs and what works to help shape our approach to underserved cuisine categories. 

Basic Qualifications 

Language Capability: Fluency in both English and Bengali Experience and Track Record: Sales or business development experience in an outbound or target-driven environment with a track record of hitting or exceeding targets. Sales Cycle Capability: Proven ability to manage the full end-to-end cycle, from proactive prospecting to identifying needs, negotiating commercial structures, and transitioning relationships into early-stage account management. Soft Skills and Drive: Excellent communication, active listening, and presentation skills. Must be a resourceful problem-solver who can overcome objections with creative perseverance in a fast-paced environment. Product Expertise: Confidently handle routine product questions and platform objections by demonstrating deep marketplace expertise. Deal Structuring: Propose basic commercial deal structures and follow existing upsell frameworks to maximise the mutual value of the partnership from day one. Relationship Building: Ability to build trust quickly with independent business owners and adapt your communication style to different merchants. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience in the food delivery, hospitality, or e-commerce marketplace industries. Extraordinary listening and communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style to a wide variety of audiences. A resourceful and persistent attitude, with a relentless drive to achieve goals and overcome objections. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

rows.title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Global Marketing

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Strategy & Planning Lead will serve as a strategic advisor and thought partner to Global Marketing leadership, driving high-impact initiatives that accelerate growth, improve operational effectiveness, and maximize the return on marketing investments. This role sits at the intersection of corporate strategy, marketing, operations, analytics, and executive communications.

As a trusted partner to senior leaders, you will oversee strategic planning, investment prioritization, organizational effectiveness, and executive engagement across the marketing organization. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities to drive greater impact with existing resources, solving complex business challenges, and translating insights into actionable recommendations that influence company and marketing strategy.

The ideal candidate is highly self-directed, thrives in ambiguity, and brings deep experience in strategy, marketing, business operations, and executive stakeholder management. They are equally comfortable conducting rigorous analysis, developing executive-level narratives, leading cross-functional initiatives, and influencing senior leaders.

What You'll Do

Strategic Planning & Investment Management

 Drive annual and quarterly strategic planning processes across Global Marketing, partnering with leadership to define priorities, roadmap, investment allocations, and success metrics.  Develop business cases and investment scenarios to optimize marketing resource allocation and maximize growth impact.  Evaluate portfolio and market opportunities, recommending strategic shifts based on business performance, market dynamics, and organizational priorities.  Partner with Finance and Marketing leadership to establish planning frameworks that balance growth ambitions with operational discipline. 

Growth Strategy & Business Performance

 Analyze marketing performance, business trends, customer insights, and market opportunities to identify growth levers and strategic recommendations.  Develop executive-ready analyses and recommendations to improve marketing effectiveness, ROI, and organizational efficiency.  Monitor industry trends, competitive developments, and emerging opportunities to proactively identify risks and areas for investment.  Build frameworks that enable the organization to do more with less through prioritization, resource optimization, and scalable operating models. 

Executive Communications & Stakeholder Engagement

 Own executive engagement strategies and partner with internal and external stakeholders to develop clear, compelling narratives around marketing strategy and business priorities.  Lead development of executive presentations, leadership reviews, board-level materials, strategic memos, and organizational communications.  Translate complex analyses into concise recommendations that influence decision-making at the highest levels of the organization.  Serve as a key liaison between Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners across the business. 

Strategic Initiatives 

 Lead complex cross-functional projects that advance marketing and business priorities, from problem definition through implementation and impact measurement.  Partner closely with Operations, Data Science, Finance, Product, Regional teams, and other stakeholders to solve critical business challenges.  Establish operating mechanisms, governance processes, and performance management frameworks that improve organizational effectiveness.  Drive initiatives that increase operational rigor, simplify decision-making, and improve execution across the marketing organization. 

Leadership Partnership

 Act as a strategic thought partner and advisor to Marketing leadership on key business decisions, organizational priorities, and emerging opportunities.  Identify and advocate for high-priority initiatives that support both marketing objectives and broader company growth goals. rows.title: Product Manager II, Agentic AI
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

Uber's Customer Obsession AI team is building one of the largest GenAI products at Uber, serving nearly one billion customer interactions annually across all of Uber's products globally - Rideshare, Delivery, Merchants, Autonomous Vehicles, Third-party offerings, and more.

Customer experience is at the heart of cutting-edge applied AI today. The opportunity is expanding from handling individual customer queries into an end-to-end proactive AI assistant across the full user journey. We are rebuilding the product from the ground up to be AI-native, with a world-class team across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Design.

The team is also AI-pilled - every day, we find and deploy new ways to use AI internally to accelerate development, improve quality, and increase innovation.

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to help build the next generation of Agentic AI for Customer Experience at Uber.

You will work on products and platform capabilities that enable AI agents to understand customers and their context, reason through complex situations, make decisions, and take actions on their behalf. Depending on the product area, you may work on the customer-facing agent experience, agent reasoning and orchestration, multimodal capabilities, context and memory, quality and evaluation systems, developer tooling, or other foundational capabilities required to operate AI agents at Uber's scale.

This is an opportunity to work on AI with real-world consequences and learn how to build and operate agentic systems at massive scale. Our AI serves nearly one billion customer interactions annually across a wide range of products, markets, and customer scenarios. Building these experiences requires us to move quickly at the frontier of AI while maintaining a high bar for customer experience, quality, accuracy, and safety.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, User Research, and Operations to turn advances in AI into products that meaningfully improve the customer experience.

What You'll Do

Build agentic AI products: Own and ship product capabilities that help Uber's AI understand customer needs, reason through complex situations, make decisions, and take actions. Turn AI advances into customer experiences: Stay close to rapidly evolving AI capabilities and identify opportunities to translate them into intuitive, differentiated experiences for Uber customers. Own a product area end-to-end: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap, define requirements and success metrics, make tradeoffs, and work closely with cross-functional partners from discovery through launch and iteration. Drive AI quality: Partner with Engineering and Data Science to understand agent behavior and improve it through capabilities such as evals, experimentation, simulations, observability, debugging, and human feedback. Champion the customer: Use customer insights, research, data, and product intuition to deeply understand customer problems and ensure technology translates into a high-quality user experience. Work across the stack: Develop enough technical depth to engage with how agentic systems work - from models and reasoning to tools, context, orchestration, platform infrastructure, and the experiences customers ultimately see. Use data to learn and iterate: Define success metrics, analyze product and model performance, identify opportunities, and use experimentation and customer feedback to continuously improve the product. Drive cross-functional execution: Work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Design, User Research, Operations, and other Uber product teams to move quickly from ideas to products in customers' hands. Operate with speed and curiosity: Experiment with new AI tools and ways of working, including using AI to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, testing, and iteration. 

Basic Qualifications

Product experience: Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Product Management experience, including high-impact internships. You have contributed to shipping and improving technology products used by real customers. Strong product thinking: You can take an ambiguous customer or business problem, break it down, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and translate them into a clear product plan. AI curiosity and technical depth: You are excited about AI and have a strong desire to understand how modern AI and agentic systems work. You can engage deeply with Engineering and Data Science on technical tradeoffs without needing to be an engineer yourself. Customer obsession: You care deeply about the quality of the end-user experience and can combine product intuition, customer research, and quantitative data to make good decisions. Strong execution: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, getting into the details, making tradeoffs, and driving cross-functional teams toward outcomes in a fast-moving environment. Analytical mindset: You use data to understand problems, evaluate product performance, test hypotheses, and make decisions. Communication and storytelling: You can clearly articulate the customer problem, product rationale, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences. High ownership and learning velocity: You are curious, hands-on, and eager to learn. You move with urgency, seek out feedback, and are excited to build in a space where the technology and product possibilities are evolving rapidly

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working on mobile experiences and consumer products.

Phenomenal track record of working with engineering, analytics and design teams, with proven examples to prioritize work across the team.

Grittiness: you never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on.

Proven track record of growing and scaling a product.

About The Role

The Staff Security Strategist, GRC partners with engineering, security, and cross-functional risk stakeholders to strengthen Uber's cybersecurity posture through scalable cyber risk management, risk governance, and control design programs. This role is responsible for driving and implementing security, compliance, and risk management programs on the ServiceNow eGRC platform at Uber, working with the engineering team to develop and enable technical solutions that satisfy a variety of risk and compliance processes.

This role operates at the intersection of technical security, process design, and risk governance. The successful candidate will translate control gaps, threat and business context, and compliance requirements into practical risk treatment plans that engineering teams can execute, while driving consistent risk analysis, decision-making, and follow-through. The role must be able to deliver work products required by Agile development methodologies for software development delivery as defined.

 Own cyber risk intake, triage, and prioritization, ensuring clear accountability, well-formed risk statements, and timely treatment decisions.  Develop product strategy and lead project execution for multiple major components of Uber's Risk and Compliance technology solutions.  Manage different solutions on Uber's internal eGRC platform (ServiceNow) and collaborate with stakeholders to implement their program improvements.  Partner with engineering teams to define risk treatment plans, identify sustainable fixes, and drive mitigation or remediation to the last mile rather than stopping at documentation.  Gather business and functional requirements from partner teams and deliver a product/release that meets the needs presented. Develop technical specifications documentation.  Lead or materially contribute to control design reviews, risk assessments, and risk decisions that require judgment, stakeholder alignment, and tradeoff management.  Drive and evangelize vision for overall GRC strategy across engineering and security organizations.  Analyze and fully understand user stories and internal procedures in order to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows, and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the eGRC platform.  Work with developers to implement workflows from customer requirements including workflows, UI actions, client scripts, business rules, etc.  Load, manipulate, and maintain data between the eGRC platform and other systems as needed.  Build and maintain risk reporting for leaders and partner teams, including KRIs, exposure trends, risk acceptance aging, decision status, and escalation triggers.  Design and develop dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors, and reports as needed to support program requirements.  Improve the efficiency of risk workflows through automation, better tooling, clearer operating models, and reusable knowledge assets.  Perform system and integration testing with sample and live data.  Review product performance and provide a continuous improvement path through leveraging industry standard tools and capabilities as well as building new ones.  Serve as a bridge between cybersecurity, engineering, audit, privacy, and compliance stakeholders so that security risk becomes practical engineering action.  Mentor analysts and junior security partners on risk analysis, risk statement quality, treatment planning, stakeholder communication, and operational rigor. 

Basic Qualifications:

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.  10+ years of experience in security, cyber risk, GRC, assurance, security operations, or related technical risk roles.  Security certifications e.g. CISA, CISSP, CISM, or other relevant certifications.  Demonstrated success managing security risk programs, treatment decisions, and cross-functional execution end to end.  Strong understanding of security controls, risk treatment, and how to work with engineering on implementation details.  Experience operating across multiple stakeholders, handling ambiguity, and driving accountability.  Ability to effectively and autonomously accomplish outcomes across cross-functional teams in ambiguous situations with minimal supervision.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present risk, status, and decision points to leadership and technical audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications:

 CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or comparable additional certifications.  Hands-on experience with ServiceNow eGRC platform, including configuration, workflow development, and integration.  Experience with other GRC/ERM tooling such as AuditBoard, Archer, OpenPages, or SAP GRC.  Big 4 accounting firm and/or internet/technology industry experience.  Process management experience, including process redesign and optimization.  Proven track record in driving security risk treatment to closure across multiple engineering teams.  Ability to leverage AI, data analytics, and workflow automation to improve risk program performance and reporting.  Experience with risk quantification methodologies and risk lifecycle tooling.  Strong knowledge of control frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, NIST RMF, SOC 2, and CIS. rows.title: Safety Measurement & Insights Lead
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Safety Risk Measurement & Insights Lead owns how Uber defines, measures, and reasons about safety risk on the platform. This role makes us smart about measurement itself - ensuring that our indicators of safety risk (both outcome metrics like Safety Incident Rate and the leading, input, and predictive signals that precede harm) are well-defined, governed, trusted, and continuously improved, and then translating them into clear, actionable insight for business leadership and external reporting.

This role sits at the center of Analytics, Operations, and cross-functional partners to unify metric definitions, strengthen data quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve how safety performance is understood and acted upon across the organization. This role will also help shape how Safety uses smarter tooling and AI-enabled workflows to scale measurement, analytics, and reporting.

What You'll Do

Metric Governance & Foundations:  Drive governance for Safety's most critical metrics, including Incident Rate and leading indicators of safety risk. Recommend durable definitions, inclusion/exclusion logic, auditability, lineage, and consistency over time. Ensure metric frameworks remain credible as the platform, product, and risk landscape evolve.

Data Quality & Measurement Integrity:  Serve as Safety's measurement steward - lead end-to-end accountability for the quality and reliability of safety data. Partner with DS / Eng / Ops to resolve issues, and establish clear monitoring and escalation mechanisms that improve trust in reported safety outcomes.

Analytical Investigation, Insight Generation & Business Translation: Lead deep dives into performance shifts, emerging risks, and measurement anomalies, combining quantitative analysis with operational context to identify what is happening, why it is happening, and what Safety should do next; then turn those insights into crisp, credible narratives that help leaders make decisions, prioritize investments, and communicate clearly to senior stakeholders.

AI-Enabled Insights & Scalable Workflows: Define and advance the future state of Safety analytics by identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis, improve self-serve access, and use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate insight generation without compromising rigor

Safety Ops Enablement:  Enable Safety Operations and regional partners to use trusted safety metrics consistently and effectively. Build or shape dashboards, reporting tools, education materials, and analytical resources that improve understanding, speed up decision-making, and strengthen stakeholder influence.

Reporting & Decision Support:  Ensure executive- and external-facing reporting is rigorous, defensible, and efficient, with clear underlying methodology and a consistent measurement framework.

What You'll Need

 Analytical Leadership & Data Acumen: Strong analytical foundation with the ability to understand statistical concepts, challenge assumptions, partner credibly with Data Science, and turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.  Business Acumen & Strategic Thinking: Strong understanding of the broader business context and Safety's role within it, with the ability to frame trends, tradeoffs, and recommendations in a way that supports executive decision-making.  Influence & Communication: Excellent communicator and storyteller with a track record of building trust, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and driving alignment without direct authority.  Systems Thinking: Able to understand end-to-end processes, dependencies, and organizational dynamics to identify root causes and durable solutions.  AI & Analytical Innovation: Curious and practical user of AI, automation, or emerging analytical tools to accelerate insight generation, improve decision-making, and scale analytical work. 

Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, business operations, data science, or a related field.  Bachelor's Degree in Economics, Engineering , Data Science, Finance or technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience in Trust & Safety, Risk, Marketplace Integrity, Fraud, or other complex operational domains.  Experience at a technology platform, marketplace, gig economy, e-commerce, social media, dating, or similar trust-based ecosystem.  Experience defining, governing, or evolving critical business metrics used by senior leadership.  Experience building self-service analytics, measurement frameworks, or analytical products.  Track record of coaching, educating, or upskilling teams on analytical concepts and best practices.  Experience driving accountability and raising the quality bar for insight generation across an organization.  PHD in Economics, Engineering , Data science, Finance or technical field. 

 Why This Role Matters 

This role ensures Safety has the measurement foundations it needs to make good decisions, hold the right line on rigor, and communicate performance credibly inside and outside the company. It is both a governance role and an insight role: trusted numbers, better decisions, stronger execution.

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

This role cannot offer any sort of visa sponsorship.

Global Platform builds the shared services, tools, and engineering foundations that help eBay teams deliver products faster, improve reliability, and reduce operational risk.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll set platform direction for one of eBay’s company priorities with broad technical and organizational scope. You’ll partner with product, engineering, architecture, and VP-level leaders to connect company goals with the capabilities and investments needed to achieve them.

Your work will extend beyond a single initiative. You’ll identify recurring needs across organizations, determine where reusable solutions can create broader value, and help shape Global Platform’s multi-year strategy and investment priorities.

You’ll lead through influence, turn complex technical questions into clear decisions, and guide work across organizations from early framing through measurable results. Success will be reflected in stronger adoption, smoother migrations, improved service health, greater engineering efficiency, and better customer and business outcomes.

What You Will Accomplish
