Track progress through usage, migration, service health, engineering efficiency, and business results.Communicate clear recommendations to technical and executive audiences and mentor other product managers.Identify, evaluate, and scale responsible AI-enabled capabilities that accelerate product delivery, improve customer engagement, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Who You Are

rows.title: Inventory Planner
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Inventory Planner (Omni)

Overview Of The Inventory Planner (Omni) Role

The Inventory Planner (Omni) is responsible for supporting inventory planning and execution for our Omni services, including Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Buy Online Ship From Store (BOSFS), and Buy Online Ship to Store (BOSTS).

This role partners with Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Distribution, Store Operations, E-commerce, and IT to help maximize sales, optimize inventory turn, support in-stock goals, and deliver a best-in-class customer experience across Omni fulfillment channels.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, and comfortable using data to identify business trends, support recommendations, and help improve inventory outcomes across stores and digital channels.

Responsibilities


 Support inventory planning for Omni services, including BOPIS, BOSFS, and BOSTS, to help drive sales, improve inventory productivity, and support customer fulfillment goals.  Review Corporate Open-To-Buy plans submitted by Inventory teams, along with historical Omni performance, to help build store-level forecasts for BOSFS and BOPIS labor planning.  Analyze Omni sales, inventory availability, fulfillment trends, backorder opportunities, cancellation risk, and store performance to identify risks and opportunities.  Support BOSFS inventory strategies that help maximize sales, leverage available store inventory, reduce aged or clearance inventory, and mitigate backorder risk.  Partner with Store Operations to monitor store fulfillment performance and identify opportunities to improve on-time service, reduce delays, and support customer experience goals.  Partner with Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Visual, and Store Operations to review floor set plans, key-item representation, presentation minimums, and safety stock needs to help protect in-store selling and display quantities.  Leverage historical data to identify key learnings around product, pricing, seasonality, inventory, and Omni fulfillment behavior, and apply those learnings to future planning decisions.  Prepare recurring reporting and analysis to support Omni planning conversations, business reviews, and cross-functional decision-making.  Partner with Distribution, Inventory, and IT teams to help troubleshoot Omni inventory, reporting, fulfillment, and process issues.  Support standardized processes, documentation, and reporting routines that improve visibility, reduce manual work, and create consistency across Omni inventory planning workflows.  Use approved AI tools, automation, reporting tools, or planning systems to support analysis, improve recurring workflows, and identify opportunities to work more efficiently.  Operate a computer and communicate via telephone.  Transport materials and equipment and lift, move, and carry objects up to 50 pounds on a limited basis. 


Criteria


 Data-driven individual with a curious, analytical, and collaborative mindset.  Minimum two years of experience in Inventory Management, Inventory Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Merchandise Planning, E-commerce Planning, or a related retail function.  Omnichannel, e-commerce, store fulfillment, or retail inventory experience preferred.  Proven ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear business recommendations.  Proficiency in retail math, including sales, inventory, turn, receipts, margin, markdowns, and open-to-buy concepts.  Experience supporting forecasts, reporting, inventory analysis, or recurring business review processes.  Strong proficiency in MS Excel; experience with planning systems, reporting tools, dashboards, or data visualization tools preferred.  Curious and proactive in adopting approved AI tools, automation, and reporting enhancements to improve analysis, reduce manual work, and support better decision-making.  Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Inventory, Merchandising, Store Operations, Distribution, E-commerce, and IT.  Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload, manage deadlines, and follow through on multiple tasks.  Flexible and adaptive to changing priorities, business needs, and process changes. 


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits Tax-free commuter benefits A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-development Advisor (Mentor) program Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series


WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

The expected starting pay range for this position is $75,000-$85,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

rows.title: Vice President, Regional Operations - eCommerce Fulfillment and Light Manufacturing
rows.descriptionText:
Role Overview

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

The Vice President of Operations leads a large-scale ecommerce fulfillment, distribution, and light manufacturing operation across multiple US sites, reporting to the Chief Supply Chain & Manufacturing Officer.

This is both a strategic and hands-on role. The VP sets multi-year direction, manages P&L impact, drives continuous improvement, optimizes network performance, partners with vendors and develops a strong leadership bench while staying close to daily execution, ensuring critical peak period performance, improving cost-to-serve and delivering reliable customer service.

The ideal candidate brings experience in high-volume e-commerce and small-parcel fulfillment with the technical, analytical, and people-leadership capabilities needed to scale operations, strengthen process discipline, reduce costs, improve quality, and deliver superior customer experience.

What You’ll Do

Lead Regional Operations


 Own regional site performance across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, inventory accuracy, and customer experience. Translate business growth objectives into scalable operating models, staffing plans, facility strategies, process standards, and performance systems. Build short-, mid-, and long-term operating plans that align capacity, labor, systems, automation, service levels, customer promise, and cost structure. Oversee and develop Site Operations, Engineering, Safety, and Operational Excellence leaders.


Drive E-commerce Fulfillment, and Small-Parcel Performance


 Lead high-volume ecommerce fulfillment including order flow, pick-pack-ship, sortation, returns, exception management, and on time ship and customer service performance Improve order cycle time, dock-to-stock performance, units per labor hour, cost per order, cost per shipment, inventory accuracy, damage rates, returns handling, and carrier performance. Partner with Transportation, Customer Experience, Merchandising, Planning, Finance, IT, and external providers to ensure fulfillment performance supports customer expectations and business growth. Own peak readiness: capacity planning, labor modeling, inventory positioning, contingency planning and disciplined execution. Manage parcel carrier, 3PL, packaging, automation and maintenance vendor relationships.


Scale Light Manufacturing and Technical Operations


 Lead light manufacturing and personalization across Softline and Hardlines merchandise, including packaging, quality control, production planning, and value-added services. Apply engineering, Lean, Six Sigma, and process design principles to improve flow, reduce variation, eliminate waste, and increase repeatability. Partner with Engineering and Facilities on layout, material flow, equipment reliability, ergonomics, automation readiness, and capital projects. Evaluate and implement new technologies, equipment, systems, and automation that improve speed, quality, labor efficiency, and scalability.


Build Operational Excellence


 Lead an operating system grounded in Lean, Six Sigma, standard work, visual management, root cause problem-solving, daily management, and disciplined KPI review. Establish scorecards across safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, inventory, and customer outcomes. Sponsor major transformation initiatives including facility redesign, WMOS/ERP implementation, automation deployment, systems integration, process standardization, and network optimization. Create a culture of operational discipline where leaders use data, facts, and root cause analysis to solve problems, improve performance, and sustain results.


Own Financial and Strategic Performance


 Own operating budgets, labor plans, productivity commitments and cost improvement plans. Manage P&L-impacting decisions across labor, supplies, freight, parcel, packaging, maintenance, inventory accuracy, quality defects, and vendor spend. Build business cases for capital investments, automation, facility changes, technology upgrades, outsourcing, insourcing, and network changes. Partner with Finance on cost-to-serve models, productivity targets, and operating reviews


Develop People and Culture


 Build a high-performing leadership bench across directors, senior managers, operations managers, engineers, safety leaders, and analysts. Create a culture grounded in safety, accountability, respect, communication, recognition, development, and measurable performance. Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, succession planning, leadership capability, engagement, retention, change management, training, and organizational design. Lead through complexity, ambiguity, growth, turnaround, peak periods, systems change, and operational transformation.


Required Qualifications

What We’re Looking For


 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, or related field. 12+ years of progressive operations leadership in ecommerce direct-to-consumer fulfillment, distribution, logistics, small-parcel operations, light manufacturing, supply chain, or related environments. 5+ years leading Directors, Senior Managers, General Managers across multi-site/multi-function operations. Demonstrated results improving safety, service, quality, productivity, cost, and inventory accuracy in high-volume environments. Strong financial acumen: budgeting, labor planning, cost reduction, and P&L impact. Experience with WMS, ERP, LMS, labor planning, inventory and parcel shipping, and operational dashboards. Track record leading capital projects, technology implementations, equipment/technology deployment or large-scale operational transformation. Builds cross-functional partnerships: Supply Chain, Transportation, Finance, HR, IT, and Customer Experience.


Preferred Qualifications


 Engineering or technical degree; MBA or advanced degree a plus. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Master Black Belt, PMP and/or APICS/ASCM certification. Experience with e-commerce, omnichannel retail, high-SKU operations, parcel shipping, light manufacturing, assembly, customization, packaging, kitting, or personalization. Experience with automation, robotics, conveyor/sortation systems, warehouse control systems, or advanced analytics. Experience managing 3PLs, parcel carriers, automation vendors and outsourced labor providers. Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel, data visualization, or similar analytics tools. Background in startups, turnaround, rapid scaling, or facility launch environments.


How We Lead

We hire and develop leaders who role model our WSI Leadership Behaviors. The VP is expected to be:


 Strategic and hands-on: able to set regional direction while understanding what is happening on the floor. Data-driven: uses KPIs, root cause analysis, and financial modeling to make decisions. Customer-focused: understands that operational performance directly affects delivery promise, brand trust, and repeat purchase behavior. Technically credible: able to work effectively with engineering, systems and process design teams. People-centered: develop leaders, create an engaging culture, and build accountability. Change-capable: experienced in leading transformation, process standardization, systems implementation, and performance turnarounds. Commercially sharp: understands cost-to-serve, P&L impact, capital ROI, labor leverage, and service tradeoffs.


What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:


 Measurable improvement in service, quality, cost, inventory accuracy and customer delivery. Stronger peak readiness and labor planning discipline with operational consistency. Clear operating scorecards in place and reviewed consistently across all sites. A leadership bench that runs the day-to-day and is ready for the next level of growth. At least one major transformation project: automation, facility redesign, or systems; executed on time and on budget. Stronger cross-functional relationships and a reputation as a collaborative, execution-oriented leader.


Why Join Us

This is a high-visibility executive role with real P&L accountability and room to shape the regional fulfillment operating model. You'll work at the intersection of ecommerce growth, operational excellence, and people development, in a strategic and hands on role central to the operations of Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

Benefits Just For You

Your Opportunity

You’ll play a key role in shaping the future of Chewy’s supply chain as an Associate Director of Network Strategy & Analytics. You’ll lead the development of our multi-year network strategy, helping determine how products move from suppliers through our fulfillment network and ultimately to our customers. You’ll bring together perspectives from across data science, forecasting, engineering, operations, transportation, and real estate to evaluate complex choices and turn insights into actionable plans. This is an exciting opportunity to build the data, metrics, and planning frameworks that inform significant supply chain investments and create lasting impact at Chewy!

What You’ll Do

Develop multi-year supply chain and network strategies spanning inbound transportation, fulfillment, and outbound delivery.Build metrics, models, and analytical frameworks that evaluate network alternatives, tradeoffs, required investments, and expected outcomes.Partner with data science teams to develop rigorous analytical approaches for solving complex supply chain and network questions.Collaborate across transportation, fulfillment, forecasting, engineering, operations, and real estate to define critical business questions and evaluate potential solutions.Translate complex analyses into clear strategic options, recommendations, and investment considerations for senior leaders.Lead leadership reviews that encourage thoughtful discussion, clarify tradeoffs, and build alignment around long-term network plans.Establish scalable planning processes, data structures, and metrics that strengthen Chewy’s multi-year supply chain decision-making.Guide and develop a team responsible for network strategy and analytics while fostering curiosity, collaboration, and measurable impact.

What You’ll Need

8+ years of experience in supply chain, with demonstrated expertise across transportation, operations management, network planning, or related areas.Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, including establishing goals, creating meaningful metrics, and delivering measurable business outcomes.Experience translating complex data and analytics into clear recommendations that support strategic business decisions.Ability to collaborate across functions, influence stakeholders, and build alignment among teams with different priorities and perspectives.Advanced proficiency with Excel, SQL, and Tableau, with the ability to apply data analysis to complex supply chain challenges.Deep understanding of transportation, operations management, and supply chain planning.Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage multiple complex initiatives.E-commerce experience.BS/BA degree in a related field.

Bonus

Experience working in a startup or other rapidly evolving business environment.

What You’ll Get

You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Chewy plans and invests in its supply chain for years to come. You’ll work alongside talented partners across the organization, build new strategic capabilities, and help solve complex challenges that directly affect how we serve our customers.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

rows.title: Tech Principal Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team responsible for delivering technology capabilities that modernize and optimize Williams-Sonoma's end-to-end supply chain. The team partners closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Technology to deliver scalable product capabilities that improve operational efficiency, inventory productivity, manufacturing performance, and customer experience. You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team that is responsible for continuous improvement of our supply chain by focusing on removing friction points for our internal and external customers by delivering a highly satisfying experience.

About The Role

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is in the business of enhancing the quality of our customers' lives at home. This critical Principal Product Manager role owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Williams-Sonoma's Manufacturing technology domain, supporting our in-house furniture and lighting manufacturing operations. This leader will define and deliver capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, production execution, inventory visibility, quality, scheduling, materials management, shop floor operations, and fulfillment while enabling scalable growth across our manufacturing network. This role operates across strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network. The right candidate will have deep experience with discrete manufacturing as well as the associated logistics and transportation activities and a techno-functional / Product Management background.

Responsibilities


This role operates across product strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to modernize manufacturing capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network.Own the Manufacturing product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities, identifying opportunities through customer insights, operational data, and hypothesis-driven product discovery focused on measurable business outcomes.Monitor emerging manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, AI, and digital manufacturing trends, evaluating new technologies and industry practices that can improve Williams-Sonoma's competitive advantage.Define product success metrics and measurement plans tied to manufacturing efficiency, production throughput, inventory accuracy, schedule adherence, quality, operational productivity, adoption, and business value realization. Continuously measure outcomes to guide product investment decisions and optimization.Lead product discovery, business process analysis, and solution definition for manufacturing capabilities, translating business needs into product strategy, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized Jira backlogs that enable iterative Agile delivery.Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, shop floor productivity, quality, scheduling, operational efficiency, and business decision making while leveraging generative AI to improve product discovery, requirements quality, documentation, and team productivity.Serve as the primary product leader across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Architecture, and Technology teams, aligning stakeholders around product vision, priorities, delivery, and measurable business value.Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver iterative product capabilities using Agile methodologies while balancing business value, technical debt, scalability, and long-term platform health.Serve as the manufacturing product subject matter expert, leading cross-functional exploration, making informed product recommendations, and communicating roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to business partners and senior Technology leadership.Lead organizational readiness and product adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, business process design, SOP documentation, training, UAT, hyper-care, and adoption measurement.Ensure manufacturing solutions meet governance, security, audit, licensing, and compliance requirements while partnering with Internal Audit and Technology teams to establish appropriate operational controls.


Criteria


10 years of Product Management or techno-functional experience supporting Manufacturing, Supply Chain, ERP, or related enterprise technology platforms.Experience with discrete manufacturing, configurable products, production planning, bills of material, routings, work centers, capacity planning, quality management, and manufacturing execution preferred.Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, drive executive alignment, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively across executive, operational, and technical audiences without direct authority.Deep understanding of Microsoft Dynamics AX/Dynamics 365 Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and related manufacturing processes.Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, and execution for complex enterprise platforms supporting manufacturing or supply chain operations.Own the product lifecycle from discovery through adoption, continuously measuring business outcomes and incorporating customer feedback into future roadmap priorities.Experience applying AI, generative AI, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics to improve manufacturing operations, product management practices, or business processes. Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver AI-enabled business capabilities.Experience with related supply chain operations, order management, eCommerce and finance / accounting processes.Experience leading large-scale business transformation initiatives from product discovery through implementation, including business process redesign, organizational change management, UAT, training, and production adoption.Experience with the process of configurable products as they flow from the eCommerce customer’s orders through order management (OMS) and to Dynamics 365 for manufacturing and order fulfillment.You have a proven ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage difficult tradeoffs, and evaluate new ideas with partners across the organization.Experience in a large, multi-brand business preferred. Consulting experience is also desirable.Experience creating and managing product backlogs, including writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work within Jira for Agile software delivery.Strong communication and negotiation skills and the ability to lead and influence others.Bachelor's degree or more in Engineering, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent work experience. This role requires being onsite in the WSI manufacturing Claremont, North Carolina office Monday through Thursday.Some travel will be required to other WSI manufacturing and supply chain locations within the United States. (Manufacturing: Claremont, NC; Tupelo, MS; Portland, OR)


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


A generous discount on all WSI brandsA 401(k) plan and other investment opportunitiesPaid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteerHealth benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefitsTax-free commuter benefitsA wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning


In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI UniversityCross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-developmentAdvisor (Mentor) programCareer development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

Identifies public relations opportunities and coordinates activities to augment the overall marketing communication strategy. Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications. rows.title: Senior Director, Marketing Performance and Growth
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

The Senior Director, Marketing Performance and Growth will lead a new team responsible for ensuring Hilton's marketing investments are driving optimal brand and commercial outcomes. This is a critical leadership role designed to move Hilton from insight-rich reporting to faster optimization across paid media, digital direct commerce, creative, and growth channels.

This role has accountability for optimization across multiple teams with the goal of reducing the time it takes to move from insight to action. This leader will establish a dedicated performance and optimization hub within Marketing, creating a new operating system with clear ownership, tighter decision-making, and measurable impact on ROI, brand health, channel growth, and digital direct commerce performance.

The Senior Director will be accountable for building the team, operating cadence, cross-functional model, and performance discipline needed to continuously improve how Hilton invests, learns, reallocates, and grows.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Lead the Marketing Performance & Optimization team, establishing the vision, operating model, governance, and day-to-day ways of working for a new embedded optimization capability.Build a faster insight-to-action model that turns performance signals into concrete recommendations, budget shifts, channel adjustments, creative learnings, and measurable outcomes.Optimize paid media investment and performance across major channels, partnering with media, regional marketing, finance, analytics, and agency teams to ensure spend is continuously evaluated and redeployed toward the highest-value opportunities.Diagnose and improve digital direct commerce performance, identifying opportunities across web, mobile, CRM, media, and other growth channels to accelerate revenue and conversion outcomes.Define, test, and scale growth channels by establishing a disciplined test-and-learn agenda, clear measurement frameworks, and repeatable playbooks for scaling what works.Establish a clear operating cadence for the team, including daily performance signal reviews and anomaly detection, weekly optimization recommendations and budget-shift discussions, and monthly channel role and investment recalibration.Build and maintain marketing tagging and tracking methodology in partnership with Marketing Technology team.Create accountability against goal delivery, ensuring optimization work is tied directly to business outcomes rather than reporting activity alone.Translate complex performance data into clear executive narratives and recommendations that help senior leaders make decisions about marketing investment, channel strategy, and growth opportunities.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Partner closely with Strategy, Insights & Analytics, Finance, Media teams, Regional Marketing leaders, and Agencies to ensure measurement, investment decisions, and optimization actions are connected and aligned.Build and develop a high-performing team with the specialized skills required to drive continuous optimization across analytics, media performance, creative insights, and growth strategy

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

Own end-to-end accountability for improving the performance of Hilton's marketing investments, with a focus on paid media efficiency, digital direct commerce growth, channel performance, and commercial return.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Twelve plus (12+) years of experience in marketing performance, media strategy, digital commerce, growth marketing, marketing analytics, or related commercial leadership roles.Demonstrated experience managing or influencing large-scale marketing investment decisions across paid media, digital, CRM, mobile, web, or performance channels.Strong understanding of marketing ROI, incrementality, attribution, media measurement, audience strategy, and performance optimization.Experience turning data and insights into practical actions that improve business outcomes.Experience building or leading cross-functional operating models across marketing, analytics, finance, agencies, and commercial teams.Simplify complex performance topics and influence senior stakeholders.Demonstrated leadership of teams, including building new capabilities, setting priorities, and creating accountability in matrixed organizations.Comfort operating in ambiguity and standing up new ways of working where roles, processes, and decision rights need to be clarified.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

Experience in hospitality, travel, retail, loyalty, ecommerce, or another multi-channel consumer business.Experience working in a global or regionally matrixed organization.Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality testing, media optimization tools, customer data platforms, and agency performance management.Experience connecting creative testing and media optimization to commercial outcomes.

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. rows.title: Product Manager — AI Enterprise Capacity Management
rows.descriptionText:
Location

London

Business Area

Product

Ref #

10053170

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg's AI is transforming how investment professionals discover information, run analysis, automate workflows and collaborate across their organizations. ASKB has quickly become a primary conversational interface for Bloomberg Terminal users — letting users interact with Bloomberg's data, analytics, news and applications in natural language, powered by specialized AI agents and grounded in three principles: accuracy, transparency and trusted content.

As firms increasingly look to deploy AI at an enterprise level, Bloomberg is bringing enterprise-grade administration, governance and collaboration to its AI capabilities — so firms can adopt AI across teams and departments while maintaining security, governance and trust. This is one of Bloomberg's most exciting product areas, combining AI, enterprise software and workflow transformation.

The role

We're seeking a Product Manager to own AI capacity for Bloomberg's enterprise AI offering — how Bloomberg measures, packages and prices the storage and compute (tokens) behind ASKB as AI workflows scale. Reporting to the Team Lead for Enterprise AI, you'll own the capacity model end-to-end: the desktop allowance, enterprise tiers, the pooled-capacity model and priority in ASKB responses — together with the metering, monitoring and decision data behind every capacity and pricing decision.

You'll define how we measure and package capacity — turning it into a scalable product that grows with usage and gives firms clear, manageable control over what they consume.

Define the capacity model. Own capacity — storage and tokens — and how it's structured: the desktop allowance versus subscribed enterprise tiers and pooled capacity, and how priority works in ASKB responses. Decide how firms buy, share and manage capacity across their users.

Meter, monitor and forecast. Own how Bloomberg measures, monitors and alerts on consumption at user, workflow and firm level, and the accuracy of the monitoring and forecasting that capacity and pricing decisions depend on.

Power the inputs for commercials. Own the capacity product's inputs to pricing and packaging — cost per user, workflow category, token and schedule constraints — and, in partnership with the Enterprise AI Team Lead and Finance, shape how capacity is packaged and how firms subscribe to and manage additional pooled capacity, within the broader enterprise commercial model.

You'll work closely with ASKB engineering, Finance and enterprise product and data teams, translate capacity needs into detailed Product Requirement Documents, and partner with the central admin workstream so firm admins can see and manage what they consume.

We'll trust you to

Own the capacity model for Bloomberg's enterprise AI — storage and tokens, the desktop allowance, enterprise tiers, the pooled-capacity model, and how capacity priority works in ASKB responses.Define metering, monitoring and alerting on consumption at user, workflow and firm level, and own the accuracy of capacity monitoring and forecasting.Own the decision data behind capacity and tiered pricing — cost per user, workflow category, token and schedule constraints — and turn it into clear packaging and pricing recommendations.Shape the input data for capacity commercials in partnership with the Enterprise AI Team Lead and Finance — how capacity is packaged and priced and how firms subscribe to and manage additional pooled capacity — consistent with the broader enterprise commercial model.Translate capacity needs into detailed PRDs and requirements for ASKB engineering and metering teams.Surface capacity controls and usage visibility to firm admins, partnering with the central admin tooling workstream so firms can manage what they consume.Define capacity KPIs — utilisation versus allowance, overage and upsell, and subscription revenue from capacity tiers — and use telemetry to shape direction.Work directly with enterprise clients to understand how they consume and want to manage AI capacity, and validate the model against real firm behaviour.

You'll need to have

Strong product management experience within enterprise software, SaaS or AI enterprise platforms, including leading initiatives from concept through launch.Experience with usage-based, consumption or capacity-based products — metering, tiering, quotas or pooled entitlement models.Hands-on experience with AI / LLM-based products or infrastructure, with an understanding of tokens, compute and storage as cost drivers.Strong analytical and quantitative skills — comfortable modelling cost, consumption and unit economics from telemetry.A solid understanding of enterprise software administration, governance and entitlements.Experience authoring Product Requirement Documents and managing cross-functional roadmaps.The ability to partner with commercial and finance stakeholders on packaging and pricing while owning the underlying product.Outstanding written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance and Sales.

We'd love to see

Experience with the Bloomberg Terminal or Bloomberg Enterprise products.Experience pricing or metering AI / LLM usage and token-based cost models.Familiarity with SaaS commercial models — usage-based pricing, pooled entitlements, overage and tiering.Experience building metering, billing or capacity-management systems.Financial-modelling and unit-economics fluency.Domain fluency in financial markets and how regulated institutions evaluate technology.

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

rows.descriptionText:
Location

Business Area

Description & Requirements

We have a 12 month fixed term contract within our HR Position Management team. This is an ideal role if your friends all know you as someone that is very collaborative, process oriented, and a problem solver. You work well under pressure, and you thrive in a team environment. Discretion is something which comes naturally to you - you find that perfect balance between professional and personable. You're naturally curious by nature and love being the champion and catalyst for process improvement.

The Team

Our HR Position Management team works in partnership across HR centers of excellence to design and implement operational excellence delivering seamless people systems to Bloomberg's 20,000 employees globally. We partner with business units to drive process improvements to manage our talent lifecycle.

What's the role?

You will be a part of a team passionate about human capital operational excellence. The advocate for process improvement providing strategic insights through comprehensive and effective data governance standards and practices across all aspects of HR- related data collection, management and usage. You'll take ownership for the management and improvement of processes that directly impact data structures including Position Management and data required for Human Capital Measurement.

You'll be hands on with key stakeholders by educating, training, and guiding clients on self-service tools and how to utilize our systems to influence business and process improvements. rows.title: ConvergeHEALTH Life Sciences - Product Management & Strategy Manager - Innovation_Delivery_Transformation
rows.descriptionText:
The Team 

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation team is building the future of our business. This is the group responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and ultimately winning in new markets with new capabilities. We do not rely solely on what the firm has always done - we look to the future and invest where we believe growth will occur three, five, and ten years from now. The Innovation & Delivery Transformation team collaborates with Industries, Offering Portfolios, Growth, and Delivery Transformation to curate and scale our Innovation Portfolio, grow through our Strategic Growth Offerings, identify and incubate the next generation of technology through our Technology Offices, and more. We are also dedicated to fostering a leading talent experience within I&DT and across the firm.

The core focus of this role is the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. The Market Access AI platform is Converge for Life Sciences' initiative reimagining how life sciences companies manage payer contracting, formulary compliance, and gross-to-net performance by replacing fragmented manual processes with intelligent workflows built to scale.

Position Summary

As a Product Manager for Market Access AI, you will shape the strategic direction of a next-generation market access platform that is transforming how pharmaceutical and biotech commercial organizations operate. Sitting at the intersection of industry expertise and product vision, you will collaborate with the practice leaders in market access domain to shape where the product goes and why - driving measurable impact for life sciences companies navigating an increasingly complex payer landscape.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/26.

Work you'll do

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:

Own and evolve the multi-horizon product roadmap for the Market Access AI platform, balancing near-term user needs with long-term market differentiation. Define and prioritize strategic bets across market access capabilities - spanning payer contract lifecycle management, agentic formulary validation, rebate compliance, GTN forecasting, copay program oversight, and script-level profitability analytics. Synthesize market signals, user feedback, competitive intelligence, and emerging AI trends into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership. Establish and maintain a product vision and narrative that aligns cross-functional teams - engineering, data science, UX, and go-to-market - around a shared north star. 

Market & Client Insight:

Conduct ongoing market research and competitive landscape analysis across the market access technology, managed markets, and life sciences commercial operations space. Build and maintain deep understanding of life science market access workflows - from pre-deal modeling and contract development through post-deal pull-through, rebate adjudication, and formulary monitoring - to ensure the product strategy addresses real, high-value pain points. Engage with current and prospective clients to validate strategic hypotheses and uncover unmet needs. Partner with functional SMEs and product owners to translate domain expertise and user insights into strategic product priorities. 

Go-to-Market & Commercial Enablement:

Collaborate with Deloitte practice leaders to define the go-to-market strategy for new platform capabilities, including positioning, messaging, and launch sequencing in partnership with marketing and sales leadership. Develop the product's value proposition and competitive differentiation narrative for use in pursuits, RFP responses, and executive briefings. Support high-priority sales cycles by providing strategic framing and credible industry context to differentiate the Market Access AI platform against competing solutions. Identify and evaluate partnership, integration, and ecosystem opportunities - across contract management systems, rebate platforms, formulary data providers, and syndicated payer data - that expand the platform's strategic value and market reach. 

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

Cross-Functional Leadership:

Act as a strategic thought partner to Product Management, Engineering, UX, and Delivery leaders, ensuring strategic intent is preserved through execution. Facilitate strategic planning sessions, roadmap reviews, and prioritization forums with senior stakeholders across Deloitte and ConvergeHEALTH. Contribute to practice-building efforts, including points of view, whitepapers, and conference presentations, to establish Deloitte as a thought leader in AI-driven market access transformation. Leverage rapid prototyping and AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Lovable, N8N) to bring strategic concepts to life as demonstrable ideas that accelerate alignment and feedback. 

Qualifications

Required: 

Bachelor's degree (Master's degree preferred) in life sciences, health economics, business strategy, computational biology, or related field. 4-5 years of experience working as an employee of a life sciences company (pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical products). 3-5 years of combined experience in Life Science market access environments and product management, management consulting, or technology product roles. Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software product organization in the life sciences, health tech, or pharmaceutical commercial operations space. Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate product strategy - including market sizing, competitive positioning, and roadmap rationale - to senior audiences. Deep familiarity with pharmaceutical market access workflows - including pre-deal modeling, deal strategy, contract development, contract execution, post-deal pull-through, and rebate adjudication. Proficiency with the key data assets that power market access decisions, including formulary and PDL data, covered lives, rebate and chargeback transaction data, GTN waterfall components (WAC, rebates, Medicaid best price, 340B, copay), script-level claims (e.g., IQVIA LAAD, Symphony Health), copay voucher data, hub and patient enrollment data, and syndicated benchmarks (e.g., SSR Health, CMS MDRP). Proven track record of synthesizing complex inputs (market data, user research, business context) into clear, actionable strategic recommendations. Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. 

Preferred:

Familiarity with AI/ML applications in market access operations, including automated contract compliance, formulary validation, and rebate leakage detection in pharmaceutical commercial environments. Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts and applications, including the use of AI agents to automate complex workflows, orchestrate multi-step market access processes, and enable autonomous decision-making in commercial operations. Comfort with modern data and cloud concepts (AWS or equivalent) sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams.

rows.title: Senior Director, Expert Services
rows.descriptionText:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.

From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.

10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.

But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.

If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.

Find us on Instagram: @optimizely

Introduction

The Senior Director of Technical Account Management (TAM) and Subscription Services is a strategic leadership role within Expert Services with a clear north star: driving product GRR (gross revenue retention) and NRR (net revenue retention). Everything this role builds - the go-to-market strategy, packaging, pricing, team, and delivery model - exists to ensure customers adopt, retain, and expand their use of Optimizely's product portfolio. This is not a services-for-services'-sake role; it's a product retention and expansion engine delivered through subscription-based technical engagements.

As Optimizely's product portfolio expands - including the rapid growth of Opal AI and agentic capabilities - this role will ensure the TAM and subscription services model evolves in lockstep with the business, creating new service tiers, defining delivery frameworks, and scaling operations globally. A critical part of this role is partnering with regional Customer Success and Sales leaders to make subscription services a natural, embedded part of the sales process for strategic accounts - directly contributing to the company's ability to retain and grow product revenue. The ideal candidate is equal parts strategist, operator, and people leader who understands that recurring technical services are the lever that moves product GRR and NRR.

We're looking for someone with a strong management consulting or advisory background - the kind of structured, analytical thinking you develop at firms like Deloitte, Accenture, McKinsey, or similar. You know how to build a business case, design a service offering from scratch, and bring the rigor of consulting methodology to an in-house leadership role. You've likely transitioned from consulting into SaaS services leadership and understand how to apply that foundation to drive scalable, repeatable outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Go-to-market strategy, packaging, and pricing

Own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for TAM and subscription services, including positioning, packaging, and pricing across all tiers (Essential, Enhanced, Advanced). Continuously refine service packages based on market feedback, competitive benchmarking, and customer adoption data - always optimizing for the packages that most directly improve product retention and expansion. Build and maintain financial models and business cases for new service offerings, applying the structured analytical approach expected of a consulting-caliber leader. Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to align pricing models with Optimizely's broader commercial strategy and GTM motion. Develop sales enablement materials, scoping guides, and ROI frameworks that make it simple for Account Executives to position and close subscription services deals within 24 hours. 

Scaling the business and driving adoption

Build and execute a scalable operating model for TAM and subscription services delivery, balancing dedicated and shared engagement models across customer segments and deal sizes. Own the P&L for the TAM and subscription services practice, including revenue targets, margin management, utilization, and headcount planning. Define and track key performance indicators with product GRR and NRR as the primary north star metrics. Secondary KPIs include subscription services attach rate, product adoption scores, customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS), time-to-value, and churn correlation analysis linking TAM engagement to retention outcomes. Drive predictable, recurring revenue growth by expanding subscription services penetration across the installed base and embedding TAM and subscription services into multi-product and platform deals - with a direct line of sight to how each engagement improves product G RR and N RR. Partner with regional Customer Success and Sales leaders to ensure the subscription services motion is a natural part of the sales process for strategic accounts - driving growth, expansion, and long-term customer value through proactive service attach. Partner with regional delivery leaders across North America, EMEA, and APJ to ensure consistent service quality and capacity planning at a global scale. 

Strategic advisory and product value realization

Establish a customer engagement methodology anchored in scoping, planning, and optimization cycles - designed to systematically increase product adoption, reduce churn risk, and create measurable uplift in GRR and NRR. Define the subscription services strategic advisory framework: capability reviews, solution architecture assessments, program governance, and maturity model progression. Embed Opal AI adoption into the subscription services motion - ensuring TAMs identify high-impact AI use cases, conduct enablement sessions, design agent workflows, and surface expansion opportunities. Act as the voice of the customer back into Product and Engineering, providing structured feedback on platform gaps, feature requests, and adoption blockers. Create a competitive moat by ensuring customers receive ongoing strategic and technical value that deepens platform adoption, strengthens product stickiness, and directly reduces logo and revenue churn. 

Knowledge And Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technical account management, professional services, customer success, or solutions consulting within SaaS, digital experience, or enterprise software. 4+ years in a leadership role with direct responsibility for building or scaling a recurring services business, including go-to-market strategy, service design, packaging, and pricing. Proven track record of owning or significantly influencing a services P&L, with demonstrable evidence that your work directly improved product GRR and NRR - not just services revenue in isolation. Strong consulting or advisory background - you've worked at a top-tier management consulting firm (e.g., Deloitte, Accenture, McKinsey, BCG, PwC, EY, KPMG, Bain) or can demonstrate equivalent consulting rigor through advisory or professional services leadership. Deep understanding of the martech and digital experience ecosystem, with hands-on familiarity across CMS, experimentation, content management, and AI-driven tools. Experience designing and operationalizing tiered service models (shared, dedicated, and specialist overlays) across multiple geographies. Exceptional executive presence with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders - both internally and with enterprise customers. Data-driven mindset with fluency in building business cases, financial models, and using customer health analytics to inform strategy. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field required. 

Education

Bachelors or higher equivalent

Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

rows.descriptionText:
Position Summary

The Experience Design Strategy Manager is a client-facing consulting leader who delivers experience design strategy engagements for Life Sciences clients. This role combines experience design strategy, digital product fluency, consulting execution, and Life Sciences commercial knowledge to help clients improve patient, provider, and business outcomes. The manager works across strategy and delivery to turn research, data, and business needs into actionable experience solutions.

Recruiting for this role ends on November 1, 2026

Work you'll do

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable shaping experience vision and driving cross-functional execution through launch and adoption. You will work across strategy, design, product, and engineering to ensure concepts become real, measurable solutions, used by patients and/or providers in production.

As a Manager, you will be responsible for:

Translating business and user challenges into structured design strategies, insights, product visions, roadmaps, release priorities, and measurable outcomes Connecting experience strategy to digital product delivery by aligning design intent with epics, features, user stories, MVP definitions, and delivery plans that product and engineering teams can execute Partner closely with product, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to move from concept through build, launch, and iteration. Guide teams in prioritization, trade-off decisions, dependency management, and release planning to drive delivery with speed and clarity. Understand which AI-enabled tools and modern ways of working can accelerate research synthesis, concept development, and product planning and champion usage. Managing client relationships, facilitating working sessions, and overseeing scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies across design workstreamsSupporting practice growth through proposals, solution shaping, workplans, and team coachingChampion and advocate for the role of design both with clients and while coaching and developing teams

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to stretch from framing ambiguous business problems through roadmap definition, build planning, launch through close collaboration with design, product and engineering leaders Agile product delivery practices to align user value, business value, and technical feasibility throughout execution. Experience overseeing roadmap creation, backlog shaping, prototyping, MVP scoping, and release planning. Strong executive storytelling and team leadership

rows.title: Summer DDA Associate - 2027
rows.descriptionText:
About L.E.K. Consulting  

L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.

How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us.

Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.

Job Description

If you are a bright, motivated undergraduate student graduating in 2028 and interested in applying data science to complex business problems, consider joining L.E.K. as a Summer Associate within our Digital, Data, & AI (DDA) team.

The internship kicks off with a week of training with peers from all of our U.S. offices, where you will learn the fundamentals of what it takes to be a successful Associate at L.E.K. At the conclusion of training, you will spend the next ~8 weeks in your home office doing real DDA casework as a part of a team.

Responsibilities

As a Summer DDA Associate, you will gain hands-on experience as a Data Scientist intern within our DDA team. You will be dedicated 100% to a single project and can expect to be on 1-2 projects over the course of the summer. You will be staffed on client case teams alongside L.E.K. Consultants and Data Scientists, applying advanced analytics and data science techniques to solve complex business problems. While casework varies every day, a Summer DDA Associate’s primary responsibilities typically include:

Acquire, clean, manipulate and analyze structured and unstructured data Conduct exploratory analysis and develop statistical and machine-learning models Validate analytical approaches and translate outputs into meaningful business insights Create visualizations that communicate complex findings clearly Collaborate with Consultants and Data Scientists to translate client questions into analytical approaches Contribute findings to case-team discussions, written presentations and client deliverables 

L.E.K. Offers Associates The Broadest Range Of Fast-paced, High-impact, And Diverse Cases For Maximum Learning. In Addition, You Can Expect To Participate In The Following Throughout The Summer

Weekly check-in meetings with your case team Manager to discuss your experience and feedback Professional development sessions, including sector introductory lunches A program of formal mentoring Fun social events with the entire office 

L.E.K. offers Summer DDA Associates very competitive compensation and benefits. High-performing Summer DDA Associates may be considered for opportunities to return to L.E.K. as full-time members of the DDA team following graduation, along with additional bonus incentives.

WHY L.E.K.? 

The Summer DDA Associate role at L.E.K. is differentiated from other firms in several key ways:

Immediate technical responsibility: Apply data science to live client problems from the beginning. Business impact: Work at the intersection of advanced analytics and strategy, with analyses directly informing client decisions. Breadth of problems: Apply data science across industries, datasets and business questions rather than working on one product/problem. Integrated teams: Work alongside consultants and DDA specialists, building both technical and commercial problem-solving skills. Development: Receive regular feedback, mentorship and exposure to L.E.K.'s broader consulting environment. 

Qualifications

We do not use a rigid checklist – L.E.K. hires Summer DDA Associates with backgrounds in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics, or other quantitative disciplines.

Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate

A strong foundation in applied data science, including machine learning, generative AI/LLM and agentic AI applications, statistical modeling and analysis Proficiency in Python, common data science and AI/ML libraries and SQL Experience working with data across the analytical lifecycle, including data acquisition, cleaning and manipulation, exploratory analysis, model development and validation, and visualization Strong problem-solving and communication skills, including the ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and explain technical findings clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences Strong academic achievement, initiative, intellectual curiosity and ability to collaborate effectively 

Additional Information

The expected salary for this position is $1,850 weekly during the course of the summer internship. This role follows our hybrid work model for U.S. offices. rows.title: Research Engineer — Post-Training & Small Language Models (SLMs), Healthcare AI
rows.descriptionText:
Research Engineer - Post-Training & Small Language Models (SLMs), Healthcare AI

Three hundred fifty million Americans rely on a healthcare system whose decision-making has become slow, costly, and adversarial - care delayed by prior authorization and paperwork, claims that misfire, clinical decisions made without the right information at the right moment, and patients who struggle to navigate or afford the care they need. Deloitte has a new AI-first effort,, backed by $1B in committed investment, building the reasoning models and agentic systems to rebuild how that system decides - across payers, providers, and life sciences, and for the patients they serve - so that care is faster, fairer, and far less wasteful. This is not AI applied at the margins. It is a ground-up rebuild of the decision-making machinery behind American healthcare, at national scale.

This is resourced to do real post-training at scale - committed investment in GPU compute and training infrastructure, not toy fine-tunes.

As a Research Engineer on our post-training team, you will design, train, evaluate, and align the models that reason about healthcare - working across the full post-training lifecycle to shape model behavior for clinical and operational decisioning across the industry. Healthcare decisioning is one of the cleanest verifiable-reward domains outside math and code: the problems are hard. We ground that reward in real signals - clinical policy and criteria, adjudicated outcomes, and clinical-expert judgment - so correctness is checkable rather than asserted.

You will own the post-training stack for our clinical reasoning models end to end - from data and reward design through trained, evaluated models that ship. This is not a prompt-engineering role. We are looking for people who understand not just how to use LLMs, but how to improve and shape model behavior through advanced post-training.

You do not need a healthcare background. We pair every engineer with clinical and domain experts and teach you the domain - you bring the modeling depth.

We hire on demonstrated depth, not years - the level you join at is determined through our interview process, based on the depth and judgment you demonstrate, not your years in a title.

Work you'll do

Post-training & alignment

 Design and execute post-training pipelines: supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, and reinforcement learning / alignment workflows. Build and optimize training using techniques such as SFT, RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, RLAIF, and Constitutional AI, and understand how each affects reasoning quality, safety, latency, cost, and reliability. Train reasoning models for healthcare decisioning using verifiable-reward RL - designing reward signals and verifiers grounded in clinical guidelines, policy and criteria, and adjudicated outcomes.

Reward modeling & data

 Develop reward models and preference datasets to improve reasoning quality, factuality, safety, policy adherence, and task performance. Curate, clean, synthesize, and evaluate large-scale instruction, preference, and domain-specific datasets, with rigorous filtering, deduplication, and quality control. Build verification and reward pipelines from our proprietary clinical, claims, and operational data and from clinical-expert labeling - turning guidelines, policy, and adjudicated outcomes into checkable reward signals at scale.

Efficient fine-tuning, training & inference infrastructure

 Implement efficient fine-tuning strategies including LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, and adapter-based approaches; build scalable distributed training using DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, Ray, or equivalent. Optimize inference performance - latency, throughput, quantization, and deployment efficiency - for production, including frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or TGI.

Small language models & open-weight models

 Train and optimize open-weight models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or DeepSeek; build specialized small language models (SLMs) for on-premise and cloud-hybrid deployment with strong performance-per-dollar.

Evaluation, safety & red teaming

 Design evaluation frameworks covering reasoning, hallucination detection, factuality, instruction following, structured outputs, and domain-specific metrics. Build healthcare-grade evaluation - held-out clinical benchmarks, deployment regression gates, calibration and uncertainty, factuality against ground truth, and bias/fairness evaluation across patient populations and subgroups - co-designed with clinical experts. Apply PHI/HIPAA-aware data handling and produce model documentation suitable for regulated clinical use. Perform red teaming and adversarial testing to identify alignment failures, unsafe behaviors, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and regression risks; collaborate with agentic and application teams to improve tool use, grounding, and long-horizon reasoning.

The team

Deloitte brings together AI researchers, modeling and platform engineers, architects, clinical and domain specialists, and product leaders to build, deploy, and operate verticalized AI systems across software, data, models, and cloud infrastructure - engineered for one of the most complex operating environments in the world. The work spans the healthcare industry - payers, providers, and life sciences - and involves genuinely hard reasoning problems, nuanced operational workflows, and a high bar for reliability, with little tolerance for shallow or unreliable outputs. We pair frontier AI research with production-grade engineering, and we ship into real clinical and operational settings rather than leaving models in the lab.

You can go deep. The team sub-specializes across post-training research, data and reward engineering, and training and inference infrastructure - you won't be expected to own all of it alone.

Qualifications - Required Skills And Experience

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Computational Linguistics, or a related field. Demonstrated depth training and post-training large transformer-based language models in production or research - this is your craft, not coursework or a one-off fine-tune. Genuine depth including SFT and at least one preference-optimization or RL method, evidenced by shipped models, releases, or research. Hands-on experience with reasoning-model training and/or verifiable-reward (RLVR) workflows. Strong understanding of modern post-training techniques: SFT, RLHF, PPO, DPO, GRPO, RLAIF, and preference optimization workflows. Experience with open-weight foundation models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, or equivalent architectures. Strong expertise in PyTorch and modern deep-learning tooling; experience with distributed training frameworks such as DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM, or Ray. Experience implementing efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, and quantization-aware workflows. Deep understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization, attention mechanisms, decoding strategies, and model scaling trade-offs. Strong grasp of LLM evaluation methodologies, benchmarking, reward modeling, and alignment trade-offs; experience with large-scale and synthetic datasets, filtering, deduplication, and quality-control pipelines. Strong Python engineering skills and production-grade software practices; ability to work through ambiguous, highly complex technical problems in fast-moving environments. Ability to travel 0-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Qualifications - Required Skills And Experience

 Experience building or optimizing reasoning models, agentic models, or tool-using LLM systems. Familiarity with inference optimization frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Ollama. Experience with multimodal models, speech models, or domain-specific foundation models; experience using large-scale GPU clusters and distributed compute. Contributions to open-source AI projects, research publications, benchmark development, or model releases. Familiarity with safety, governance, and responsible-AI practices; experience in regulated or high-stakes industries such as healthcare, finance, insurance, or public sector.\
