rows.descriptionText:
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value.
At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.
Who You’ll Work WithAt Slalom, we co-create custom software, data, AI, and cloud solutions with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We are passionate about technology and its potential to create better products, experiences, and organizations.
Our Data Architecture & Engineering team sees data as the foundation for decision-making, artificial intelligence, and transformation. You may work with cross-platform data engineering teams or with one of our centers of excellence that specializes in a particular ecosystem. Slalom works across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Databricks, and Snowflake, along with the technologies that support each platform.
Expertise across every platform is not required. Your current skills, delivery experience, and areas of interest will help determine which team and client opportunities are the best fit, while giving you room to expand your capabilities over time.
What You’ll DoAs a Data Engineer at Slalom, you will collaborate with clients, architects, and multidisciplinary delivery teams to design, build, and operationalize scalable data solutions. Your work may include:Designing and implementing cloud-native data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, and data products.Building reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, integrations, and orchestration workflows.Translating business and technical requirements into maintainable engineering solutions and actionable development tasks.Developing solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake ecosystems based on client needs and your areas of expertise.Applying software engineering practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, documentation, and secure development.Using AI-enabled engineering approaches and tools to improve delivery speed, quality, testing, documentation, and maintainability, with appropriate human review and responsible use.Designing, building, and operationalizing governed data platforms that support analytics, AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic workloads.Enabling data quality, metadata, lineage, security, privacy, governance, performance, reliability, and cost-effective operations.Participating in technical discovery, design sessions, code reviews, demonstrations, and knowledge sharing with clients and colleagues.Contributing to reusable patterns, accelerators, and engineering communities within Slalom. What You’ll BringWe welcome candidates with different combinations of experience. You do not need every skill listed below to be successful in this role. We are interested in the depth of your experience, your learning mindset, and the areas where you want to grow.Hands-on experience designing, building, testing, deploying, or supporting production data engineering solutions.Experience with at least one major cloud or data platform, such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, or Snowflake. Experience across multiple platforms is valued but not required. Proficiency in programming languages such as SQL, Python, Java and or Scala. Experience with several modern data engineering capabilities, such as data modeling, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, lakehouse architectures, streaming, APIs, orchestration, or data platform modernization. Familiarity with relevant technologies, which may include Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Dagster, Azure Data Factory, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Dataplex, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Kinesis, Kubernetes, Terraform, or comparable tools. Understanding of how high-quality, secure, governed, and observable data foundations support AI, ML, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic solutions.Experience with AI-enabled or agentic engineering practices, including using AI-assisted development tools and designing data workflows or platforms that can support intelligent agents and automated decision workflows.A commitment to responsible engineering, including privacy, security, transparency, testing, monitoring, and appropriate human oversight for AI-enabled solutions.Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with an ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences.A curious, growth-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and delivery approaches.
Additional Experience That May Be HelpfulCloud, Databricks, or Snowflake certifications.Experience in consulting or in client-facing, cross-functional delivery teams.Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, vector databases, model or prompt monitoring, feature stores, semantic layers, or AI platform operations.Experience modernizing legacy data environments or migrating workloads to cloud platforms.Experience mentoring others or contributing to technical communities and reusable assets.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 
Hybrid/In office: We are hybrid and require that you live within a commutable distance to a Slalom location. If your team leader or client requires you to be onsite, there are expectations that you can meet those requirements.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this Consultant role, we are hiring at the following targeted base pay salary ranges:  
Boston, New York: $100,000 - $122,000
All other locations: $100,000 - $115,000
 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. 
 We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.title: Senior User Experience Designer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Associate Consultant – Senior User Experience Designer

The ZS Digital Experience and Design (DXD) practice was created to champion design in the creation of compelling, innovative and outcomes-focused experiences, services and products. Our clients look to us to design and create engaging experiences and solutions for a broad range of B2B or B2C customers, with a focus on healthcare providers, physicians, and patients. We use our deep understanding of people to design meaningful interactions and desirable outcomes for customers, while delivering better performance for our clients.

Role Overview: 

As a Senior User Experience Designer, you will lead key workstreams in designing and delivering AI-powered digital products, predictive analytics interfaces, and enterprise-scale healthcare solutions. You’ll guide experience strategy, translate research into scalable GenAI design patterns, and meaningfully shape client conversations. You will also leverage AI design tooling to speed up workflows—from research synthesis to ideation to prototyping.

What you'll do:

Lead the design of AI-driven product workflows, such as agentic task flows, adaptive dashboards, conversational interactions, and predictive insight delivery. Translate complex business and analytics requirements into clean, extensible interaction patterns and high-fidelity designs. Collaborate directly with clients to define the role of AI, clarify requirements, and align on experience direction. Conduct or support generative and evaluative research, synthesizing insights into actionable experience strategies. Use AI fluently across the design process — from early research synthesis and concept exploration through to design-to-code workflows that bridge design and front-end delivery.Guide junior designers on best practices for designing AI-enabled experiences and applying AI tools responsibly. Drive the evolution of project-level design systems incorporating GenAI-specific components. Work within client-facing teams to solve design problems with creative thinking and design reviews. Facilitate workshops and design sprints focused on validating AI-infused prototypes and concepts. 

What you’ll bring:

Bachelor's degree required, with a demonstrated record of academic success. Preferred fields include Human-Computer Interaction or Human Factors; design disciplines such as design strategy, service design or cognitive science are also strongly considered.5+ years designing complex digital products, ideally in analytics, enterprise systems, or AI-driven solutions. Consulting experience strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience leading end to end product design — translating ambiguous business and user needs into well-defined problems, and driving the design through to launched solutions.Proficiency designing for GenAI and AI-powered experiences, including chat UX, recommendations, decision-support, and multi-step agentic flows. Actively uses AI as a core part of their design process — across research synthesis, ideation, prototyping, and visual exploration — and stays current as the tooling evolves.A strong plus: demonstrated experience in design engineering (design-to-code, AI dev tools, front-end collaboration) or hybrid design/PM work — shaping roadmaps, owning product decisions, and connecting user needs to business strategy.Strong capability to structure ambiguous problem spaces and drive clarity through design. Experience mentoring designers and contributing to design system governance. Strong consulting and communication skills — able to synthesize feedback, articulate design decisions, manage project tasks, and confidently engage clients as an advocate for user-centered design.Familiarity with healthcare, pharma, or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.

A strong portfolio is required, demonstrating your full design process from problem definition through to solution — final screens alone are not sufficient.

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.

KPMG is currently seeking a Manager to join our KPMG Strategy practice.

Responsibilities :

Assist with selling and delivering client engagements for corporate and private equity clients with significant transactions including acquisitions and divestitures with operational focus on the finance & accounting functionWork with KPMGs M&A Services teams on F&A engagements and/or work streams, focusing on full range of finance and accounting activities at the clientsWork with KPMG teams including financial due diligence, accounting advisory services, transaction tax, management consulting financial management, enterprise system, risk consulting and treasury servicesAssist with selling, and delivering client engagements for corporate and private equity groups with significant transactions including acquisitions and divestitures with operational focus on the finance & accounting function

Qualifications :

Minimum of five years of experience providing accounting and management consulting services to corporate and/or private equity clients as part of a major consulting/advisory firm or applicable or minimum of five years financial reporting and consolidations experience with a Fortune 500 organization; experience to include large project management, supporting business development, and developing and maintaining good client relationships at the Finance functional levelBachelor's degree from an accredited college/university in an appropriate field; licensed CPA or MBA a plus Significant Operational M&A transaction experience in all phases of the deal lifecycle from pre-signing to post-close operations; must have extensive hands-on experience assisting with the operational details of transactions both pre- and post-close; experience with international transactions desirableProven performance with project management, process analysis, process redesign, financial systems, analytics, and financial analysis required; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills are requiredSignificant experience with the finance and accounting function of large complex organizationsSolid experience with F&A sub-functions including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Internal AuditKnowledge and experience with transition service agreements (TSAs), charts of accounts, shared services and Day 1 readiness is desiredWillingness and ability to travelMust be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

KPMG LLP and its affiliates and subsidiaries (“KPMG”) complies with all local/state regulations regarding displaying salary ranges. If required, the ranges displayed below or via the URL below are specifically for those potential hires who will work in the location(s) listed. Any offered salary is determined based on relevant factors such as applicant's skills, job responsibilities, prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications and market considerations. In addition, KPMG is proud to offer a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, with options designed to help you make the best decisions for yourself, your family, and your lifestyle. Available benefits are based on eligibility. Our Total Rewards package includes a variety of medical and dental plans, vision coverage, disability and life insurance, 401(k) plans, and a robust suite of personal well-being benefits to support your mental health. Depending on job classification, standard work hours, and years of service, KPMG provides Personal Time Off per fiscal year. Additionally, each year KPMG publishes a calendar of holidays to be observed during the year and provides eligible employees two breaks each year where employees will not be required to use Personal Time Off; one is at year end and the other is around the July 4th holiday. Additional details about our benefits can be found towards the bottom of our KPMG US Careers site at Benefits & How We Work.

Follow this link to obtain salary ranges by city outside of CA:

https://kpmg.com/us/en/how-we-work/pay-transparency.html/?id=M111DAS_3_26

KPMG offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. KPMG is an equal opportunity employer. KPMG complies with all applicable federal, state and local laws regarding recruitment and hiring. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The attached link contains further information regarding KPMG's compliance with federal, state and local recruitment and hiring laws. No phone calls or agencies please.

KPMG recruits on a rolling basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) for which they are qualified that is also of interest to them.

Los Angeles County applicants: Material job duties for this position are listed above. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness, and safeguard business operations and company reputation. Pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

rows.title: Data Engineer - East Region
rows.descriptionText:
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value.
At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.
Who You’ll Work WithAt Slalom, we co-create custom software, data, AI, and cloud solutions with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We are passionate about technology and its potential to create better products, experiences, and organizations.
Our Data Architecture & Engineering team sees data as the foundation for decision-making, artificial intelligence, and transformation. You may work with cross-platform data engineering teams or with one of our centers of excellence that specializes in a particular ecosystem. Slalom works across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Databricks, and Snowflake, along with the technologies that support each platform.
Expertise across every platform is not required. Your current skills, delivery experience, and areas of interest will help determine which team and client opportunities are the best fit, while giving you room to expand your capabilities over time.
What You’ll DoAs a Data Engineer at Slalom, you will collaborate with clients, architects, and multidisciplinary delivery teams to design, build, and operationalize scalable data solutions. Your work may include:Designing and implementing cloud-native data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, and data products.Building reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, integrations, and orchestration workflows.Translating business and technical requirements into maintainable engineering solutions and actionable development tasks.Developing solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake ecosystems based on client needs and your areas of expertise.Applying software engineering practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, documentation, and secure development.Using AI-enabled engineering approaches and tools to improve delivery speed, quality, testing, documentation, and maintainability, with appropriate human review and responsible use.Designing, building, and operationalizing governed data platforms that support analytics, AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic workloads.Enabling data quality, metadata, lineage, security, privacy, governance, performance, reliability, and cost-effective operations.Participating in technical discovery, design sessions, code reviews, demonstrations, and knowledge sharing with clients and colleagues.Contributing to reusable patterns, accelerators, and engineering communities within Slalom. What You’ll BringWe welcome candidates with different combinations of experience. You do not need every skill listed below to be successful in this role. We are interested in the depth of your experience, your learning mindset, and the areas where you want to grow.Hands-on experience designing, building, testing, deploying, or supporting production data engineering solutions.Experience with at least one major cloud or data platform, such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, or Snowflake. Experience across multiple platforms is valued but not required. Proficiency in programming languages such as SQL, Python, Java and or Scala. Experience with several modern data engineering capabilities, such as data modeling, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, lakehouse architectures, streaming, APIs, orchestration, or data platform modernization. Familiarity with relevant technologies, which may include Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Dagster, Azure Data Factory, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Dataplex, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Kinesis, Kubernetes, Terraform, or comparable tools. Understanding of how high-quality, secure, governed, and observable data foundations support AI, ML, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic solutions.Experience with AI-enabled or agentic engineering practices, including using AI-assisted development tools and designing data workflows or platforms that can support intelligent agents and automated decision workflows.A commitment to responsible engineering, including privacy, security, transparency, testing, monitoring, and appropriate human oversight for AI-enabled solutions.Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with an ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences.A curious, growth-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and delivery approaches.
Additional Experience That May Be HelpfulCloud, Databricks, or Snowflake certifications.Experience in consulting or in client-facing, cross-functional delivery teams.Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, vector databases, model or prompt monitoring, feature stores, semantic layers, or AI platform operations.Experience modernizing legacy data environments or migrating workloads to cloud platforms.Experience mentoring others or contributing to technical communities and reusable assets.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 
Hybrid/In office: We are hybrid and require that you live within a commutable distance to a Slalom location. If your team leader or client requires you to be onsite, there are expectations that you can meet those requirements.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this Consultant role, we are hiring at the following targeted base pay salary ranges:  
Boston, New York: $100,000 - $122,000
All other locations: $100,000 - $115,000
 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. 
 We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.title: Manager, Transaction Strategy (Finance)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.

KPMG is currently seeking a Manager to join our KPMG Strategy practice.

Responsibilities :

Assist with selling and delivering client engagements for corporate and private equity clients with significant transactions including acquisitions and divestitures with operational focus on the finance & accounting functionWork with KPMGs M&A Services teams on F&A engagements and/or work streams, focusing on full range of finance and accounting activities at the clientsWork with KPMG teams including financial due diligence, accounting advisory services, transaction tax, management consulting financial management, enterprise system, risk consulting and treasury servicesAssist with selling, and delivering client engagements for corporate and private equity groups with significant transactions including acquisitions and divestitures with operational focus on the finance & accounting function

Qualifications :

Minimum of five years of experience providing accounting and management consulting services to corporate and/or private equity clients as part of a major consulting/advisory firm or applicable or minimum of five years financial reporting and consolidations experience with a Fortune 500 organization; experience to include large project management, supporting business development, and developing and maintaining good client relationships at the Finance functional levelBachelor's degree from an accredited college/university in an appropriate field; licensed CPA or MBA a plus Significant Operational M&A transaction experience in all phases of the deal lifecycle from pre-signing to post-close operations; must have extensive hands-on experience assisting with the operational details of transactions both pre- and post-close; experience with international transactions desirableProven performance with project management, process analysis, process redesign, financial systems, analytics, and financial analysis required; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills are requiredSignificant experience with the finance and accounting function of large complex organizationsSolid experience with F&A sub-functions including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Internal AuditKnowledge and experience with transition service agreements (TSAs), charts of accounts, shared services and Day 1 readiness is desiredWillingness and ability to travelMust be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

KPMG LLP and its affiliates and subsidiaries (“KPMG”) complies with all local/state regulations regarding displaying salary ranges. If required, the ranges displayed below or via the URL below are specifically for those potential hires who will work in the location(s) listed. Any offered salary is determined based on relevant factors such as applicant's skills, job responsibilities, prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications and market considerations. In addition, KPMG is proud to offer a comprehensive, competitive benefits package, with options designed to help you make the best decisions for yourself, your family, and your lifestyle. Available benefits are based on eligibility. Our Total Rewards package includes a variety of medical and dental plans, vision coverage, disability and life insurance, 401(k) plans, and a robust suite of personal well-being benefits to support your mental health. Depending on job classification, standard work hours, and years of service, KPMG provides Personal Time Off per fiscal year. Additionally, each year KPMG publishes a calendar of holidays to be observed during the year and provides eligible employees two breaks each year where employees will not be required to use Personal Time Off; one is at year end and the other is around the July 4th holiday. Additional details about our benefits can be found towards the bottom of our KPMG US Careers site at Benefits & How We Work.

Follow this link to obtain salary ranges by city outside of CA:

https://kpmg.com/us/en/how-we-work/pay-transparency.html/?id=M111DAS_3_26

KPMG offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. KPMG is an equal opportunity employer. KPMG complies with all applicable federal, state and local laws regarding recruitment and hiring. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The attached link contains further information regarding KPMG's compliance with federal, state and local recruitment and hiring laws. No phone calls or agencies please.

KPMG recruits on a rolling basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) for which they are qualified that is also of interest to them.

Los Angeles County applicants: Material job duties for this position are listed above. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness, and safeguard business operations and company reputation. Pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

KPMG is currently seeking a Manager to join our KPMG Strategy practice.

Responsibilities :

Minimum of five years of experience providing accounting and management consulting services to corporate and/or private equity clients as part of a major consulting/advisory firm or applicable or minimum of five years financial reporting and consolidations experience with a Fortune 500 organization; experience to include large project management, supporting business development, and developing and maintaining good client relationships at the Finance functional levelBachelor's degree from an accredited college/university in an appropriate field; licensed CPA or MBA a plusSignificant Operational M&A transaction experience in all phases of the deal lifecycle from pre-signing to post-close operations; must have extensive hands-on experience assisting with the operational details of transactions both pre- and post-close; experience with international transactions desirableProven performance with project management, process analysis, process redesign, financial systems, analytics, and financial analysis required; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills are requiredSignificant experience with the finance and accounting function of large complex organizationsSolid experience with F&A sub-functions including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and Internal AuditKnowledge and experience with transition service agreements (TSAs), charts of accounts, shared services and Day 1 readiness is desiredWillingness and ability to travelMust be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

rows.title: Data Engineer - East Region
rows.descriptionText:
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value.
At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.
Who You’ll Work WithAt Slalom, we co-create custom software, data, AI, and cloud solutions with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We are passionate about technology and its potential to create better products, experiences, and organizations.
Our Data Architecture & Engineering team sees data as the foundation for decision-making, artificial intelligence, and transformation. You may work with cross-platform data engineering teams or with one of our centers of excellence that specializes in a particular ecosystem. Slalom works across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Databricks, and Snowflake, along with the technologies that support each platform.
Expertise across every platform is not required. Your current skills, delivery experience, and areas of interest will help determine which team and client opportunities are the best fit, while giving you room to expand your capabilities over time.
What You’ll DoAs a Data Engineer at Slalom, you will collaborate with clients, architects, and multidisciplinary delivery teams to design, build, and operationalize scalable data solutions. Your work may include:Designing and implementing cloud-native data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, and data products.Building reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, integrations, and orchestration workflows.Translating business and technical requirements into maintainable engineering solutions and actionable development tasks.Developing solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake ecosystems based on client needs and your areas of expertise.Applying software engineering practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, documentation, and secure development.Using AI-enabled engineering approaches and tools to improve delivery speed, quality, testing, documentation, and maintainability, with appropriate human review and responsible use.Designing, building, and operationalizing governed data platforms that support analytics, AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic workloads.Enabling data quality, metadata, lineage, security, privacy, governance, performance, reliability, and cost-effective operations.Participating in technical discovery, design sessions, code reviews, demonstrations, and knowledge sharing with clients and colleagues.Contributing to reusable patterns, accelerators, and engineering communities within Slalom. What You’ll BringWe welcome candidates with different combinations of experience. You do not need every skill listed below to be successful in this role. We are interested in the depth of your experience, your learning mindset, and the areas where you want to grow.Hands-on experience designing, building, testing, deploying, or supporting production data engineering solutions.Experience with at least one major cloud or data platform, such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, or Snowflake. Experience across multiple platforms is valued but not required. Proficiency in programming languages such as SQL, Python, Java and or Scala. Experience with several modern data engineering capabilities, such as data modeling, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, lakehouse architectures, streaming, APIs, orchestration, or data platform modernization. Familiarity with relevant technologies, which may include Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Dagster, Azure Data Factory, BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Dataplex, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Kinesis, Kubernetes, Terraform, or comparable tools. Understanding of how high-quality, secure, governed, and observable data foundations support AI, ML, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic solutions.Experience with AI-enabled or agentic engineering practices, including using AI-assisted development tools and designing data workflows or platforms that can support intelligent agents and automated decision workflows.A commitment to responsible engineering, including privacy, security, transparency, testing, monitoring, and appropriate human oversight for AI-enabled solutions.Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with an ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences.A curious, growth-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and delivery approaches.
Additional Experience That May Be HelpfulCloud, Databricks, or Snowflake certifications.Experience in consulting or in client-facing, cross-functional delivery teams.Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, vector databases, model or prompt monitoring, feature stores, semantic layers, or AI platform operations.Experience modernizing legacy data environments or migrating workloads to cloud platforms.Experience mentoring others or contributing to technical communities and reusable assets.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 
Hybrid/In office: We are hybrid and require that you live within a commutable distance to a Slalom location. If your team leader or client requires you to be onsite, there are expectations that you can meet those requirements.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this Consultant role, we are hiring at the following targeted base pay salary ranges:  
Boston, New York: $100,000 - $122,000
All other locations: $100,000 - $115,000
 In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. 
 We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note, this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.descriptionText:
SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to lead the design, architecture, and configuration of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions. This role will be responsible for defining finance transformation strategies, driving adoption of SAP leading practices, and ensuring scalable, compliant, and maintainable solutions across global finance organizations. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, including Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Asset Accounting, Project Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Record-to-Report (RTR), and financial reporting. The architect will serve as the primary advisor for finance process design, configuration decisions, solution governance, and business transformation initiatives. Relevant SAP S/4 leading practices include standardized end-to-end finance processes, embedded analytics, integrated finance and controlling, and adoption of SAP Fiori user experiences.

Responsibilities

Solution Architect and Design

 Lead the end-to-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance transformations. Define future-state finance operating models leveraging SAP best practices and standard functionality. Design scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with SAP Clean Core principles. Provide thought leadership on finance process transformation and ERP modernization initiatives. Evaluate business requirements and recommend optimal SAP standard capabilities before customizations.

Finance Process Leadership

 Serve as the functional architecture lead across key finance domains: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Project Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Consolidation and Financial Reporting, Treasury and Cash Management Lead finance process redesign workshops and drive adoption of SAP leading practices. Partner with Finance leadership to align business requirements with SAP solution capabilities.

SAP Configuration Leadership

 Lead and govern SAP S/4HANA Finance configuration activities. Define configuration standards for: Ledger Design, Company Codes, Chart of Accounts, Fiscal Year Variants, Posting Period Controls, Financial Statement Versions, Costing Structures, Parallel Accounting, Universal Journal (ACDOCA) Review and approve functional specifications, configuration documents, and solution designs. Ensure consistency across global deployments and member firm implementations. Ledger and accounting-principle design are critical tenant-level architecture decisions that affect reporting, compliance, and operational processes.

Reporting, Analytics & Controls

 Architect financial reporting solutions utilizing: SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Financial Reporting Structures Design solutions that support regulatory, statutory, management, and operational reporting requirements. Ensure strong internal controls and auditability across financial processes. Support finance organizations with KPI frameworks and executive reporting capabilities. Embedded analytics and integrated FI/CO reporting are key SAP S/4HANA finance leading practices.

Stakeholder Leadership

 Facilitate executive and business stakeholder workshops. Serve as trusted advisor to CFO organizations and finance leadership teams. Collaborate closely with Enterprise Architects, Data Migration Teams, Integration Teams, Reporting, Teams, Security Teams, SAP Delivery Partners. Present recommendations and architecture decisions to leadership governance boards.

Delivery Leadership

 Provide solution governance across all project phases: Discover, Design, Build, Test, Deploy, Hypercare Support testing strategy, defect resolution, cutover planning, and production readiness activities. Mentor SAP FI/CO consultants, business analysts, and functional leads.

Qualifications

 Minimum ten years of recent SAP Finance consulting experience. Minimum five years serving as SAP Finance Lead or Solution Architect. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, information systems, computer science, or related discipline from an accredited college or university Multiple end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation programs. Extensive experience leading global finance transformation initiatives. Experience working directly with CFO organizations and Finance leadership. Deep expertise in: SAP S/4HANA Finance, Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Universal Journal (ACDOCA), Asset Accounting, Project Systems / Professional Services, Revenue Recognition, Margin Analysis (CO-PA), Group Reporting, Financial Close Processes, Embedded Analytics, SAP Fiori Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud configuration and core organizational and financial design concepts is highly desirable. Strong understanding of: Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Project Financials, Revenue and Billing Processes, Internal Controls and Compliance, Professional Services Finance Operations. Possess business expertise, solid leadership skills, strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. Resource should be located within commuting distance of Montvale, Dallas, or Chicago.

rows.title: Product Manager, Stream & Batch Processing in Data Infrastructure
rows.descriptionText:
Meta’s products depend on data pipelines that process large-scale batch and real-time workloads. Today, those workloads span two ecosystems.Our streaming stack includes XStream and a growing managed Apache Flink footprint. Our batch stack includes Spark and Presto over Hive and Iceberg tables, Velox as a shared execution layer, and an internal workflow authoring and scheduling platform.These systems evolved separately. As a result, engineers encounter different authoring models, operational practices, guarantees, and migration paths depending on the workload they are building.We are looking for a senior individual-contributor PM to set the product direction across this portfolio. The immediate focus is to define a coherent customer experience across batch and streaming, align the long-term platform strategy, and help teams move from legacy systems safely.You will work closely with engineering leaders across multiple organizations. HiBob is a village filled with incredible people, and we’re proud of that. It’s a place where Bobbers can truly be themselves. We’re about fun, dreams, and ambition just as much as we’re about precision, growth, and high performance.

About the Team
In the Organizational Culture (OC) department, our Internal Marketing and Engagement team (Global Event Hub) focuses on creating enriching activities and engagements for employees. We aim to raise awareness of our company's culture and mission, promoting global adoption of our values. Our goal is to foster teamwork, inspire passion at work, and unite everyone in achieving our objectives.

We are looking for candidates: 
- Self and Mission driven: Passionate about the potential of our mission to 'Inspire Creativity and Bring Joy" and self-motivated to have a positive impact on society. 
- Business centric and analytical: Relentless in pursuing solutions to resolve root cause issues, and pragmatic in prioratising solutions which can help individuals/teams achieve actual business results.
- Entrepreneurial and Humble: Willing to innovate and pioneer by challenging assumptions and 'industry norms'. Willing to embrace different perspectives and ways of working. 
- Inclusive & Collaborative: Optimising for the greater good of the organisation by creating a collaborative environment where everyone can share their different experiences and perspectives. 
- Driven by data, logic and context: Rational in their communication style, to promote information transparency and expose problems candidly. 
- Courageous: Dare to take calculated risks and seek challenging goals, rising above boundaries/ limitations.

Responsibilities:
1. Global Campaigns & Projects 
- Lead the regional rollout of global culture campaigns, employee engagement programs, and other strategic initiatives across AMS region, from regional planning through local execution.
- Manage the full project lifecycle at the regional level, driving program planning, event production, communications, on-site operations, budget tracking, risk management, and post-event evaluation.

- Build and maintain partnerships with regional and local stakeholders across Business Lines and functional teams, identifying collaboration opportunities that support culture campaigns, strategic projects, and employee engagement priorities.
- Consolidate and coordinate regional resources across Business Lines and partner teams, including events, communication channels, employee networks, and operational support, to enable effective campaign delivery.

- Serve as the AMS regional POC for the OC–Internal Marketing & Engagement team, connecting global direction with regional priorities and local operational needs.
- Partner with local functional teams on ongoing operational programs and inquiries, providing guidance on OC-related processes, guidelines and next steps.
- Maintain and activate local Culture Buddy communities to expand local reach, strengthen employee participation, and support program delivery.

- Advise requestors on brand guidelines, operational processes, feasibility, and the effective use of available regional resources.

- Lead competitor product analysis across major platforms, emerging startups, and the broader creative technology ecosystem, with a focus on product capabilities, workflows, positioning, and advertiser value propositions
- Compare product design, functionality, user journeys, and feature gaps across TikTok and competitor platforms to identify opportunities for product improvement and differentiation

- Collaborate with product teams to advance key strategic projects and ensure consistent execution across markets

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
A part of the Trust and Safety Product organization, the Research Data team is focused on enabling the work of independent researchers to understand the content and activities that take place on the TikTok platform. We lead initiatives to share data with the research community as part of an industry-leading transparency and compliance program. We are looking for an experienced Research Data Program Manager to expand our team's work delivering this mission with a focus on improving internal processes, developing insights, and expanding TikTok's offerings to the research community. 

The Research Data Program Manager is a role focused on driving TikTok Trust & Safety's research, transparency, and regulatory compliance efforts. The Research Data Program Manager will take ownership of processes related to our Research Tools, including the application process, increasing uptake and understanding of the tools in the research community, and working with internal stakeholders to strengthen and improve TikTok's research data offerings. Additionally, the Research Data Program Manager will conduct analysis with and about our data tools in order to develop original insights for the Trust & Safety team. 

Responsibilities:
- Ensure TikTok is prepared to fulfill research data sharing regulatory requirements.
- Manage research data compliance process including application review.
- Work cross-functionally to evaluate and improve data sharing tools and procedures.
- Collaborate closely with external stakeholders to understand research requirements and propose responsive solutions.
- Contribute to advancing TikTok's Trust & Safety Research agenda.
- Help define TikTok's longer term data sharing and transparency roadmap and work with our partner teams to make product, technical, and privacy decisions.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
- Strong understanding of research activities including research ethics and data privacy.
- Experience conducting quantitative or mixed methods original research in an academic, NGO, and/or tech setting.
- Master's degree with a strong research component; Ability to translate requirements between the academic, regulatory, and tech sectors.
- Experience building new processes and driving alignment across teams.
- Proactive and detail oriented; able to interpret and apply guidance from various disciplines to the task at hand.
- You thrive in fast-paced entrepreneurial environments and are able to deal with rapid changes, high ambiguity and imperfect status quo.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- PhD in a discipline that includes work with big data and/or social media data.
- 5+ years of experience in tech, academia, law, or a comparable discipline.
- Experience with presentations to stakeholders, leading trainings, and/or teaching.
- Keen interest in and familiarity with the global regulatory environment as it relates to researcher data access.

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. 

TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. 

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.

rows.title: Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
As a Sustaining Reliability Engineer at Meta Reality Labs, you will set the technical direction for the long-term reliability and quality of consumer hardware products after launch across Meta's device portfolio, including virtual reality headsets, augmented reality glasses, and wearable devices. In this role, you will own reliability engineering strategy for the installed base and for products scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and you will drive systemic resolution of field failures to root cause and corrective action across product families. You will define the metrics, methodologies, and reaction frameworks the organization uses to sustain field performance, influence design and architectural decisions on current and next-generation products, and partner with and influence cross-functional leaders and external suppliers. You will be a recognized technical authority who leverages data to identify population-based reliability and quality risks in both the factory and the field, and who mentors and elevates other engineers across the function.

Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer Responsibilities:

Own the reliability and quality engineering strategy and metrics (field return rate, failure rate, and quality KPIs) for all products actively out in the market or currently scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and set the bar for what good looks like across the portfolioDrive systemic resolution of field performance issues, component obsolescence, and return-rate (RMA/warranty) optimization to root cause and corrective action, in partnership with cross-functional internal and external partners, including recurring and cross-product failure modesPartner with and influence internal leaders and external suppliers to ensure long-term hardware field performance, and close the loop by institutionalizing lessons learned into design, NPI, and supplier processesDefine and own the field signal analytics, product health telemetry, and failure-reaction frameworks the organization relies onset thresholds and escalation triggers for products in the fieldEstablish the standards, methodologies, and metrics for sustaining reliability and quality, including ongoing reliability testing (e.g., ORT), excursion/ECO assessment, post-ramp qualifications (PRQ) and change control against reliability and quality goalsLead complex, multidisciplinary root cause analysis for reliability and quality escapes, distinguishing between design, material, manufacturing-process, and use-condition contributors, and drive corrective actions to closureProvide Design-for-Reliability and architectural evaluations that carry field and sustaining learnings into new product categories and next-generation designsOwn the quality management system for products in sustainingunderstand, analyze, and resolve field quality issues and influence internal teams to drive durable quality improvementsTranslate reliability and quality data into risk assessments, reports, and positions that inform executive product and business decisionsMentor and technically guide reliability and quality engineers across the function, raising the capability of the team

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experienceBachelor's degree in Mechanical, Materials, or Electrical Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience10+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering and/or product quality for consumer electronics, wearable devices, or similar electro-mechanical productsKnowledge of mechanical design, material science, and the failure mechanisms of consumer electronicsExperience driving root cause analysis, design of experiments (DOE), and corrective action on complex hardware systemsExperience analyzing reliability data, field return, and warranty metrics to identify systemic failure trends and drive engineering corrective actionsKnowledge of industry test standards including ASTM, MIL, JEDEC, and IECKnowledge of failure analysis techniques and tools including optical microscopy, X-Ray, CT scan, SEM, EDX, and FTIRExperience independently driving decisions and dependencies across multiple teams or functions in a dynamic environment

Preferred Qualifications:

Track record of defining mission profiles and reliability/quality strategy for new product categoriesExperience with data mining and data visualization to make strategic business decisions, and with Asia high-volume manufacturing and external partner relationship managementMS or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent disciplineFamiliarity with Weibull analysis, reliability growth modeling, and statistical reliability prediction methods12+ years of experience, including field/sustaining reliability and post-launch product improvement for VR, AR, or wearable device product lines (display, optics, battery, sensor subsystem failure modes)Experience with quality and statistics tools and methodology (8D, PFMEA, SPC, DOE)Certified Quality Engineer or Lean/Six Sigma Black BeltExperience using AI tools to redesign reliability/quality data analysis workflows, accelerate failure-pattern identification, or improve reporting efficiency

rows.title: Competitive Intelligence Lead
rows.descriptionText:
As an Analyst in Meta’s Competitive Intelligence organization, you will operate at the intersection of analytics, data science, and market strategy. You will work on major projects and product areas (often in environments of significant ambiguity or technical complexity) to drive both technical and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for builders who thrive on solving real problems.This role demands a unique blend of analytical and statistical knowledge, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate complex insights into impactful product and business decisions. You will be recognized as a thought partner by cross-functional leads and will help shape the analytical foundations that inform how we build and grow our products.

Competitive Intelligence Lead Responsibilities:

As a Sustaining Reliability Engineer at Meta Reality Labs, you will set the technical direction for the long-term reliability and quality of consumer hardware products after launch across Meta's device portfolio, including virtual reality headsets, augmented reality glasses, and wearable devices. In this role, you will own reliability engineering strategy for the installed base and for products scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and you will drive systemic resolution of field failures to root cause and corrective action across product families. You will define the metrics, methodologies, and reaction frameworks the organization uses to sustain field performance, influence design and architectural decisions on current and next-generation products, and partner with and influence cross-functional leaders and external suppliers. rows.title: Competitive Intelligence Lead
rows.descriptionText:
As an Analyst in Meta’s Competitive Intelligence organization, you will operate at the intersection of analytics, data science, and market strategy. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for builders who thrive on solving real problems.This role demands a unique blend of analytical and statistical knowledge, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate complex insights into impactful product and business decisions. You will be recognized as a thought partner by cross-functional leads and will help shape the analytical foundations that inform how we build and grow our products.

Competitive Intelligence Lead Responsibilities:

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelors degree and a minimum of 4 years of work experience (minimum of 2 years with a Ph.D.) in business intelligence, product analytics, or economic / strategy consulting in a technology environment with increasing scope and impactDemonstrated skill to ethically source, validate, and synthesize high-signal insights from people (e.g., stakeholder interviews, skilled conversations, field research, and relationship-based information gathering) while maintaining high standards for privacy, consent, and integrityProficiency in AI-powered tools: Demonstrate working knowledge of Generative AI technologies (e.g., LLM and AI agents) and experience designing, prompting, and orchestrating AI systems (e.g., prompt engineering) to automate data analyses, synthesize insights, and execute multi-step analytical tasks (e.g., prompting agent to clean datasets, build visualizations)Practical working understanding of data-analytics tools, and direct experience managing, analyzing, manipulating and interpreting 1P and external 3P datasetsExperience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python), and/or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R)Experience with statistical analysis, including causal inference (e.g., randomized control trials, quasi-experimentation such as synthetic control, diff-in-diff, meta-analyses) and/or bayesian aggregation (e.g., bayesian pooling, hierarchical modeling)Demonstrated communication skills and experience presenting complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholdersDemonstrated experience thriving in ambiguous environments and shaping new analytics organizations or products

Master's or Ph.D. Degree in a quantitative field such as Quantitative Economics or Political Science, Operations Research, Data Science, Computer Science, Physics, Business, or MathematicsDemonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

rows.title: Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
As a Sustaining Reliability Engineer at Meta Reality Labs, you will set the technical direction for the long-term reliability and quality of consumer hardware products after launch across Meta's device portfolio, including virtual reality headsets, augmented reality glasses, and wearable devices. In this role, you will own reliability engineering strategy for the installed base and for products scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and you will drive systemic resolution of field failures to root cause and corrective action across product families. You will define the metrics, methodologies, and reaction frameworks the organization uses to sustain field performance, influence design and architectural decisions on current and next-generation products, and partner with and influence cross-functional leaders and external suppliers. You will be a recognized technical authority who leverages data to identify population-based reliability and quality risks in both the factory and the field, and who mentors and elevates other engineers across the function.

Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer Responsibilities:

Own the reliability and quality engineering strategy and metrics (field return rate, failure rate, and quality KPIs) for all products actively out in the market or currently scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and set the bar for what good looks like across the portfolioDrive systemic resolution of field performance issues, component obsolescence, and return-rate (RMA/warranty) optimization to root cause and corrective action, in partnership with cross-functional internal and external partners, including recurring and cross-product failure modesPartner with and influence internal leaders and external suppliers to ensure long-term hardware field performance, and close the loop by institutionalizing lessons learned into design, NPI, and supplier processesDefine and own the field signal analytics, product health telemetry, and failure-reaction frameworks the organization relies onset thresholds and escalation triggers for products in the fieldEstablish the standards, methodologies, and metrics for sustaining reliability and quality, including ongoing reliability testing (e.g., ORT), excursion/ECO assessment, post-ramp qualifications (PRQ) and change control against reliability and quality goalsLead complex, multidisciplinary root cause analysis for reliability and quality escapes, distinguishing between design, material, manufacturing-process, and use-condition contributors, and drive corrective actions to closureProvide Design-for-Reliability and architectural evaluations that carry field and sustaining learnings into new product categories and next-generation designsOwn the quality management system for products in sustainingunderstand, analyze, and resolve field quality issues and influence internal teams to drive durable quality improvementsTranslate reliability and quality data into risk assessments, reports, and positions that inform executive product and business decisionsMentor and technically guide reliability and quality engineers across the function, raising the capability of the team

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experienceBachelor's degree in Mechanical, Materials, or Electrical Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience10+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering and/or product quality for consumer electronics, wearable devices, or similar electro-mechanical productsKnowledge of mechanical design, material science, and the failure mechanisms of consumer electronicsExperience driving root cause analysis, design of experiments (DOE), and corrective action on complex hardware systemsExperience analyzing reliability data, field return, and warranty metrics to identify systemic failure trends and drive engineering corrective actionsKnowledge of industry test standards including ASTM, MIL, JEDEC, and IECKnowledge of failure analysis techniques and tools including optical microscopy, X-Ray, CT scan, SEM, EDX, and FTIRExperience independently driving decisions and dependencies across multiple teams or functions in a dynamic environment
